lists.content:
• Own and drive the successful execution of complex, multi-functional Global R&D Vault implementations (Clinical, Regulatory, and Safety) at our strategic accounts, ensuring measurable business impact and financial excellence
  • Forge and cement deep, trusted-advisor relationships with customer IT and business executives to define, secure buy-in for, and govern the long-term R&D transformation roadmaps
  • Strategically lead and align all cross-functional Veeva teams—Sales, Product, Strategy, and Services—acting as the primary executive liaison to deliver unified, outcome-driven programs and unlock maximum value for the customer
  • Champion the growth trajectory of the account by crafting, negotiating, and leading services contracts and implementation proposals that expand customer value and product adoption
  • Act as the ultimate program governance leader by proactively anticipating risks, resolving complex internal and external challenges (the first line of escalation), and inspiring excellence across diverse project teams
  • Ensure long-term success and continuity by overseeing smooth transitions from implementation into post-deployment operations and ongoing customer enablement teams
  • Communicate proactively and with executive clarity, ensuring all stakeholders at all levels are fully aligned, informed, and motivated to achieve world-class results

• Extensive program leadership experience (7+ years) delivering enterprise-scale R&D or GxP technology programs in Pharma (Clinical, Regulatory, or Safety)
  • Deep understanding of Pharmaceutical R&D functions such as Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Safety, Quality, or Manufacturing
  • Proven consulting expertise supporting enterprise pharma clients across multiple business domains
  • Demonstrated success leading global teams to deliver complex, multi-system implementations with measurable impact
  • Strategic thinker with experience defining technology roadmaps that modernize operations and enable transformation
  • Executive communicator capable of influencing decisions and building alignment across diverse stakeholder groups
  • Resilient problem solver who thrives in ambiguity, negotiates with confidence, and drives accountability without authority
  • Collaborative leader skilled in orchestrating multiple internal and external teams while maintaining high delivery cadence
  • Based in the EU or UK and able to travel up to 25% of the time

• Direct experience leading a Veeva Vault implementation (e.g., Clinical, RIM, Quality, Safety)
  • Previous experience with large-scale Software as a Service (SaaS) implementations in the highly regulated GxP environment

  • Forge and cement deep, trusted-advisor relationships with customer IT and business executives to define, secure buy-in for, and govern the long-term R&D transformation roadmaps
  • Strategically lead and align all cross-functional Veeva teams—Sales, Product, Strategy, and Services—acting as the primary executive liaison to deliver unified, outcome-driven programs and unlock maximum value for the customer
  • Champion the growth trajectory of the account by crafting, negotiating, and leading services contracts and implementation proposals that expand customer value and product adoption
  • Act as the ultimate program governance leader by proactively anticipating risks, resolving complex internal and external challenges (the first line of escalation), and inspiring excellence across diverse project teams
  • Ensure long-term success and continuity by overseeing smooth transitions from implementation into post-deployment operations and ongoing customer enablement teams
  • Communicate proactively and with executive clarity, ensuring all stakeholders at all levels are fully aligned, informed, and motivated to achieve world-class results

• Extensive program leadership experience (7+ years) delivering enterprise-scale R&D or GxP technology programs in Pharma (Clinical, Regulatory, or Safety)
  • Deep understanding of Pharmaceutical R&D functions such as Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Safety, Quality, or Manufacturing
  • Proven consulting expertise supporting enterprise pharma clients across multiple business domains
  • Demonstrated success leading global teams to deliver complex, multi-system implementations with measurable impact
  • Strategic thinker with experience defining technology roadmaps that modernize operations and enable transformation
  • Executive communicator capable of influencing decisions and building alignment across diverse stakeholder groups
  • Resilient problem solver who thrives in ambiguity, negotiates with confidence, and drives accountability without authority
  • Collaborative leader skilled in orchestrating multiple internal and external teams while maintaining high delivery cadence
  • Based in the Denmark and able to travel up to 25% of the time

• Direct experience leading a Veeva Vault implementation (e.g., Clinical, RIM, Quality, Safety)
  • Previous experience with large-scale Software as a Service (SaaS) implementations in the highly regulated GxP environment

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.

lists.content:
• Build Smart Workflows: You will overhaul our hiring operations by building more robust logic into our current spreadsheet environment. You’ll focus on creating automated, well-aligned workflows that solve operational bottlenecks through process design rather than the "crutch" of a traditional ATS.
  • Standardize Hiring Excellence: You will set the gold standard for candidate quality and process integrity. This includes designing robust verification protocols, ensuring only high-caliber talent enters the training pipeline.
  • Optimize Team Performance: As the owner of the hiring team's output, you will monitor critical metrics to identify performance gaps. You’ll lead calibration efforts to ensure Hiring Coordinators meet quality standards while executing projects that measurably improve recruitment speed and conversion rates.
  • Model Scalable Capacity: You will design and manage the headcount model for our Hiring Coordinators. By tracking incoming request volumes, you will ensure the team is perfectly sized to meet global headcount demands without bottlenecks.
  • Servant Leadership: Lead, mentor, and inspire a team of remote Hiring Coordinators. You will foster a culture of high performance by providing clarity on targets and ensuring constant alignment with project quality requirements.
  • Risk & Compliance Management: Proactively identify pipeline risks and operational incidents ensuring they are escalated and resolved through recurring process audits.

• Data-First Mindset: 2+ years of experience in a fast-paced environment (Tech, Startup, Ops) with a proven track record of managing hiring processes.
  • Process Mastery: You are a workflow specialist with deep experience in process design. You’re comfortable managing high-volume hiring targets and have the unique ability to build structured, scalable systems in environments that aren’t yet fully automated.
  • Quality Oversight: Experience in leveraging team data to pinpoint quality gaps and recalibrating output to ensure consistent alignment with project standards.
  • Global Communicator: Excellent English skills with a proven track record of cross-functional stakeholder management. You translate operational bottlenecks into clear so

• Experience leading a recruitment team within a high-volume function.
  • Experience building hiring pipelines for freelance and contingent talent.

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.
  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Opportunity to work in a diverse and international workspace
  • Life insurance
  • 1% charitable giving program
  • Fitness reimbursement

• Total compensation: 35,000 - 50,000 EUR
  • The total compensation range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential total compensation range for this role. Please note that actual total compensation may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position's total compensation may be composed of other types of compensation, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

As a Consultant, you will play a pivotal role in the success of our commercial implementation projects in CRM and Events Management area. You'll work directly with top pharma organizations, leading business process due diligence and designing solutions that meet our customers' needs. Your expertise will be key to the on-time, high-quality delivery of our Veeva solutions built on the Vault platform, and you will have the opportunity to take on leading roles such as Project Manager, Solution Architect, Functional Analyst, or Configuration Specialist.

lists.content:
• Implement Veeva Solutions: Participate in one or multiple Veeva product implementation or migration projects covering autonomously the assigned role (such as configuration specialist, functional analyst, solution architect, stream lead, project manager)
  • Configure and Customize: Get hands-on with our Veeva CRM and Vault platforms, configuring and customizing solutions to meet our clients' specific needs
  • Lead Client Engagements: Take ownership of client-facing activities, including leading workshops, user acceptance testing (UAT), and training sessions. You will guide clients through the implementation process, from initial design to final delivery
  • Provide Expert Advisory: Act as a trusted advisor to clients, supporting the optimization and harmonization of their business processes. You will translate complex requirements into actionable and scalable solution designs
  • Collaborate and Contribute: Work closely with international teams to deliver projects with a focus on global scalability. Your contributions will ensure our foundational solutions are robust and ready for future market rollouts
  • Grow Your Expertise: We'll invest in your professional development. You will have the opportunity to earn certifications on our platform and stay at the forefront of industry best practices
  • Be Part of the Team: Collaborate proactively on internal initiatives and projects

• Demonstrated 3+ years of consulting experience, within Life Sciences or adjacent industry
  • 3+ years of hands-on SaaS technology implementation projects, in the following roles or similar: Configuration Specialist, Functional Analyst, Solution Architect, Business or Technical Consultant
  • Demonstrated ability to manage customer-facing activities and stakeholder relationships
  • Strong presentation skills and experience are essential
  • Able to travel approximately 20%
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken) and one of the following languages: French, German, Spanish, or Italian

• Experience working on projects with a global scope or with international teams
  • Understanding of Medical, Key Account Management, or Events Management
  • Salesforce.com certification and implementation experiences
  • Veeva certification and implementation experiences
  • Major events management platforms (e.g. Cvent, SpotMe, On25) implementation experiences
  • Experience in multichannel marketing
  • Additional European language

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.
  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Work Anywhere policy - You can utilise our office spaces or work remotely
  • Stock bonus %
  • Private medical insurance
  • Life assurance
  • Veeva 1% giving
  • Wellness reimbursement
  • The chance to work with a genuine market leader
  • Incredible support from the wider team, and a best-in-class tech stack to help you be successful in your role

The growth of Vault CRM is leading the way on future innovations around how life sciences engage customers, helping get lifesaving treatments to patients, faster. You will be making a true difference to people’s lives all around the world.
 
As a Consultant, you will play a pivotal role in the success of our commercial implementation projects in CRM and Events Management area. You'll work directly with top pharma organizations, leading business process due diligence and designing solutions that meet our customers' needs. Your expertise will be key to the on-time, high-quality delivery of our Veeva solutions built on the Vault platform, and you will have the opportunity to take on leading roles such as Project Manager, Solution Architect, Functional Analyst, or Configuration Specialist.
 
The ability to travel domestically and abroad is required (VISA not being handled by Veeva). The ideal candidate will be fluent in English and ideally one of the following languages: French, German, Italian, or Spanish. The role is ideally based in the area of a Veeva office (Barcelona, London, Paris, Frankfurt, Berlin), but other EU locations will be considered.

lists.content:
• Implement Veeva Solutions: Participate in one or multiple Veeva product implementation or migration projects covering autonomously the assigned role (such as configuration specialist, functional analyst, solution architect, stream lead, project manager)
  • Configure and Customize: Get hands-on with our Veeva CRM and Vault platforms, configuring and customizing solutions to meet our clients' specific needs
  • Lead Client Engagements: Take ownership of client-facing activities, including leading workshops, user acceptance testing (UAT), and training sessions. You will guide clients through the implementation process, from initial design to final delivery
  • Provide Expert Advisory: Act as a trusted advisor to clients, supporting the optimization and harmonization of their business processes. You will translate complex requirements into actionable and scalable solution designs
  • Collaborate and Contribute: Work closely with international teams to deliver projects with a focus on global scalability. Your contributions will ensure our foundational solutions are robust and ready for future market rollouts
  • Grow Your Expertise: We'll invest in your professional development. You will have the opportunity to earn certifications on our platform and stay at the forefront of industry best practices
  • Be Part of the Team: Collaborate proactively on internal initiatives and projects

• Demonstrated 3+ years of consulting experience, within Life Sciences or adjacent industry
  • 3+ years of hands-on SaaS technology implementation projects, in the following roles or similar: Configuration Specialist, Functional Analyst, Solution Architect, Business or Technical Consultant
  • Demonstrated ability to manage customer-facing activities and stakeholder relationships
  • Strong presentation skills and experience are essential
  • Able to travel approximately 20%
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken) and one of the following languages: French, German, Spanish, or Italian

• Experience working on projects with a global scope or with international teams
  • Understanding of Medical, Key Account Management, or Events Management
  • Salesforce.com certification and implementation experiences
  • Veeva certification and implementation experiences
  • Major events management platforms (e.g. Cvent, SpotMe, On25) implementation experiences
  • Experience in multichannel marketing
  • Additional European language

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Work Anywhere policy - You can utilise our office spaces or work remotely
  • Stock bonus %
  • Private medical insurance
  • Life assurance
  • Veeva 1% giving
  • Wellness reimbursement
  • The chance to work with a genuine market leader
  • Incredible support from the wider team, and a best-in-class tech stack to help you be successful in your role

• Total compensation: 50,000 - 85,000 EUR
  • The total compensation range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential total compensation range for this role. Please note that actual total compensation may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position's total compensation may be composed of other types of compensation, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

The Role
Veeva is dedicated to building the careers of university students & graduates. Generation Veeva is a global organization that offers multiple development programs and career paths. Each path is designed to develop you professionally in a supportive environment. Workshops, mentors, career path planning, and on-the-job learning are all things you can look forward to as you grow your career at Veeva.
 
Join us as an Implementation Consultant Intern, working with our experienced Consulting teams. You will learn about the full implementation lifecycle of Veeva software applications for a wide range of Life Sciences clients, support project teams to deliver high-quality solutions to drive customer success and build your knowledge about the Life Sciences industry’s business processes.
 
This internship is for at least 6 months duration (at least 3 days per week) and provides the opportunity to explore a full-time Associate Consultant position, part of our global Consultant Development Program, after graduating from the University.

The Role
Veeva Systems is looking for individual leaders with consulting and system implementation experience and a passion for helping customers optimize their regulatory data and document management processes.
 
Veeva’s Vault RIM suite is the industry’s only unified software solution that provides fully integrated regulatory information management (RIM) capabilities, including data and document management, submission publishing, and archival on a single cloud-based platform.
 
As a member of our Professional Services team, you will be responsible for understanding our customers’ global regulatory needs, translating requirements into solution design, and configuring our cloud-based solution for managing regulatory information across the enterprise.
 
There is no work location requirement (remote position) within the EU/UK if a candidate is in close proximity to an airport and able to meet travel requirements. Qualified EU/UK-based candidates are encouraged to apply.

The Role

The IT Integration Engineer will be a key member of Veeva's Global IT delivery team, responsible for designing, developing, and implementing enterprise-scale integration solutions and data architectures that power our internal business operations. The ideal candidate is an experienced integration engineer who excels at translating complex business requirements into scalable, cloud-native technical designs across SaaS platforms. This role requires both strong hands-on technical execution and the ability to communicate effectively across business and technical stakeholders at all levels.

lists.content:
• Collaborate with system analysts, platform architects, and business SMEs to derive integration requirements and translate those needs into detailed technical designs.
  • Design, develop, and implement efficient and scalable integration solutions, adhering to best-practice standards in performance, maintainability, exception handling, and recovery.
  • Apply security and availability best-practice principles to data architecture design and the implementation of integration frameworks.
  • Develop and implement efficient and scalable data models and schemas to support transactional integrations and analytics implementations.
  • Design, develop, test, and implement ETL solutions for data warehousing needs.
  • Own and maintain the enterprise integration portfolio, partnering with the Enterprise Architect to ensure alignment with the Applications IT Roadmap.

• BS or MS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • Hands-on experience with modern cloud integration platforms; Boomi is highly preferred. Mulesoft, Informatica, AWS Lambda, Talend, or other open-source iPaaS experience will be considered.
  • Experience designing, deploying, and managing Boomi Atoms, Molecules, and Atom Clouds in an enterprise environment.
  • Experience designing and publishing managed APIs using Boomi API Management or a comparable API gateway platform.
  • Demonstrated experience monitoring, alerting, and operationally supporting live integration environments, including error handling, retry logic, and incident response.
  • Proven experience implementing enterprise-scale SaaS solutions such as Salesforce, NetSuite, Workday, or similar platforms.
  • Strong background in the architecture, design, development, implementation, and support of ETL processes and supporting technology platforms.
  • Proficiency with SQL, NoSQL, and Python; working knowledge of MDX and a strong foundational understanding of XML and JSON are required.
  • Solid programming skills in JavaScript or other modern object-oriented languages, with experience building and consuming SOAP and REST web services.
  • Demonstrated technology leadership across complex technical implementations with a strong focus on cloud architecture and cross-platform integration.
  • Strong ability to identify, communicate, and manage technical risk across projects and stakeholders.
  • Excellent leadership, collaboration, and motivational skills.
  • Solid understanding of data architecture, business analytics, and integration frameworks.
  • Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills with the ability to communicate complex technical information to audiences at all levels of the organization.

• Boomi certification at the Associate, Professional, or Architect level is a plus.
  • Experience operating in an Agile development environment.
  • Familiarity with Agile tools such as Jira or Confluence.
  • Working knowledge of SCM tools (Git preferred) and code management best practices.
  • Understanding of CI/CD deployment models and release strategy.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS cloud environments.
  • Experience with Single Sign-On (SSO) technologies such as Okta.
  • Experience integrating with Veeva products is a plus.

The Role
Ostro is a specialized business division within Veeva, dedicated to advancing brand engagement for the life sciences industry through AI technology. Veeva Ostro empowers life sciences companies to transform how they connect with the people who need their innovations most. By joining this fast-growing team, you will work at the forefront of leveraging AI innovations to make healthcare information seamless, intuitive, and impactful.
 
Reporting to the Manager, Nurse Navigator Operations and Training (MNNO&T), the Junior Consumer Support Navigator (CSN) is a webchat and call center specialist who is responsible for providing inbound and outbound customer (consumer) support in a Life Sciences (Biotech) environment. In addition, the focus of the CSN is to ensure that the activities of the CSN contribute to the MNNO&T’s overall program objectives.
This role averages 17–25 hours per week. Our goal is to grow volume and budget in a way that allows per diem team members to transition into full-time roles over time.

lists.content:
• Assists the Nurse Navigator (NN) Team by answering incoming webchat and telephonic consumer inquiries/interactions in a professional manner following client guidelines and business rules
  • Perform outgoing webchats in professional manner following client guidelines and business rules
  • Responds to consumer inquiries and provides education or information to answer questions utilizing Client approved FAQ documents
  • Identify and escalate priority issues to assigned manager and/or Nurse Navigator
  • Display exemplary phone/chat etiquette utilizing approved FAQ documents
  • Complies with departmental standards regarding training, professional development, communication, management of workload, and safety/emergency situations
  • Completes all necessary compliance training in specified timeframe
  • Understands and utilizes telephony system and records appropriate information in the Ostro database in accordance with customer business rules and training
  • Documents all call/webchat information in Ostro’s database system
  • Identifies and reports AE/PQC/SS in accordance with Ostro and client guidelines

• Active LPN licensure required
  • Must be available to work 20 hours per week and evenings until 8:00pm EST. Our full hours of service are Monday - Friday 8:00am - 8:00pm EST
  • Must reside in one of the following states: Arizona, Connecticut, Delaware, District of Columbia, Florida, Illinois, Iowa, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Texas, Virginia
  • 1+ year experience in a call center within life sciences, healthcare or patient support program preferred
  • Google Drive Platform experience a plus
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Excellent listening skills 
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Ability to multitask, take direction, and maintain prioritization
  • Excellent follow-up skills
  • Must have strong computer skills
  • Must be able to type 35 wpm
  • Spanish fluency a plus
  • Interest in full-time opportunities in the future is a plus

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Base pay: $22 - $28 per hour
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
 
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
 
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.


The Role
Our vision for Link is to become the global leader in deep data for life sciences. It helps professionals to find the right people for, e.g., clinical trials, education programs, or advisory boards. This streamlined access helps to reduce the time-to-market of important drugs, conduct trials with the most relevant experts in the respective field, and spread information about new treatments to key people in the life science community. You can read more about Veeva Link on our product pages at https://www.veeva.com/products/veeva-link/.
 
As our lead, you will guide and develop a remote team of approximately 40 researchers who identify various data related to Key People while following compliance and quality standards. You will design data production processes and drive process and technology improvements. You are fully responsible for your team's performance (efficiency and quality).
 
To thrive in your role, you are highly motivated to lead and have a "can do" attitude. You are results-oriented, analytical, methodical, and socially skilled. You communicate effectively with managers, analysts, and researchers.
 
We care about a great cultural fit. You should enjoy working remotely and at speed in multi-cultural teams. If you are excited about leadership and operations and working for a fast-growing tech company, we are the optimal fit.
 
Overall, this is an exciting opportunity for someone with strong leadership and operational skills to make a significant impact in the life sciences industry.

Are you a passionate and curious individual with a relentless drive for delivering successful software implementations? Do you enjoy tackling large-scale, complex problems and leading high-energy teams focused on transforming the way Life Sciences companies bring drugs to market?
 
We are looking for a senior, self-motivated Lead Consultant to join our Professional Services team. You'll be at the forefront of our mission, leading a team of Veeva colleagues and working side-by-side with one of our key enterprise customers. As a primary customer liaison, you will build long-term relationships and act as a customer advocate, guiding them in the adoption of industry best practices and providing value through agile delivery.
 
You'll leverage your existing background in Life Sciences software implementation and program/project management while innovating and developing novel approaches to project delivery. You’ll be responsible for empowering enterprise companies with best-of-breed cloud-based technology.

lists.content:
• Lead a key enterprise customer in the IT Operations and implementation of Veeva Quality Cloud suite
  • Manage a multi-year, multi-phased global implementation program, overseeing all aspects of program and project management, including resource planning, team leadership, project tracking, and forecasting
  • Act as the primary customer liaison, managing all communication and relationships between the project team, customer, and internal stakeholders
  • Oversee customer release management programs and IT operations for Veeva Quality Cloud suite
  • Analyze customer requirements and new product features to develop customer adoption and enhancement roadmaps
  • Mentor project teams and junior consultants within the Quality Services organization
  • Guide customers in adopting Quality Cloud and industry best practices as part of post-implementation programs focused on continuous improvement

• 8+ years of experience in IT Project Management, Consulting, or Product Management, with a proven track record of leading system implementation projects
  • Experience leading large-scale Enterprise projects
  • Proven ability to work both independently and in teams in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience in assembling, planning, resourcing, budgeting, and leading project teams
  • Experience designing and executing on effective project governance models for large enterprises
  • Strong technical affinity and/or hands-on experience with software implementation
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to engage with senior/executive-level stakeholders
  • Good understanding of SaaS and GxP principles
  • Ability to travel 25-50%; easy access to an airport
  • Must be legally authorized to be employed in the EU. Veeva Systems does not anticipate providing sponsorship for employment visa status for this position

• Direct experience with eContent Management systems such as Veeva Vault, TrackWise, OpenText, SharePoint, Documentum, MasterControl, EtQ, FirstDoc/FirstPoint, or NextDocs
  • Experience in the Life Sciences Quality, Clinical, Regulatory, and/or Drug Safety spaces
  • PMP, Prince2, or Agile Scrum Master certification
  • Experience with Agile methodology and/or ACP Certification
  • Change management experience
  • Experience with PMO organizations

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Total compensation: 18,000,000 - 33,000,000 HUF
  • The total compensation range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential total compensation range for this role. Please note that actual total compensation may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position's total compensation may be composed of other types of compensation, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

The Role
Are you passionate about continuous innovation, building long-term customer relationships, and providing value through agile delivery? Do you enjoy tackling large-scale, complex problems?
 
Veeva Systems is looking for driven, self-motivated Program Leads with a passion for empowering enterprise companies with best-of-breed cloud-based technology. Veeva’s Vault Development Cloud helps organizations eliminate silos and transforms business processes across clinical, regulatory, quality, and drug safety with greater efficiency and compliance.
 
Program Leads within our practice will be responsible for leading a team of technical Veeva colleagues in developing and executing a strategic roadmap of enhancements for a customer’s Veeva Vault products. You’ll oversee implementing an agile release methodology and managing operations across customer QA, IT, and Business teams. In this role, you’ll have an opportunity to partner and build relationships with some of Veeva’s largest, most complex, and strategic customers.
 
This is a remote, full-time permanent role with Veeva. There is no work location requirement. This is a customer-facing role with occasional travel requirements.
 
Veeva Systems does not anticipate providing sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B, OPT) for this employment position.

lists.content:
• Program Lead IT Operations at our customers for Veeva’s R&D SaaS solutions
  • Function as a Primary customer liaison managing communication between managed services teams, customer stakeholders, and 3rd parties
  • Oversee customer release management programs including resource planning, release tracking, and forecasting
  • Support with the analysis of customer requirements and new product features to develop customer adoption and enhancement roadmaps
  • Guide customers in adopting Vault and industry best practices as part of post-implementation programs focused on the holistic success and continuous improvement of the customer

• 8+ years of experience in IT Project Management
  • Proven program management track record leading implementation and/or post implementation teams, whilst still have a good understanding of technical knowledge
  • Proven ability to work both independently and in teams in a dynamic, fast-moving environment
  • Ability to quickly understand business requirements and design creative solutions
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills – our company language is English
  • Project Management Certification or equivalent relevant experience

• Experience in the Lifesciences Quality, Clinical, Regulatory, or Drug Safety spaces
  • Experience with Data or Content Management applications
  • Direct experience with systems such as Veeva Vault, Monday.com, Google Docs, SharePoint, Smartsheet

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Total compensation: 18,000,000 - 33,000,000 HUF
  • The total compensation range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential total compensation range for this role. Please note that actual total compensation may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position's total compensation may be composed of other types of compensation, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

The Role
Do you dream about being part of a team with the talent, passion, and financial backing to build top-notch, industry-changing cloud-based applications and platforms? At Veeva, we build enterprise cloud technology that powers the biggest names in pharmaceuticals, biotech, consumer goods, chemical & cosmetics industries. Our customers make vaccines, life-saving medicines, and life-enhancing products that make a difference in everyday lives. Our technology has transformed these industries, enabling them to get critical products and services to market faster. Our products empower our customers in the fight against global pandemics like COVID-19.
 
Veeva Systems is expanding its global footprint with a new development centre in Hyderabad, India. This emerging and growing branch of Veeva is looking for Software Engineer, Test Automation for multiple positions to expand global quality & release engineering efforts. You will be working on cutting-edge technologies such as Cucumber, AWS(EC2, S3, Workspace), Visual Regression & DevOps Tools, playing a pivotal role in developing/maintaining automating tests to support our ever-growing suite of regression tests. The ideal candidate will be highly technical, motivated, and can work without too much supervision.

lists.content:
• Learn and understand features of Veeva Vault platform and applications
  • Work on CI/CD tools (Git, Jenkins, JIRA) on a daily basis 
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts (API and UI)
  • Communicating status and working effectively with onshore/offshore managers
  • Troubleshoot day to day technical issues related to test automation
  • Perform code reviews and be a  technical mentor to team members
  • Work with managers to arrive at metrics for measuring the code quality for test automation suite
  • Work closely with scrum masters on sprint plannings and backlog grooming
  • Be a key player for the growth of Veeva Hyderabad by contributing to  recruiting initiatives

• 10+ years of experience in software test automation
  • Strong experience in Java, Object-Oriented Methodologies
  • Strong experience with automated test frameworks (e.g. Selenium, Cucumber)
  • Good working knowledge of CI/CD tools (Git, Jenkins, JIRA)
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum development methodologies (preferably in an onshore /offshore model)
  • Experience working for a product-based company 
  • Excellent team collaboration and effective communication skills 
  • Experience playing a technical mentor role to the team and performing code reviews
  • Experience leading automation projects in a technical role  and actively participated in overall program/project management activities
  • Bachelor's or Masters' Degree in computer engineering, computer science, electrical engineering, or similar
  • Experience with applicable software and programs including  Kotlin, Swift,  JAVA, and React.
  • Experience with Android and Mac platforms
  • Fluency in interfacing and functional testing.
  • A natural problem solver and critical thinker.
  • Comfortable debugging and working with object-oriented programming.
  • Experience in Mobile Testing and Automation – Appium, XCUI, Espresso, KI
  • Experience in Mobile Apps Development (Android/iOS)

• Experience working in the life sciences and health care industry
  • Participation in code hackathons and other open source community activities

• Health insurance with generous coverage limits
  • Fixed cash bonus
  • Allowance for wellness & fitness programs
  • Winter break

As a Lead Product Designer at Veeva, you'll set the design direction for one of our core Vault product areas and help shape how the design team works at its best. We're looking for a seasoned designer who combines strong craft with the judgment and presence to lead — someone who can define the vision for a feature, drive alignment across Product, Engineering, and Design, and raise the quality of the work around them.

data.descriptionBody:
The Role

As a Lead Product Designer at Veeva, you'll set the design direction for one of our core Vault product areas and help shape how the design team works at its best. We're looking for a seasoned designer who combines strong craft with the judgment and presence to lead — someone who can define the vision for a feature, drive alignment across Product, Engineering, and Design, and raise the quality of the work around them.

This role goes beyond execution. You'll be the design authority in your product area, a thought partner to Product and Design leadership, and a meaningful contributor to how we grow and develop our design practice.

This is an incredible opportunity to design products that will impact millions of lives. Your work will be used by the largest global pharmaceutical and biotech companies to bring their medicine, treatments, and products to the doctors and patients who need them.

• Responsible for the UX design strategy for the Veeva Labs platform 
  • Create the design strategy for Veeva labs products
  • Quickly and thoroughly create design artifacts, wireframes, design mockups, and prototypes to effectively conceptualize new initiatives
  • Able to distill complex processes into intuitive UI workflows
  • Participate in discovery and design activities to understand customer needs and shape solutions
  • Partner with Product Management and Engineering on Product initiatives, including ideation, use case definition, design, and bringing products live

• 7+ years of professional experience 
  • HCI or design or related field 
  • A portfolio of shipped work that includes UX work and UI design work 
  • Experience creating and maintaining design systems
  • Experience designing UX and US for SaaS enterprise solutions 
  • Experience mentoring other designers

• Hands-on experience styling web user interfaces with CSS to turn designs into reality
  • Experience with tools such as but not limited to Figma, Confluence, Jira, Slack, Google Suite

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

lists.content:
• Prepare food for no less than 350 guests per service following recipes and portion guidelines set by the Executive Chef and Sous Chef
  • Maintain an organized and efficient workstation during service, ensuring timely preparation and plating of dishes
  • Assist with food prep tasks, such as chopping, marinating, and portioning ingredients, to support daily operations
  • Monitor food quality and presentation, adhering to Veeva standards for taste, temperature, and visual appeal
  • Uphold and adhere to food safety and sanitation practices, including proper storage, rotation (FIFO), and cleaning of equipment and work areas
  • Support for meetings and events, including setup, execution, and breakdown of service
  • Assist with inventory checks, receiving deliveries, and restocking supplies as needed
  • Maintain production facility equipment, reporting any issues to leadership for prompt resolution

• High school diploma or equivalency certificate
  • 2+ years of experience as a line cook or in a similar production facility role
  • Must hold current certification (ServSafe, Food Handlers Card)
  • Ability to carry large heavy items unassisted (up to 50 lbs.)
  • Ability to stand for long periods of time – up to 10 hours a day
  • Ability to perform frequent bending, stooping, and lifting of objects

• Culinary certificate or degree from an accredited program
  • 3+ years of experience in corporate dining, restaurants, or high-volume kitchens
  • Proficiency with production facility equipment (e.g., grills, ovens, knives) and cooking techniques
  • Strong knowledge of food safety and sanitation practices (e.g., ServSafe or equivalent)
  • Experience with diverse cuisines and accommodating dietary restrictions (e.g., vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free)
  • Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment
  • Basic computer skills (e.g., Microsoft Office)
  • Excellent communication skills for coordinating with production facility and service staff

  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

lists.content:
As a Managed Services Consultant, you will ensure the seamless operation and optimization of the Veeva China CRM platform by focusing on three core areas:

  • System Consulting & Client Partnership:
  • Act as a trusted technical consultant for post-implementation system administration and support
  • Communicate with China customers to gather and analyze requirements
  • Interact with Veeva teams (Support, CSM, PMs) on customers’ behalf to drive resolution and improvements
  • Provide best practice sharing and technical feature education to customers
  • System Administration & Execution:
  • Provide Tier 2/3 Incident Troubleshooting and timely resolution
  • Manage and execute the customer-internal System Releases Cycle
  • Design and enable new product features based on customer needs
  • Perform environment management and execute Customer Change Requests (CR)
  • Handle system maintenance, including user, security, territory, and role hierarchy setup
  • Maintain data imports and exports
  • Team Improvement:
  • Grow the capabilities of the team, develop best practices, and create accelerators
  • Be willing to “wear any hat” necessary to make the customer successful

We are looking for a candidate with a strong technical foundation, an analytical mindset, and excellent stakeholder management skills.

  • At least Bachelor’s degree in Life Science, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related degree
  • Strong technical background with a minimum of 5+ years of experience in Python and MySQL
  • Good understanding of software architecture and data models
  • Familiarity with Generative AI tools and CLI assistants (e.g., Gemini, Claude Code, etc.). A solid foundation in basic AI concepts is required
  • Excellent communication skills—ability to deliver formal presentations in workshops and collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders to ensure high-degree of satisfaction
  • Smart, eager to learn new things, and the ability to work independently in a fast-moving environment
  • Proven ability to work under pressure, always committing to the work assigned, and maintaining high accountability
  • Exceptional ability to juggle and prioritize multiple tasks and requests effectively

• Prior experience in customer service, consulting, business analysis (BA), or project management (PM)
  • Direct product knowledge of Veeva China CRM (China SFA)
  • Knowledge and applicable work experience in the Pharmaceutical and Life Sciences

lists.content:
Post-Go-Live Support & Managed Services:
  • Provide ongoing consulting and expert administrative support for multiple Veeva Align clients.
  • Lead quarterly territory alignment and targeting execution, including impact analysis, configuration, communication, and change management.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date roster data and assignments for consumption by CRM and other downstream systems.
  • Maintain large datasets related to territory alignment and roster management, ensuring data quality and managing upstream/downstream integrations.
  • Consult on best practices and overall solutions tailored for each customer's unique Veeva Align requirements.
  • Configure new Veeva Align functionalities and incorporate them into the customers' business processes.
  • Create reports and dashboards.
  • Triage, troubleshoot, and resolve client-reported issues.
    • General:
  • Manage client interactions, set expectations, and provide clear, effective communication.
  • Develop subject matter expertise on the Life Sciences industry and the Veeva solutions, particularly Veeva Align.
  • Grow the capabilities of the team, develop best practices.
  • Contribute to internal initiatives, knowledge sharing, and best practice development.
  • Uphold the Veeva Vision and Values, including “Do the Right Thing” and “Customer Success”.

• Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience required.
  • Ability to work remotely and independently in support of multiple clients.
  • Hands-on experience with data management and/or process analysis. Typically, very skilled with MS Excel for smaller data sets and MS Access or SQL for larger datasets.
  • Ability to learn quickly and adapt to rapidly changing environments.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills are essential as the position is client-facing.
  • Fluent in English.
  • Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in the United States. Veeva Systems does not anticipate providing sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B or TN status) for this employment position.

• Product knowledge: 2+ years of experience with Sales Territory Alignment Software or territory alignments within a CRM (and preferably experience with Salesforce.com).
  • Knowledge and applicable work experience in the Pharmaceutical / Life Sciences industry.
  • Business knowledge for sales and marketing territory alignments and sales cycle planning.
  • Understanding of how Master Data Management systems work.
  • Exposure to the following technical disciplines: Web Services, ETL, SQL, Force.com.
  • Consulting experience.
  • Experience with other Veeva applications (e.g., Veeva CRM, Vault CRM, Veeva Network MDM).

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $70,000 - $140,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

lists.content:
• Provide post-go-live consulting and administrative support for multiple clients
  • Configuration enhancement for live applications – business process, taxonomy and metadata, new features & functionality, security, notifications, etc.
  • Bulk import/export/updates of content and data
  • Recommendations on application features, use, and best practices
  • Maintenance of production and sandbox environments 
  • Creation of reports and dashboards

• 3+ years experience configuring/supporting/implementing content management software or related services delivery
  • Customer service or consulting experience

  • Experience managing clients requests and setting expectations
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

lists.content:
• Support the Project Manager with activities through Start-up
  • Be the primary point of contact through Maintenance and Closeout of a project
  • Perform skilled duties such as creating, reviewing, coordinating, and managing a variety of deliverables for assigned projects
  • Facilitate and troubleshoot the myriad issues associated with managing the delivery of complex systems and projects
  • Respond to inquiries about projects
  • Lead various project status and review meetings

• Two+ year degree or equivalent experience
  • One+ years of experience in a customer support role
  • One+ years of experience in a regulated industry
  • One+ years of RTSM/IRT experience
  • Microsoft Office experience (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)

• Zendesk
  • Google Docs

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Total compensation: 36,000 - 55,000 EUR
  • The total compensation range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential total compensation range for this role. Please note that actual total compensation may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position's total compensation may be composed of other types of compensation, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

As part of Veeva, the Crossix team offers the agility of a high-growth team with the stability of a global leader.

lists.content:
• You will be the primary point of contact for internal and external teams for all things data. Your goal is to understand, leverage, and grow Veeva's data network by working closely with commercial, product, and technical groups. Responsibilities include:
  • Evaluate data partnership opportunities and present findings and recommendations to leadership
  • Design, implement, and execute a data strategy to enable dataset valuation, assessment, and acquisition
  • Understand product roadmaps and planned features to ensure data network support for novel data types
  • Structure and negotiate all external partnerships, including all contracting and renewal negotiations
  • Advocate for Veeva's positions externally and ensure commercial and technical project feasibility
  • Build strong relationships and manage multiple teams, projects, and timelines

• Work Experience: 3+ years in finance, operations, development or strategy in life sciences, technology, financial service, healthcare or advisory
  • Quantitative Skills: assess large datasets, create forecasts, calculate diverse business metrics (including pricing/other commercial measures)
  • Project Management: lead cross-department projects in an organized and efficient fashion
  • Business fundamentals: Entrepreneurial, problem solver, critical thinker, strong attention to detail, curious and eager to learn
  • Communication: Great with people: teamwork, clear and actionable feedback, stakeholder management, and relationship-building

• Foundational knowledge of the healthcare ecosystem, including how data flows and the key players
  • Prior experience in health tech or an equivalent data-focused environment
  • Functional understanding of healthcare privacy, regulations, and commercial data applications
  • Previous experience leading partner negotiations, not just data sales
  • Familiarity with existing syndicated data products and data aggregators
  • Experienced in contracting paperwork and processes and working closely with legal
  • Lead negotiations by thinking quickly, creatively, and strategically
  • Executive presence, including presentation skills and comfort interfacing with senior leaders

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.
  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • If moving to the interview stage, our process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A personality assessment
    3. A practical case exercise
    4. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $80,000 - $200,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

Crossix is positioned at the center of big data, innovative technology, media, and life sciences. Our mission is to empower life sciences companies with the data and insights they need to drive DTC and HCP marketing effectiveness and, ultimately, better patient outcomes. As part of Veeva, the Crossix team offers the agility of a high-growth team with the stability of a global leader.

You will play a critical role in supporting our Client Services team by maintaining close, collaborative partnerships with media publishers to ensure seamless execution for our mutual clients. lists.content:
• Publisher Support & Advocacy: Lead as the primary point of contact for media partners, ensuring they are fully supported to meet the needs of mutual customers and enabling the ultimate success of existing partnerships
  • Client Services Collaboration: Work in lockstep with the Client Services team to resolve partner-related hurdles and ensure successful project delivery
  • Inbound Management: Identify and evaluate inbound partnership opportunities, providing recommendations to leadership based on strategic fit and technical feasibility
  • Contracting & Process Management: Execute partnership paperwork, renewals, and legal processes in close coordination with legal and technical teams
  • Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships across multiple teams and stakeholders by effectively communicating and managing project timelines, efficiently troubleshooting technical challenges, and executing with operational excellence
  • Strategic Alignment: Understand product roadmaps to ensure the publisher network supports evolving data types and Crossix features

• Work Experience: 3+ years in media, adtech, strategy, or operations within life sciences or technology
  • Media & Health Tech Expertise: Foundational knowledge of the healthcare media ecosystem, including data flows between media owners and measurement providers
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Functional understanding of healthcare privacy regulations (e.g., HIPAA) and their application in media and commercial data
  • Contracting Experience: Proven experience managing contracting paperwork and working closely with legal teams to finalize partnership agreements
  • Negotiation & Strategy: Ability to lead partner discussions by thinking quickly, creatively, and strategically to solve for mutual customer success
  • Executive Presence: Strong presentation skills and comfort interfacing with senior leaders at major publishing and media organizations
  • Quantitative Skills: Ability to assess datasets and calculate business metrics related to media performance
  • Communication: Exceptional relationship-building skills and the ability to provide clear, actionable feedback to internal and external stakeholders

• Industry Tools: Familiarity with existing syndicated data products and data aggregators within the healthcare space
  • Technical Adaptability: Experience working in a data-focused environment or with health tech platforms
  • Problem Solving: A proven track record of being an entrepreneurial problem solver and critical thinker
  • Advanced Project Management: Experience leading complex, cross-departmental projects in a highly organized and efficient fashion

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $100,000 - $150,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

lists.content:
• Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Product Support Engineers to deliver world-class customer support
  • Hire, onboard, and retain top technical talent in the region
  • Manage, mentor, and grow a team of Product Support Engineers focused on delivering high-quality customer support
  • Drive team engagement and development
  • Oversee daily operations, ticket handling, and SLA compliance to ensure timely and effective customer issue resolution
  • Act as an escalation point for complex customer issues and collaborate cross-functionally with Product Management and Engineering
  • Build strong relationships with customers and internal partners to ensure alignment and customer satisfaction
  • Coordinate with global peers in North America, Europe, and Asia for consistent processes and support excellence
  • Support hiring and onboarding of new engineers to build long-term local capability

  • 3+ years of proven experience managing or leading technical support teams
  • Demonstrated ability to manage escalations and customer communications effectively

  • Experience with enterprise ticketing systems (Zendesk, Jira Service Management, or similar)
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, both verbal and written
  • Fluent in Japanese and proficient in English (both verbal and written)
  • Based in Tokyo, Japan, and eligible to work in Japan

• Korean language proficiency
  • Experience with Veeva Vault or other SaaS enterprise applications
  • Knowledge of Salesforce, Zendesk, Jira, or Confluence
  • Background in life sciences or other regulated industries

The Role
Our vision for Link is to become the global leader in deep data for life sciences. It helps pharma professionals to find the right people for, e.g., clinical trials, education programs, or advisory boards. This streamlined access helps to reduce the time-to-market of important drugs, conduct trials with the most relevant experts in the respective field, and spread information about new treatments to key people in the life science community. You can read more about Veeva Link on our product pages at https://www.veeva.com/products/veeva-link/.
 
We are seeking an experienced People Manager to lead one of our Data Operations teams. This role is pivotal in ensuring the efficient and high-quality delivery of data operations that support our product development. You are part of the Data Operations leadership team and responsible for a team of 5 Veevans and multiple hundred curators.
 
You know how to lead an engaged and high-performing team. Building a personal connection with your team and holding them accountable comes naturally to you. You are experienced in driving process improvements and skilled in data-driven decision-making. You are hands-on. Don’t shy away from analyzing the data for your decisions yourself. Based on your understanding of the value a product adds to customers, you can shape operations and be a sparring partner to product managers.
 
You will represent Data Operations in a cross-functional product team, collaborating closely with Product Management, Data Engineering, and Data Science.
 
We care about a great cultural fit. You enjoy working at speed in multi-cultural teams. We are the optimal fit if you are excited about data, Life Sciences, and working for a fast-growing tech company.

data.descriptionPlain:
Veeva Systems is building the industry cloud for Life Sciences to help companies work in a more efficient and connected way. Learn more about our products, vision and values, and status as a public benefit corporation on our website.
 
Crossix is positioned at the center of big data, innovative technology, media, and life sciences.  Our mission is to empower life sciences companies with the data and insights they need to drive patient and provider marketing effectiveness and, ultimately, better patient outcomes.  As part of Veeva, the Crossix team offers the agility of a high-growth team with the stability of a global leader.
 
The Role
We are hiring recent university graduates to grow the next generation of analytics services professionals through our Analytics Development Program. 
 What this role is (and isn’t):
What it IS: A data-driven, customer-facing role where you'll work directly with media agencies and pharmaceutical brand teams.  You will use the Crossix Measurement Suite to help the world’s leading pharmaceutical brands optimize their marketing, ultimately helping them deliver life-changing treatments to patients more effectively.
What it IS NOT: This is not a sales role. You will not be cold-calling, hunting leads, or chasing sales quotas. It is also not a back-end technical programming position.
 This role is part of Generation Veeva, and as such you can expect:
A “learn by doing” environment with challenging and impactful work, where you will be expected to learn quickly and deliver early
A collaborative work environment where you will work closely with many levels of our team, from other early-career professionals through senior leaders
Mentorship and continuous professional development opportunities, aiding in your immediate and long-term success at Veeva
The anticipated start date is July 2027.
The Analytics Development Program offers two distinct paths. Please review our other track, the Marketing Data Analyst role, to choose the best fit for your skills and interests.
We welcome you to apply to all roles that align with your skills and interests. See all open opportunities here: Generation Veeva Careers

lists.content:
• Translate Data into Strategy: Partner with experienced team members to translate complex healthcare data into compelling, high-impact stories. You will be responsible for providing strategic recommendations that directly influence the multi-million dollar marketing investments of leading global pharmaceutical brands.
  • Consult Directly with Clients: Serve as a strategic advisor to media agencies and pharma brand teams. You will quickly become an expert on the Crossix Measurement Suite, helping clients interpret their data, answer critical business questions, and maximize the value of our platform.
  • Own Your Deliverables: Manage end-to-end client workstreams. In our fast-paced environment where high-performance is rewarded, you will actively manage deliverables, solve real-world problems, and rapidly evolve into a future leader on the Crossix team.

lists.text: REQUIREMENTS | We are looking for graduates who meet the following requirements:
lists.content:
• Analytical & Strategic Mindset: Exceptional problem-solving skills and the ability to translate quantitative findings into qualitative business recommendations.
  • High Drive & Performance: A self-starter with a track record of excellence who thrives in a demanding and dynamic environment, and is hungry for rapid professional growth.
  • Consultative Communication & Storytelling: Ability to build strong, trusting client relationships and present complex ideas clearly to diverse audiences, from technical analysts to senior executives.
  • Academic Excellence: Bachelor’s degree (any major) with a 3.0 – 4.0 GPA, demonstrating the intellectual curiosity, time management, and work ethic necessary for a high-performance consulting career.
  • Experience Level: This role is designed for upcoming or recent graduates with 0–2 years of post-grad full-time work experience. 
  • Location & Presence: You live within about a 45-60 minute commute of our NYC office (or plan to be by your start date) and look forward to collaborating with the team on-site 4 days a week.
  • Unwavering Integrity: Veeva is a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) and a “do the right thing” company. We hold ourselves to high ethical standards and expect honesty and integrity from every team member.

lists.text: THE PROCESS | Our process is different from most. It is designed to be fast, efficient and respectful. Here are the steps:
lists.content:
• Application & Assessment: You submit your resume, responses to a few short application questions, and complete a brief online assessment.
  • Application Response (Within 1 Week): We review every application thoroughly. Within about one week of submission, we will notify you via email whether we’d like to move you to the next stage.
  • Initial Interview: You will participate in a 60-minute job interview with a senior member of our team.
  • Case Interview: If we proceed following your initial interview, you will complete a strategic case exercise. You will be given one full week to prepare for the case.
  • Final Decision (Within 1 Week): Within about one week of completing your case exercise, we will either extend an official offer or let you know that we are not moving forward.
  • Your Decision (2 Weeks): If extended an offer, you will have two weeks to make your final decision. If you accept, we will hold a spot for you and expect you to show up on your start date. Accepting an offer and continuing to interview for other roles would be an ethical violation in our view.
• Starting base pay: $82,500

Crossix is positioned at the center of big data, innovative technology, media, and life sciences.  Our mission is to empower life sciences companies with the data and insights they need to drive patient and provider marketing effectiveness and, ultimately, better patient outcomes.  As part of Veeva, the Crossix team offers the agility of a high-growth team with the stability of a global leader.
 
The Role
We are hiring recent university graduates to grow the next generation of data analysts through our Analytics Development Program.
 
The Marketing Data Analyst (MDA) is a member of the internal analytics team focused on product analytics.  This team’s primary function is to produce the analytical reports that are incorporated into Veeva Crossix products and shared with customers.

 What this role is (and isn’t):
What it IS: A data analytics role. You will be part of our internal analytics team, focusing on backend report generation, quality control, and pressure-testing results. Using SQL, Excel, and our proprietary coding language, you will link marketing data to health data, transforming large datasets into core analytical reports embedded in Veeva Crossix products. Your work will be used to generate the insights our customers use to make business decisions.
 
What it IS NOT: This is not a client-facing consulting role. If you want to spend your days in external client meetings, presenting slide decks, and advising on marketing strategies, check out the Client Services Associate track. This is also not a software engineering role - your focus is on data logic, manipulation, and insights, not building software architecture.

This role is part of Generation Veeva, and as such you can expect:
A “learn by doing” environment with challenging and impactful work, where you will be expected to learn quickly and deliver early
A collaborative work environment where you will work closely with many levels of our team, from other early-career professionals through senior leaders
Mentorship and continuous professional development opportunities, aiding in your immediate and long-term success at Veeva
The anticipated start date is July 2027.
