lists.content:
• Produce Analytics Reports: Own the end-to-end execution, rigorous quality control, and timely delivery of high-value, recurring analytical reports across a large portfolio.
  • Link Complex Datasets: Connect marketing exposure data to massive, transactional healthcare datasets. Your data manipulation will provide the analytical foundation that helps pharmaceutical and life sciences companies optimize their marketing efforts and ultimately improve patient outcomes.
  • Formulate Analytical Hypotheses: Transform complex client questions into hypotheses that are testable using SQL, Excel, and Crossix’s proprietary analytical coding language.
  • Partner Internally with Client Services: Communicate the technical results and methodology of marketing campaign analyses to our Client Services teams, acting as the subject-matter expert on the underlying data logic.
  • Master Modern Data Tools: Leverage a robust toolkit including SQL, advanced Excel, data visualization suites, and internal platforms to clean, manipulate, and present data effectively.

lists.text: REQUIREMENTS | We are looking for graduates who meet the following requirements:
lists.content:
• Technical Foundation: Intermediate proficiency in SQL, Python, or a comparable coding language. You have a natural comfort with data structures and a knack for logical, step-by-step problem-solving.
  • High Drive & Performance: A self-starter with a track record of excellence who thrives in a demanding and dynamic environment, and is hungry for rapid professional growth.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: Exceptional precision and a commitment to rigorous quality control. You take pride in catching small errors before they impact the final product.
  • Effective Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively share technical insights and methodology with our internal client services teams.
  • Academic Excellence: Bachelor’s degree (any major) with a 3.0 – 4.0 GPA, demonstrating the intellectual curiosity, time management, and work ethic necessary for a high-performance analytics career.
  • Experience Level: This role is designed for upcoming or recent graduates with 0–2 years of post-grad full-time work experience. 
  • Location & Presence: You live within about a 45-60 minute commute of our NYC office (or plan to be by your start date) and look forward to collaborating with the team on-site 4 days a week.
  • Unwavering Integrity: Veeva is a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) and a “do the right thing” company. We hold ourselves to high ethical standards and expect honesty and integrity from every team member.

lists.text: THE PROCESS | Our process is different from most. It is designed to be fast, efficient and respectful. Here are the steps:
lists.content:
• Application & Assessment: You submit your resume, responses to a few short application questions, and complete a brief online assessment.
  • Application Response (Within 1 Week): We review every application thoroughly. Within about one week of submission, we will notify you via email whether we’d like to move you to the next stage.
  • Initial Interview: You will participate in a 60-minute job interview with a senior member of our team.
  • Case Interview: If we proceed following your initial interview, you will complete an analytics case exercise. This will be a live demonstration of your skills, with no prework required.
  • Final Decision (Within 1 Week): Within about one week of completing your case exercise, we will either extend an official offer or let you know that we are not moving forward.
  • Your Decision (2 Weeks): If extended an offer, you will have two weeks to make your final decision. If you accept, we will hold a spot for you and expect you to show up on your start date. Accepting an offer and continuing to interview for other roles would be an ethical violation in our view.
• Starting base pay: $82,500

Veeva Systems is building the industry cloud for Life Sciences to help companies work in a more efficient and connected way. Learn more about our products, vision and values, and status as a public benefit corporation on our website.
 
Consulting is changing, and we’re not like other firms. Veeva Business Consulting was launched in 2019 and has grown quickly and organically to a global organization of over 400 people. Our team is focused on making the Life Sciences industry more efficient and effective through software, data, and consulting working together.
 
We expect significant growth in Business Consulting as we look towards 2030, and are looking for great people to make it happen.
 
The Role
We are hiring high potential people who are early in their careers and want to pivot into Life Sciences Consulting through our Master Class Program.  
 
Breaking into business consulting after starting your career down a different path can be hard.  As an alternative to an MBA, this program is intentionally designed as the entry path to shape experienced professionals as Business Consultants capable of making an impact for the Life Sciences industry.  
 
Early in the program, you will own key workstreams on customer-facing engagements to create high-impact business solutions while collaborating with team members at all levels of Veeva. You will be given the tools and resources to accelerate your consulting skills development.
   
Our Business Consulting team builds effective business and operational improvement strategies powered by Veeva’s unique industry insights, and market-leading technology. Our offerings are focused on speeding drug development, launching treatments more effectively, and shaping the best engagement for our customers.
 
If you’re graduating with an advanced degree, have 3-5 years of industry experience, or have served your country and are excited to pivot your career into consulting for a critical industry, Master Class is for you.
  
The anticipated start date is September 2026.

lists.content:
• Support and deliver all components of customer engagements (e.g., customer communications, workshops, stakeholder interviews, process and data analysis, managing timelines)  
  • Collaborate with Business Consultants to create deliverables that optimize customer operating and engagement models, processes, and business performance
  • Leverage Veeva’s software and data to pull through tangible business and operational solutions

lists.text: REQUIREMENTS | We are looking for people who meet the following requirements:
lists.content:
• 3-5 years of experience from one of the following paths: Life Sciences Industry experience; Advanced Degree (PhD, PharmD, MD); Other non-Consulting work experience; or Veteran/Military Service
  • Desire to work within an intense, challenging program and environment 
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • A problem-solving mindset: anticipating issues early, analyzing, and proactively finding solutions
  • A process-driven person who loves digging into operations, numbers, and other data to find opportunities for improvement
  • High work ethic. Veeva is a hard-working company
  • High integrity and honesty. Veeva is a PBC and a “do the right thing” company, and we expect that from all employees
  • Willingness to travel up to 20% of your time per year. Travel varies per customer engagement, coworking, internal meetings, and events with your team

lists.text: THE PROCESS | Our process is different than most. It is designed to be fast, efficient and respectful. Here are the steps:
lists.content:
• You submit your resume, short cover letter of questions, and take a personality test
  • Within one week we will notify you via email if we would like to go to the next step or not
  • The next step is a 45-minute interview with the Executive Leader of the practice, followed by a case exercise. You will have one week to prepare for the case exercise.
  • Within one week after this step, we will give you an offer, or let you know that we do not wish to move forward
  • You will have two weeks to accept our offer or not. If you accept, we will hold a spot for you and expect you to show up on your start date. Accepting an offer and continuing to interview would be an ethical violation in our view

• Starting Salary: $130,000
  • After one year, if you perform well, you will receive a salary increase and be granted equity

Consulting is changing, and we’re not like other firms. Veeva Business Consulting was launched in 2019 and has grown quickly and organically to a global organization of over 400 people. Our team is focused on making the Life Sciences industry more efficient and effective through software, data, and consulting working together.

We expect significant growth in Business Consulting as we look towards 2030, and are looking for great people to make it happen.

The Role

We are hiring high potential people who are early in their careers and want to pivot into Life Sciences Consulting through our Master Class Program.  

Breaking into business consulting after starting your career down a different path can be hard. As an alternative to an MBA, this program is intentionally designed as the entry path to shape experienced professionals as Business Consultants capable of making an impact for the Life Sciences industry.  

Early in the program, you will own key workstreams on customer-facing engagements to create high-impact business solutions while collaborating with team members at all levels of Veeva. You will be given the tools and resources to accelerate your consulting skills development.   

Our Business Consulting team builds effective business and operational improvement strategies powered by Veeva’s unique industry insights, and market-leading technology. Our offerings are focused on speeding drug development, launching treatments more effectively, and shaping the best engagement for our customers.

If you’re graduating with an advanced degree or have 3-5 years of industry experience and are excited to pivot your career into consulting for a critical industry, Master Class is for you.

The anticipated start date is September 2026.

lists.content:
• Support and deliver all components of customer engagements (e.g., customer communications, workshops, stakeholder interviews, process and data analysis, managing timelines)  
  • Collaborate with Business Consultants to create deliverables that optimize customer operating and engagement models, processes, and business performance
  • Leverage Veeva’s software and data to pull through tangible business and operational solutions

lists.text: REQUIREMENTS | We are looking for people who meet the following requirements:
lists.content:
• 3-5 years of experience from one of the following paths: Life Sciences Industry experience; Advanced Degree (PhD, PharmD, MD); or Other non-Consulting work experience
  • Desire to work within an intense, challenging program and environment 
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • A problem-solving mindset: anticipating issues early, analyzing, and proactively finding solutions
  • A process-driven person who loves digging into operations, numbers, and other data to find opportunities for improvement
  • High work ethic. Veeva is a hard-working company
  • High integrity and honesty. Veeva is a PBC and a “do the right thing” company, and we expect that from all employees
  • Willingness to travel up to 20% of your time per year. Travel varies per customer engagement, coworking, internal meetings, and events with your team

lists.text: THE PROCESS | Our process is different than most. It is designed to be fast, efficient and respectful. Here are the steps:
lists.content:
• You submit your resume, short cover letter of questions, and take a personality test
  • Within one week we will notify you via email if we would like to go to the next step or not
  • The next step is a 45-minute interview with the Executive Leader of the practice, followed by a case exercise. You will have one week to prepare for the case exercise.
  • Within one week after this step, we will give you an offer, or let you know that we do not wish to move forward
  • You will have two weeks to accept our offer or not. If you accept, we will hold a spot for you and expect you to show up on your start date. Accepting an offer and continuing to interview would be an ethical violation in our view

• Starting Salary: 60,000 EUR
  • After one year, if you perform well, you will receive a significant salary increase and be granted equity

lists.content:
• Support and deliver all components of customer engagements (e.g., customer communications, workshops, stakeholder interviews, process and data analysis, managing timelines)  
  • Collaborate with Business Consultants to create deliverables that optimize customer operating and engagement models, processes, and business performance
  • Leverage Veeva’s software and data to pull through tangible business and operational solutions

lists.text: REQUIREMENTS | We are looking for people who meet the following requirements:
lists.content:
• 3-5 years of experience from one of the following paths: Life Sciences Industry experience; Advanced Degree (PhD, PharmD, MD); or Other non-Consulting work experience
  • Desire to work within an intense, challenging program and environment 
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • A problem-solving mindset: anticipating issues early, analyzing, and proactively finding solutions
  • A process-driven person who loves digging into operations, numbers, and other data to find opportunities for improvement
  • High work ethic. Veeva is a hard-working company
  • High integrity and honesty. Veeva is a PBC and a “do the right thing” company, and we expect that from all employees
  • Willingness to travel up to 20% of your time per year. Travel varies per customer engagement, coworking, internal meetings, and events with your team

lists.text: THE PROCESS | Our process is different than most. It is designed to be fast, efficient and respectful. Here are the steps:
lists.content:
• You submit your resume, short cover letter of questions, and take a personality test
  • Within one week we will notify you via email if we would like to go to the next step or not
  • The next step is a 45-minute interview with the Executive Leader of the practice, followed by a case exercise. You will have one week to prepare for the case exercise
  • Within one week after this step, we will give you an offer, or let you know that we do not wish to move forward
  • You will have two weeks to accept our offer or not. If you accept, we will hold a spot for you and expect you to show up on your start date. Accepting an offer and continuing to interview would be an ethical violation in our view

lists.content:
• Support and deliver all components of customer engagements (e.g., customer communications, workshops, stakeholder interviews, process and data analysis, managing timelines)  
  • Collaborate with Business Consultants to create deliverables that optimize customer operating and engagement models, processes, and business performance
  • Leverage Veeva’s software and data to pull through tangible business and operational solutions

lists.text: REQUIREMENTS | We are looking for people who meet the following requirements:
lists.content:
• 3-5 years of experience from one of the following paths: Life Sciences Industry experience; Advanced Degree (PhD, PharmD, MD); or Other non-Consulting work experience
  • Desire to work within an intense, challenging program and environment 
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • A problem-solving mindset: anticipating issues early, analyzing, and proactively finding solutions
  • A process-driven person who loves digging into operations, numbers, and other data to find opportunities for improvement
  • High work ethic. Veeva is a hard-working company
  • High integrity and honesty. Veeva is a PBC and a “do the right thing” company, and we expect that from all employees
  • Willingness to travel up to 20% of your time per year. Travel varies per customer engagement, coworking, internal meetings, and events with your team

lists.text: THE PROCESS | Our process is different than most. It is designed to be fast, efficient and respectful. Here are the steps:
lists.content:
1. You submit your resume, short cover letter of questions, and take a personality test
  2. Within one week we will notify you via email if we would like to go to the next step or not
  3. The next step is a 45-minute interview with the Executive Leader of the practice, followed by a case exercise. You will have one week to prepare for the case exercise.
  4. Within one week after this step, we will give you an offer, or let you know that we do not wish to move forward
  5. You will have two weeks to accept our offer or not. If you accept, we will hold a spot for you and expect you to show up on your start date. Accepting an offer and continuing to interview would be an ethical violation in our view

• Starting Salary: 60,000 EUR
  • After one year, if you perform well, you will receive a significant salary increase and be granted equity

lists.content:
• Support and deliver all components of customer engagements (e.g., customer communications, workshops, stakeholder interviews, process and data analysis, managing timelines)  
  • Collaborate with Business Consultants to create deliverables that optimize customer operating and engagement models, processes, and business performance
  • Leverage Veeva’s software and data to pull through tangible business and operational solutions

lists.text: REQUIREMENTS | We are looking for people who meet the following requirements:
lists.content:
• 3-5 years of experience from one of the following paths: Life Sciences Industry experience; Advanced Degree (PhD, PharmD, MD); or Other non-Consulting work experience
  • Desire to work within an intense, challenging program and environment 
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • A problem-solving mindset: anticipating issues early, analyzing, and proactively finding solutions
  • A process-driven person who loves digging into operations, numbers, and other data to find opportunities for improvement
  • High work ethic. Veeva is a hard-working company
  • High integrity and honesty. Veeva is a PBC and a “do the right thing” company, and we expect that from all employees
  • Willingness to travel up to 20% of your time per year. Travel varies per customer engagement, coworking, internal meetings, and events with your team

lists.text: THE PROCESS | Our process is different than most. It is designed to be fast, efficient and respectful. Here are the steps:
lists.content:
1. You submit your resume, short cover letter of questions, and take a personality test
  2. Within one week we will notify you via email if we would like to go to the next step or not
  3. The next step is a 45-minute interview with the Executive Leader of the practice, followed by a case exercise. You will have one week to prepare for the case exercise
  4. Within one week after this step, we will give you an offer, or let you know that we do not wish to move forward
  5. You will have two weeks to accept our offer or not. If you accept, we will hold a spot for you and expect you to show up on your start date. Accepting an offer and continuing to interview would be an ethical violation in our view

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
 
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
 
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
 
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.


The Role
This role is a 12-month fixed term maternity cover, starting on October 1st 2026.
 
As Field Marketing Manager / Senior Manager at Veeva, you have the opportunity to learn from a high-caliber team at a high-growth company. You can make a real impact across many areas, including demand generation, events, digital marketing, sales enablement, and communications. If you are results-driven, resourceful, and strive for excellence, this could be the perfect role for you.

The Role

This role is a 12-month fixed term maternity cover, starting on October 1st 2026.
 
As Field Marketing Manager / Senior Manager at Veeva, you have the opportunity to learn from a high-caliber team at a high-growth company. You can make a real impact across many areas, including demand generation, events, digital marketing, sales enablement, and communications. If you are results-driven, resourceful, and strive for excellence, this could be the perfect role for you.

lists.content:
• Develop and execute field marketing plans, working with key stakeholders to define the goals, strategy, content, tactics, and KPIs for the year
  • Plan and execute virtual and in-person events from planning, preparation to execution, and reporting
  • Build integrated marketing campaigns utilizing various channels, content types, and tactics, including email marketing (Marketo), social, digital advertising, sales enablement, etc.
  • Work with internal teams such as product marketing, creative services, content, product, communications, and digital teams to deliver field marketing programs for both customers and prospects
  • Support the execution and optimization of outreach programs to engage current and prospective customers, leveraging LinkedIn, media publications, and other channels
  • Help organize the annual Veeva Summit, including logistics, customer communities, internal and external communications, event app management, and reporting
  • Own the weekly and monthly marketing program reporting and metrics for your area, leveraging the data to drive decision-making

• 4+ years of relevant B2B marketing experience (5+ years for Senior Manager)
  • Self-directed and able to manage multiple stakeholders, priorities, and projects
  • Exceptional communication, writing, and organizational skills
  • Well organized with very high attention to detail
  • Proficient in delivering content via social media tools such as LinkedIn
  • Growth-minded and a team player

• Experience developing and executing account-based marketing programs
  • Experience with customer retention, cross-selling, and upselling campaigns
  • Experience using Marketo
  • Life sciences industry experiences a plus, but not essential

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Incredible support from the wider team and a best-in-class tech stack to help you be successful in your role
  • Work anywhere policy – Yes, you can utilize our office spaces or work remotely when you need to
  • Don't just take our word for it; apply here and find out more!

• Total compensation: 50,000 - 100,000 EUR
  • The total compensation range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential total compensation range for this role. Please note that actual total compensation may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position's total compensation may be composed of other types of compensation, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

The Role
Veeva Network is a comprehensive Master Data Management (MDM) solution that helps life sciences companies manage critical product and customer data. Veeva OpenData is a customer reference database offering access to more than 16 million healthcare professional and organization profiles.
Our solutions enable faster go-to-market and more informed customer engagement across the commercial landscape.
 
As our client base continues to expand, we are seeking a highly skilled MDM Technical Architect to lead complex enterprise-level implementations across Veeva Network and OpenData.
You will work closely with commercial life sciences customers to design, implement, and optimize robust MDM architectures. This role requires a blend of strategic thinking, deep technical expertise, and strong communication skills to guide customers through their data transformation journey.

lists.content:
• Design and deliver MDM architectures using Veeva Network, covering data modeling, integration, governance, and data quality
  • Own project delivery for enterprise clients, from initial scoping through deployment and post-go-live support
  • Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to capture requirements and translate them into scalable solutions
  • Create detailed technical documentation, including data models, architecture diagrams, and integration specifications
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to internal teams and implementation partners
  • Support change management activities to drive adoption of MDM best practices
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with customer stakeholders
  • Contribute to internal initiatives to continuously improve service quality and delivery frameworks

• 5+ years of experience in MDM, data integration, and data governance within complex enterprise environments
  • Strong consulting background with proven ability to architect and implement MDM solutions
  • Hands-on experience with platforms such as Veeva Network, Informatica MDM, Reltio, or similar
  • Deep expertise in data modeling, data quality, integration technologies (SOAP/REST), and governance methodologies
  • Familiarity with CRM ecosystems and enterprise data domains (e.g., customer, HCP/HCO, product)
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to engage both technical and business audiences
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment across multiple assignments
  • Willingness to travel as needed

• Experience working in the Pharmaceutical, Biotech, or Consumer Health sectors
  • Familiarity with OpenData and integration of third-party reference data
  • Certification from a CRM or MDM software vendor
  • Hands-on experience with data warehousing concepts, SQL, ETL tools, or web services technologies
  • Exposure to integration frameworks, user authentication methods, or batch data processes
  • Additional European language(s)

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Annual allocations for charitable contributions
  • Fitness reimbursement
  • Work anywhere

  • Own project delivery for enterprise clients, from initial scoping through deployment and post-go-live support
  • Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to capture requirements and translate them into scalable solutions
  • Create detailed technical documentation, including data models, architecture diagrams, and integration specifications
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to internal teams and implementation partners
  • Support change management activities to drive adoption of MDM best practices
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with customer stakeholders
  • Contribute to internal initiatives to continuously improve service quality and delivery frameworks
    •

• 5+ years of experience in MDM, data integration, and data governance within complex enterprise environments
  • Strong consulting background with proven ability to architect and implement MDM solutions
  • Hands-on experience with platforms such as Veeva Network, Informatica MDM, Reltio, or similar
  • Deep expertise in data modeling, data quality, integration technologies (SOAP/REST), and governance methodologies
  • Familiarity with CRM ecosystems and enterprise data domains (e.g., customer, HCP/HCO, product)
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to engage both technical and business audiences
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment across multiple assignments
  • Willingness to travel as needed

• Experience working in the Pharmaceutical, Biotech, or Consumer Health sectors
  • Familiarity with OpenData and integration of third-party reference data
  • Certification from a CRM or MDM software vendor
  • Hands-on experience with data warehousing concepts, SQL, ETL tools, or web services technologies
  • Exposure to integration frameworks, user authentication methods, or batch data processes
  • Additional European language(s)

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Annual allocations for charitable contributions
  • Fitness reimbursement
  • Work anywhere

• Total compensation: 60,000 - 105,000 EUR
  • The total compensation range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential total compensation range for this role. Please note that actual total compensation may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position's total compensation may be composed of other types of compensation, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

data.descriptionBody:
The Role

Veeva Network is a comprehensive Master Data Management (MDM) solution that helps life sciences companies manage critical product and customer data. Veeva OpenData is a customer reference database offering access to more than 16 million healthcare professional and organization profiles.
Our solutions enable faster go-to-market and more informed customer engagement across the commercial landscape.
 
As our client base continues to expand, we are seeking a highly skilled MDM Technical Architect to lead complex enterprise-level implementations across Veeva Network and OpenData.
You will work closely with commercial life sciences customers to design, implement, and optimize robust MDM architectures. This role requires a blend of strategic thinking, deep technical expertise, and strong communication skills to guide customers through their data transformation journey.

The Role
Are you ready to be the architect of digital transformation for the world's leading life sciences companies? As a Migration Consultant within our dynamic EU Professional Services group, you will lead critical migration solutions for our clients in the Life Sciences industry. You will be instrumental in deploying Veeva Development and Quality Cloud solutions, helping pharmaceutical development companies transition to the next generation of digital excellence.
 
This is more than a consulting role, it's a chance to own the migration journey. You will serve as the primary subject matter expert, leveraging your deep knowledge of Vault API, migration tools, and platform best practices to ensure a seamless and successful transition. You will be a vital customer advocate, partnering across internal teams (Product, Sales, Strategy) to shape future solutions and drive continuous success.
 
This is a remote position within the EU/UK. We encourage qualified, EU/UK-based candidates to apply. Ability to travel up to 20% is required for client engagement (proximity to an airport is helpful).
 
Veeva Systems does not anticipate providing sponsorship for employment visa status for this employment position.

data.descriptionBody:
The Role

Are you ready to be the architect of digital transformation for the world's leading life sciences companies? As a Migration Consultant within our dynamic EU Professional Services group, you will lead critical migration solutions for our clients in the Life Sciences industry. You will be instrumental in deploying Veeva Development and Quality Cloud solutions, helping pharmaceutical development companies transition to the next generation of digital excellence.
 
This is more than a consulting role, it's a chance to own the migration journey. You will serve as the primary subject matter expert, leveraging your deep knowledge of Vault API, migration tools, and platform best practices to ensure a seamless and successful transition. You will be a vital customer advocate, partnering across internal teams (Product, Sales, Strategy) to shape future solutions and drive continuous success.
 
This is a remote position within the EU/UK. We encourage qualified, EU/UK-based candidates to apply. Ability to travel up to 20% is required for client engagement (proximity to an airport is helpful).
 
Veeva Systems does not anticipate providing sponsorship for employment visa status for this employment position.

lists.content:
• Lead with expertise in Vault R&D migrations — guiding the seamless transfer of document content and object data from legacy systems into Vault
  • Advise and partner with customers throughout the extract, transform, and load (ETL) process to ensure accuracy, efficiency, and compliance
  • Contribute to the growth of the team by sharing best practices, lessons learned, and proven methodologies
  • Drive innovation in migration tooling and process design, providing direction on ETL tool enhancements and implementation strategy
  • Support delivery excellence by assisting in project scoping and estimating for the Vault R&D product suite to ensure accurate planning and smooth execution

• 5+ years of demonstrable experience in large-scale document/content migration (ECM systems like Documentum, OpenText, SharePoint, etc.) OR 5+ years of enterprise database migration (ERP/CRM systems like SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, etc.)
  • 3+ years of success in a customer-facing technical consulting role, clearly demonstrating a 'work ethic' and commitment to client outcomes
  • Proven ability to advise and communicate technical strategy to all levels, from technical teams to senior management and executives
  • Hands-on experience leading and mentoring team members, fostering a 'team first' environment
  • Proficiency in REST APIs, JSON, and XML for data manipulation and integration
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 20% for client meetings and project needs

• Direct experience in the Pharmaceutical or Life Sciences industry
  • Functional knowledge of Clinical, Regulatory, Quality, or Safety business processes
  • Previous Project Management exposure for complex enterprise software implementations
  • Familiarity with GxP and software validation regulations
  • Deep understanding of the migration verification and reconciliation process
  • Coding experience, particularly with Java or Python

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.
• Health & wellness programs

• Total compensation: 600,000 - 1,000,000 DKK
  • The total compensation range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential total compensation range for this role. Please note that actual total compensation may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position's total compensation may be composed of other types of compensation, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

The Role

We are looking for a professional, dynamic, team player and active person with facilities and office management experience. In this role, you will be the heartbeat of our office—ensuring a seamless daily experience for our engineers, leaders and guests. This role includes managing all day-to-day office processes, coordinating small projects, and maintaining the overall facility.  

This is an office-based position.

lists.content:
• Execute daily office walkthroughs to ensure that the office is sparkling clean and fully stocked with the supplies employees need
  • Work with the Global Workplace Team and contractors to ensure health & safety, including fire safety. Maintain a supply of first aid equipment
  • Manage ordering of food/drinks and supplies, including vendor coordination (janitorial services, utility vendors, food suppliers, etc.) and associated budgets
  • Ensure a welcoming reception experience for employees and visitors. Manage mail/shipping functions for the office.
  • Support new hire onboarding with desk set-up, office tours, and supplies. Set a positive tone for new hires
  • Act as a point of contact for employee and visitor requests, comments, and concerns
  • Manage office ticketing system and resolve requests or issues efficiently
  • Execute preventative office maintenance and small projects, including budget management
  • Coordinate all purchases of furniture, fixtures, and equipment for the office
  • Work with property management to ensure maintenance is being performed and all issues are resolved
  • Ensure the office is compliant with Veeva security standards, including managing the badging process in the office
  • Manage and coordinate all logistical details for onsite events - meeting rooms, AV setup, food & beverage, and rentals
  • Work with employees to develop regular gatherings and office events
  • Plan and execute annual employee events, including holiday party and summer event
  • Raise invoices through Coupa, track payments, and actively follow up with vendors for missing invoices while maintaining strict data privacy.

• Bachelor’s degree in any stream (B. Com, BBA, BA, etc.) with [3–5] years of experience in office administration, front desk, or operations
  • Fluent verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Excellent customer service and communication/interpersonal skills
  • Self-starter with a positive, can-do attitude. Able to work in a dynamic environment
  • Strong project management skills, able to juggle multiple tasks with accuracy
  • Intermediate to Advanced MS Office (Word, Excel, PPT) and general computer skills , Working knowledge of Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Calendar).
  • Onsite role - office-based from Monday – Friday
  • Must be committed to the required working hours at the office
• Prior experience working in a product development company, or an international IT setup with a diverse, multicultural workforce.

The Role

Are you a seasoned CRM expert who thrives in the "post-go-live" world? We are looking for a Post-Implementation Consultant to own the technical evolution of our clients' CRM ecosystems.
 
You will act as a dedicated technical lead for multiple live clients, translating complex business strategies into scalable technical configurations. You will manage a billable book of work, delivering professional services remotely while serving as the primary subject matter expert (SME) for ongoing application enhancement and operational excellence.

lists.content:
• Technical Delivery: Lead the end-to-end configuration and deployment of enhancements across the CRM Suite
  • Technical Architect: Ensuring all deliverables meet architectural best practices and client timelines
  • Solution Design: Translate business requests into technical design and functional specifications
  • Client Leadership: Serve as a "Trusted Advisor" to client stakeholders, providing proactive recommendations on system optimization
  • Performance Accountability: Maintain high monthly utilization targets by efficiently managing a portfolio of multiple clients in a shared-dedicated capacity
  • Release Management: Conduct impact assessments for product releases, advising clients on how new features will interact within their product footprint
  • Root Cause Analysis: Address technical escalations, identifying architectural gaps and implementing configuration fixes

• 3+ Years of Billable Consulting: Proven experience in a client-facing professional services or managed services role. You must have experience managing client expectations, project scope, and billable hours
  • Hands-on Technical Depth: 3+ years of direct experience building and configuring CRM software (e.g., Salesforce or Veeva). You must be comfortable with complex security models, validation rules, flow automation, and deployment lifecycles
  • Sovereign Delivery: Ability to work autonomously in a remote capacity, managing multiple client workstreams simultaneously without constant oversight
  • Communication Mastery: Exceptional ability to explain technical constraints to non-technical stakeholders via email, presentations, and live workshops

• Life Sciences Expertise: Direct experience working within the Life Sciences or Healthcare vertical, with an understanding of the unique compliance and operational needs of these organizations
  • Veeva CRM/Vault Certification: Current certifications in Veeva CRM or the Veeva Vault platform
  • Technical Architecture Exposure: Experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, or data integration tools

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $70,000 - $140,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

lists.content:
• Strategic Advisory: Serve as the primary SME for Veeva Network, providing proactive guidance on aligning system capabilities with evolving business requirements and industry regulations
  • Environmental Governance: Manage the critical "Network-to-CRM" interface, ensuring the integrity of end-to-end data flows and validating the accuracy of Data Change Requests (DCRs)
  • System Optimization & Continuity: Own the long-term performance of the Network environment, proactively managing the environment to identify technical debt and ensure optimal performance
  • Best Practice Guidance: Act as a "guardrail" for customers, recommending industry-standard configurations for match/merge logic, survivorship rules, and data model extensions to prevent system degradation
  • Process Evolution: Partner with customers to refine their internal data governance processes, ensuring they maximize the value of their Veeva investment post-go-live
  • Configuration Enhancements: Independently execute technical tasks within the customer’s environment, including data model updates and system audits
  • Manage client interactions, set expectations, and provide clear, effective communication
  • Triage, troubleshoot, and resolve client-reported issues related to data, configuration, or platform performance
  • AI-Enabled Efficiency: Leverage Veeva’s approved AI tools to accelerate documentation, data investigation, and provide faster technical insights
  • Contribute to internal initiatives, knowledge sharing, and best practice development
  • Uphold the Veeva Vision and Values including “Do the Right Thing” and “Customer Success”

• 3+ years of professional experience specifically within Master Data Management (MDM) or Life Sciences Data Operations
  • Master Data Management experience
  • Hands-on experience with Veeva Network or Veeva CRM (or comparable MDM platforms)
  • Experience in a customer-facing role, demonstrating consulting acumen and the ability to influence stakeholders
  • Ability to work remotely and independently in support of multiple clients while maintaining an 80% billable utilization target
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills are essential
  • Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in the United States

• Hands-on experience with Veeva Network or Veeva CRM (or comparable MDM platforms)
  • Deep understanding of Life Sciences commercial data (HCP, HCO, Payer/Plan)
  • Experience with SQL for deep-dive data investigation
  • Active Veeva Network or Veeva CRM certifications
  • Experience in a "Long-term Partner" or Managed Services delivery model

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays

Looking for an opportunity to leverage your Master Data Management (MDM) expertise in a post-implementation capacity within the life sciences industry? Veeva Systems is seeking a Consultant for our Network team to work with our live customers.

As a Consultant, Network MDM, you will be a key member of our team, providing ongoing application administration, subject matter expertise, and strategic advisory for customers live with Veeva Network. You will serve as the definitive "Network Expert" for a portfolio of clients, ensuring their MDM ecosystem remains healthy, optimized, and aligned with best practices. This is a remote, full-time, permanent role, supporting multiple clients in a shared, dedicated capacity.

This is a customer-facing role. Veeva Systems does not anticipate providing sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B, OPT) for this employment position.

lists.content:
• Strategic Advisory: Serve as the primary SME for Veeva Network, providing proactive guidance on aligning system capabilities with evolving business requirements and industry regulations
  • Environmental Governance: Manage the critical "Network-to-CRM" interface, ensuring the integrity of end-to-end data flows and validating the accuracy of Data Change Requests (DCRs)
  • System Optimization & Continuity: Own the long-term performance of the Network environment, proactively managing the environment to identify technical debt and ensure optimal performance
  • Best Practice Guidance: Act as a "guardrail" for customers, recommending industry-standard configurations for match/merge logic, survivorship rules, and data model extensions to prevent system degradation
  • Process Evolution: Partner with customers to refine their internal data governance processes, ensuring they maximize the value of their Veeva investment post-go-live
  • Configuration Enhancements: Independently execute technical tasks within the customer’s environment, including data model updates and system audits
  • Manage client interactions, set expectations, and provide clear, effective communication
  • Triage, troubleshoot, and resolve client-reported issues related to data, configuration, or platform performance
  • AI-Enabled Efficiency: Leverage Veeva’s approved AI tools to accelerate documentation, data investigation, and provide faster technical insights
  • Contribute to internal initiatives, knowledge sharing, and best practice development
  • Uphold the Veeva Vision and Values including “Do the Right Thing” and “Customer Success”

• 3+ years of professional experience specifically within Master Data Management (MDM) or Life Sciences Data Operations
  • Master Data Management experience
  • Hands-on experience with Veeva Network or Veeva CRM (or comparable MDM platforms)
  • Experience in a customer-facing role, demonstrating consulting acumen and the ability to influence stakeholders
  • Ability to work remotely and independently in support of multiple clients while maintaining an 80% billable utilization target
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills are essential
  • Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in the United States

• Hands-on experience with Veeva Network or Veeva CRM (or comparable MDM platforms)
  • Deep understanding of Life Sciences commercial data (HCP, HCO, Payer/Plan)
  • Experience with SQL for deep-dive data investigation
  • Active Veeva Network or Veeva CRM certifications
  • Experience in a "Long-term Partner" or Managed Services delivery model

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $70,000 - $140,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

lists.content: As a trusted advisor, you will deeply understand our clients' market landscapes to proactively drive continuous value, account retention, and contract renewals. You will champion client needs internally, directly influencing the Veeva Ostro product roadmap, while overseeing large-scope execution, enterprise budgets, and tight deadlines with flawless precision to maximize client ROI.

• 7+ years of digital marketing strategy and account management experience in a healthcare/pharma agency setting; proven ability to manage multiple accounts and cultivate high-trust client partnerships
  • Deep understanding of the digital ecosystem (websites, banners, social) with a track record of driving strategy for major pharma product launches; hands-on experience with pharmaceutical product communications and Veeva Vault PromoMats submissions
  • Track record of managing complex enterprise books of business and acting as a trusted consultant to proactively uncover, pitch, and secure business expansion opportunities
  • Strong ability to translate digital analytics, KPI dashboards, and campaign performance data into actionable business insights for clients
  • Experience collaborating closely with internal creative, technical, and medical writing teams in an agency or consulting environment
  • Ability to travel, minimum once a quarter per client or as needed

• Experience with Veeva Vault PromoMats, Veeva Vault CRM, or other Veeva Commercial Cloud applications
  • Experience working across multiple complex therapeutic areas (e.g., oncology, rare disease, immunology)
  • Familiarity navigating complex Medical/Legal/Regulatory (MLR) review processes and FDA guidelines

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs

Veeva is building the industry cloud for Life Sciences through software, data, AI, and Business Consulting working together. Learn more about our products, vision and values, and status as a public benefit corporation on our website.
 
Consulting is changing, and we’re not like other firms. Veeva Business Consulting was launched in 2019 and has grown quickly and organically to a global organization of over 400 people. Our team is focused on making the life sciences industry more efficient and effective through software, data, and consulting working together.
 
We expect significant growth in Business Consulting as we look towards 2030, and are looking for great people to make it happen.


The Role
As a Principal Consultant in our Commercial, you will help customers bring treatments to patients faster by transforming how they work with Technology, Data, and AI. You will focus on reshaping operating models, driving organizational change, and measuring tangible business value.
 
Some of our key areas of focus include:
Vault CRM migrations & implementations
Activating Veeva’s standards agents in Vault CRM
Identifying future customer engagement capabilities needed and the path to transformation
Transforming and modernizing the way HCP engagement is planned and executed
Optimizing field force direction, productivity, and effectiveness
Defining the strategy and execution to realize account-based engagement
Accelerating launch through a data-driven approach

lists.content:
• Project Mastery: Act as the Lead for Veeva BC’s largest and most complex global projects, maintaining full accountability for excellence across multiple teams
  • Strategic Growth: Lead and own Business Development for the Commercial Practice focusing on architecting and winning key deals exceeding $1M+
  • People Leadership: Manage and mentor high-performing consulting teams, taking responsibility for the professional growth and delivery standards of the practice
  • Thought Leadership: Develop and champion industry-leading thought leadership in Commercial & Customer to keep Veeva at the cutting edge of Life Sciences
  • Customer Success: Serve as a trusted advisor to C-suite stakeholders, leveraging Veeva’s data and software to solve their most critical challenges

• Experience: 10+ years of Life Sciences Consulting experience (Management Consulting preferred)
  • Track Record: Proven ability to win and deliver $1M+ consulting engagements
  • Expertise: Deep domain knowledge in customer engagement strategy, sales and commercial operations, omnichannel, marketing excellence, key account management, and/or medical affairs are preferred and a comprehensive understanding of the Life Sciences landscape
  • Leadership: Extensive experience managing multiple project teams and senior-level customer relationships
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher

• Knowledge of Veeva products
  • Experience delivering SaaS or Tech-enabled consulting solutions

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows: 
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program
  • Unrivaled career progression in a fast-growing, global team
  • Veeva is a Work Anywhere company. You can work from home or the office on any given day

• Base pay: $120,000 - $250,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
 
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
 
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.


The Role
The Veeva Business Consulting practice is growing, and we are looking for talented individuals to join. This team shapes commercial strategies, processes, and operations of leading Life Sciences organizations in order to provide ongoing solutions for the core business issues faced in today’s dynamic market. The Global Commercial Content Business Consulting team leads innovation and partnership in areas related to content management, creation, review, approval, planning, and distribution of content-- whether the customer is seeking to resolve a timely issue or would like to accomplish a strategic corporate goal for commercialized products in Life Sciences The focus is to help identify the source of the business issues faced, define critical success factors, develop a structured approach to deliver solutions, and do so in a highly collaborative manner - ultimately building critical customer relationships within the Commercial Business of our customers.
 
The majority of your time will be spent leading customer engagements and working with a wide variety of clients to deliver Commercial Content advisory support. Commercial Content Business Consultants have a strong subject matter understanding of commercial content operations processes, tools, and systems supporting marketing and medical content in support of commercialized products in the life sciences. In addition, these individuals have strong management consulting or agency experience to serve as the day-to-day engagement resource, leading projects with the engagement leadership team.  
 
If you are looking for an opportunity to lead commercial content strategies in an innovative and fast-paced environment, this is a great opportunity for you.
 
Opportunities are available within APAC for this role to be based in either Singapore or Australia. There is no work location requirement if a candidate is in close proximity to an airport and is able to meet travel requirements.

Consulting is changing, and we’re not like other firms. Veeva Business Consulting was launched in 2019 and has grown quickly and organically to a global organization of over 400 people. Our team is focused on making the life sciences industry more efficient and effective through software, data, and consulting working together.
 
We expect significant growth in Business Consulting as we look towards 2030, and are looking for great people to make it happen.

The Role

As a Principal - Small Medium Business (SMB) Lead in our Commercial Practice, you will help customers bring treatments to patients faster by transforming how they capture and utilize Commercial Evidence, with Technology, Data, and AI. You will focus on reshaping operating models, driving organizational change, and measuring tangible business value.
 
Some of our key areas of focus include:
  • Harnessing the power of Commercial Evidence with Agentic Commercial
  • Vault CRM migrations & implementations
  • Activating Veeva’s agentic capabilities in Vault CRM
  • Identifying future customer engagement capabilities needed and the path to transformation
  • Transforming and modernizing the way HCP engagement is planned and executed
  • Optimizing field force direction, productivity, and effectiveness
  • Defining the strategy and execution to realize account-based engagement
  • Accelerating launch through a data-driven approach

data.descriptionPlain:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
 
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
 
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
 
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.


The Role
Veeva’s Japan Business Consulting is a unique group fusing strategy and technology, inside a company at the forefront of digital innovation in the Life Science. Establishing a leading Business Consulting practice is a strategic growth priority for Veeva offering a differentiated consulting service with a compelling value proposition – building on Veeva’s position as the digital partner of choice for 85% of the Pharmaceutical companies. The Business Consulting team is focused on supporting our customers' commercial strategies through the design and delivery of solutions for the core business issues faced by today’s field organizations. 
 
The role of a Principal Business Consultant is to be part of the Japan Business Consulting Leadership Team to help grow this practice in Japan and APAC. With a focus on building our brand in the market, developing our customer network and identifying and selling new projects to support our customers to deliver on their more complex and strategic business issues. In addition, support building our practice with recruiting and mentoring of staff.
 
As a consulting leader, help identify the source of the business issues faced by our customers, develop a structured approach to deliver solutions, and do so in a highly collaborative manner - ultimately building critical customer relationships within the Commercial Business of our customers.

lists.content:
• Be among the leaders of the practice with responsibilities to help build the business consulting organization through recruiting, mentoring/coaching of staff and business development activities
  • Lead business development opportunities – identify and generate new project opportunities, clarify the customers issues and need, be able to develop a compelling, differentiated proposal to solve these issues and win new work
  • Leverage your network to identify opportunities and develop our business and build new relationships
  • Establishing relationships with client personnel at appropriate levels within the commercial organization and serving as a primary contact for strategic questions
  • Support in the creation of new campaigns, offerings and thought leadership that differentiate Business Consulting in the market
  • Lead multiple project engagement teams – empowering the team to plan and manage all aspects of delivery, from scope to quality assurance
  • Staying abreast of current business and industry trends relevant to the client's business

• 10+ years in Life Sciences advisory and industry experience, particularly in the Commercial Operations/Commercial Excellence and/or consulting to this sector
  • Good understanding of the business capabilities and drivers underpinning digital technology in Life Sciences and market forces driving industry changes
  • Strong leadership skills and track record of developing and delivering advisory engagements including the ability to manage client relationships and engagement economics
  • Extensive network of stakeholders within leadership positions in Life Science companies
  • Core management consulting skills, including workshop facilitation, client presentations, project management, and ability to develop structured approaches/methodologies to business problems
  • Deep understanding across the entire Commercial value chain with recognized mastery in two or more of the following areas: Brand strategy, product launch, go to market strategy, commercial model design, key account planning and management, segmentation and targeting, multi-channel strategy, and commercial analytics
  • Ability to travel roughly 50% but this can vary depending on engagement 
  • An effective communicator verbally and written in both English and Japanese
  • Valid working visa in Japan is required

• Experience with digital technologies, analytics tools
  • Experience working with SaaS solutions
  • Good understanding of Veeva broader platforms and solutions, and how these can be leveraged and enhanced by commercial consulting services

• Highly competitive remuneration
  • Opportunity for rapid progression
  • Veeva Giving.  Financial contributions for the societal causes you’re passionate about 
  • Health & wellness programs

The Role
 
Do you dream about being part of a team with the talent, passion, and financial backing to build top-notch, industry-changing, cloud-based applications and platforms? At Veeva, we build enterprise cloud technology that powers the biggest names in pharmaceuticals, biotech, consumer goods, chemical & cosmetics industries. Our customers make vaccines, life-saving medicines, and life-enhancing products that make a difference in everyday lives. Our technology has transformed these industries, enabling them to get critical products and services to market faster. Our products empower our customers in the fight against global pandemics like COVID-19.

lists.content:
• Learn and understand features of Veeva Vault platform and applications
  • Work on CI/CD tools (Git, Jenkins, JIRA) on a daily basis 
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts (API and UI)
  • Communicating status and working effectively with onshore/offshore managers
  • Troubleshoot day to day technical issues related to test automation
  • Perform code reviews and be a  technical mentor to team members
  • Work with managers to arrive at metrics for measuring the code quality for test automation suite
  • Work closely with scrum masters on sprint plannings and backlog grooming
  • Be a key player for the growth of Veeva Hyderabad by contributing to  recruiting initiatives

• 10+ years of experience in software test automation
  • Strong technical leadership abilities and project management experience
  • Provide a practical approach to complex testing, specifically in the areas of the automation of test cases for the purposes of regression testing
  • Proficient in QA process & methodologies, tools, and different testing approaches
  • Strong experience in Java, Object-Oriented Methodologies
  • Strong experience with automated test frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Cucumber)
  • Strong experience in testing Restful API & HTTP web services, JSON/XML, and Web-based applications
  • Good working knowledge of CI/CD tools (Git, Jenkins, JIRA)
  • Experience in Mobile Testing and Automation – Appium, XCUI, Espresso, KI
  • Experience in Mobile Apps Development (Android/iOS)
  • Experience with data analytics and log analysis tools such as Kibana, Elasticsearch, etc.
  • Able to lead multiple implementations
  • Collaborate to gather automation requirements, design automated tests and implement scalable test automation solutions
  • Design, develop and manage automated testing artifacts
  • Comfortable debugging and working with object-oriented programming
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum development methodologies (preferably in an onshore /offshore model)
  • Experience working for a product-based company
  • Excellent team collaboration and effective communication skills
  • Experience playing a technical mentor role to the team and performing code reviews
  • Experience leading automation projects in a technical role and actively participating in overall program/project management activities
  • Experience with applicable software and programs, including Kotlin, Swift, JAVA, and React
  • Fluency in interfacing and functional testing
  • A natural problem solver and critical thinker
  • Knowledge of modern best practices for software development, including IDE, source control, build processes, release management, and deployment
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or similar
• Experience with Android and Mac platforms

• Health insurance with generous coverage limits
  • Fixed bonus
  • Allowance for wellness & fitness programs
  • Winter break

lists.content:
• Help build your dream AI enabled Authoring Platform: Act as the ultimate visionary and "Voice of the Customer," guiding product and engineering teams on how an ideal, advanced authoring system should handle source data mapping, document logic, and summary execution
  • Define Document Generation Frameworks: Go beyond static templates to map out how clinical data should be logically synthesized into regulatory-grade documents—starting with clinical trial results and scaling to broader regulatory submissions
  • Define "What Good Looks Like": Establish objective quality criteria, review protocols, and verification frameworks to ensure the platform's initial and future outputs meet stringent global regulatory expectations
  • Direct Content Instructions: Inform and refine the internal instructions and content logic used by the system to generate content, ensuring it captures the nuances of cyclical document updates and complex clinical narratives
  • Commercial & Sales Enablement: Actively participate in the sales cycle. Meet with prospects, demonstrate profound medical writing expertise, and build immediate credibility with prospective buyers
  • Change Management Advisory & Early Adoption: Partner with early adopter companies to help their medical writing teams transition from manual drafting to a strategic, human-in-the-loop review process, acting as their internal champion to our product team

• 7+ years of medical writing experience within pharma, biotech, or CROs, with a heavy emphasis on authoring complex regulatory documents
  • Deep operational understanding of global regulatory guidelines (such as ICH E3) and complex clinical data mapping
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and relationship-management skills, with total comfort acting as a subject matter expert during commercial cycles
  • A passion for learning about agentic AI and an adaptive, forward-thinking mindset regarding how generative technology can transform regulatory document workflows
• Prior experience collaborating directly with software vendors or innovation teams to develop or optimize medical writing technology solutions

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $140,000 - $200,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

Join Veeva as we lead the life sciences industry’s fundamental shift from digital documents to process digitalization. As Process Architect, you will be the hands-on architect of this transition, converting legacy, document-centric processes into a modern, data-centric ecosystem within Veeva Validation Management. 
We are seeking a technical lead to convert legacy documents into normalized, relational data environments. This individual understands the requirements for mapping Commissioning, Qualification, and Validation processes, turning templates and static records into fluid, searchable, and actionable information.
In this role, you will act as a digitalization expert, guiding customers from paper-heavy or paper-on-glass solutions to data-centric workflows. You will also be responsible for owning the development and maintenance of specialized tooling and methodologies required to migrate and manage data across Vault environments.
This is a work anywhere, full-time permanent role with Veeva. Our work processes are designed so that you can be productive in the environment that works best for you. This is a customer-facing role and we have no work location requirement if you are in close proximity to an airport and able to meet future travel requirements.
