Make the work of our customers delivering life-changing medicines and treatments to patients more efficient and productive. We are looking for an experienced technical product manager to design and deliver high-value AI Agent solutions for Veeva PromoMats and Vault Medical.

In this role, you will be the expert in leveraging AI to automate the content lifecycle, from speeding up the Medical, Legal, and Regulatory (MLR) review process to automating the generation of medical information responses. You will build AI agents that help commercial and medical affairs teams ensure compliance while accelerating the speed-to-market for critical health communications.

lists.content:
• AI Orchestration & Design: Lead the design of production-ready AI Agent applications, focusing on data flow orchestration, RAG architectures, and complex prompt engineering.
  • Strategic Product Discovery: Navigate the probabilistic nature of AI by identifying high-impact use cases where LLMs can solve non-deterministic problems in the MLR and Medical Inquiry workflows.
  • Performance & Value Metrics: Define and track clear KPIs for AI success, such as “Reduction in MLR Review Cycles”, “Inference Accuracy”, and “Automated Reference Matching Precision” to demonstrate ROI to stakeholders.
  • Prototype to Production: Drive hands-on design and development of AI prototypes while ensuring they meet the rigorous scalability and quality standards of the Veeva Vault platform.
  • Process Automation: Partner with Engineering and UX to automate key business processes, such as identifying compliance risks in promotional materials or triaging complex medical inquiries.
  • Stakeholder Alignment & Evangelism: Work with Application PMs to integrate AI capabilities seamlessly and present the value proposition to internal leadership and external stakeholders.

• 5+ years of enterprise software product management, engineering, or consulting experience
  • 2+ years of hands-on focus on AI/ML applications, specifically LLMs and Generative AI
  • Technical Proficiency: Strong coding skills in Python and experience with AI Frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex) and APIs
  • Architectural Knowledge: Deep understanding of data flow design, prompt engineering, and model fine-tuning for highly regulated content
  • Communication: Ability to translate complex AI concepts into business value for non-technical stakeholders in Legal, Medical, and Regulatory departments
  • Collaboration: Proven track record of working with UX and Engineering to build intuitive tools for complex workflows

• Domain Expertise: Direct experience with Veeva Vault PromoMats or Vault Medical
  • Life Sciences Experience: Familiarity with MLR review processes, 2253 submissions, or Medical Information (MedInfo) workflows
  • Data Background: Experience as a data scientist, machine learning, or data engineering role

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • PTO and company-paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $120,000 - $170,000 CAD

Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
 
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Make the work of our customers delivering life-changing medicines and treatments to patients more efficient and productive. We are looking for an experienced technical product manager to design and deliver high-value AI Agent solutions for Veeva PromoMats and Vault Medical.

In this role, you will be the expert in leveraging AI to automate the content lifecycle, from speeding up the Medical, Legal, and Regulatory (MLR) review process to automating the generation of medical information responses. You will build AI agents that help commercial and medical affairs teams ensure compliance while accelerating the speed-to-market for critical health communications.

lists.content:
• AI Orchestration & Design: Lead the design of production-ready AI Agent applications, focusing on data flow orchestration, RAG architectures, and complex prompt engineering.
  • Strategic Product Discovery: Navigate the probabilistic nature of AI by identifying high-impact use cases where LLMs can solve non-deterministic problems in the MLR and Medical Inquiry workflows.
  • Performance & Value Metrics: Define and track clear KPIs for AI success, such as “Reduction in MLR Review Cycles”, “Inference Accuracy”, and “Automated Reference Matching Precision” to demonstrate ROI to stakeholders.
  • Prototype to Production: Drive hands-on design and development of AI prototypes while ensuring they meet the rigorous scalability and quality standards of the Veeva Vault platform.
  • Process Automation: Partner with Engineering and UX to automate key business processes, such as identifying compliance risks in promotional materials or triaging complex medical inquiries.
  • Stakeholder Alignment & Evangelism: Work with Application PMs to integrate AI capabilities seamlessly and present the value proposition to internal leadership and external stakeholders.

• 5+ years of enterprise software product management, engineering, or consulting experience
  • 2+ years of hands-on focus on AI/ML applications, specifically LLMs and Generative AI
  • Technical Proficiency: Strong coding skills in Python and experience with AI Frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex) and APIs
  • Architectural Knowledge: Deep understanding of data flow design, prompt engineering, and model fine-tuning for highly regulated content
  • Communication: Ability to translate complex AI concepts into business value for non-technical stakeholders in Legal, Medical, and Regulatory departments
  • Collaboration: Proven track record of working with UX and Engineering to build intuitive tools for complex workflows

• Domain Expertise: Direct experience with Veeva Vault PromoMats or Vault Medical
  • Life Sciences Experience: Familiarity with MLR review processes, 2253 submissions, or Medical Information (MedInfo) workflows
  • Data Background: Experience as a data scientist, machine learning, or data engineering role

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $100,000 - $200,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

lists.content:
• Work closely with customers to understand their business challenges, workflows, and requirements.
  • Translate customer needs into clear product requirements and scalable product solutions.
  • Manage the full product lifecycle, including market research, product planning, development, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
  • Identify product improvement opportunities and define and maintain the product’s mid- to long-term roadmap.
  • Define AI Agent use cases, including agent goals, workflows, context, tool usage, human-in-the-loop design, exception handling, and success criteria.
  •  Work with Engineering, Design, Data, QA, and Solution Consulting teams to deliver high-quality AI Agent capabilities.
  • Define and monitor AI product quality metrics such as accuracy, task completion, reliability, user trust, adoption, and business value.
  • Use customer feedback and real-world product performance to continuously improve AI Agent capabilities.
  • Provide cross-functional leadership to align priorities, drive decisions, and ensure successful product delivery and go-to-market.

• 7+ years of experience in digital products, AI solutions, or a related field, with demonstrated ownership of complex products or initiatives across the full lifecycle, from discovery and design through delivery, launch, adoption, and ongoing improvement.
  •  Extensive customer-facing experience, with the ability to independently lead customer discovery and communicate effectively with senior business stakeholders.
  • Strong ability to understand complex customer workflows, identify the underlying business problems behind stated needs, and translate ambiguous requirements into clear product direction and solutions.
  • Hands-on experience designing, delivering, or continuously improving Generative AI, conversational AI, or AI Agent products.
  • Experience designing AI Agent use cases, including defining agent goals, workflows, context requirements, tool usage, human-in-the-loop mechanisms, exception handling, and success criteria.
  • Ability to define and evaluate AI product quality across dimensions such as accuracy, task completion, reliability, user trust, product adoption, and business value.
  • Strong product judgment, with the ability to challenge assumptions, make thoughtful trade-offs, and clearly explain product decisions to customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Proven cross-functional leadership, with the ability to build alignment with Product and Engineering teams, drive collaboration, and influence outcomes.
  • Ability to operate independently in a fast-moving, ambiguous, and highly customer-facing environment.
  • A high degree of professional ethics, integrity, accountability, and commitment to customer success.

• Experience with enterprise SaaS products, configurable platforms, or multi-tenant product environments.
  • A technical background in software engineering, computer science, data science, machine learning, solution architecture, or a related field.
  • Familiarity with concepts such as large language models, RAG, prompt and context design, tool calling, agent orchestration, APIs, and enterprise data integration.
  • Experience in life sciences, pharmaceutical commercial operations, medical affairs, CRM, or another regulated industry.
  • Experience designing products that use enterprise data, knowledge bases, unstructured content, or external information sources.
  • Familiarity with AI governance, data privacy, information security, compliance, auditability, and responsible AI practices.

lists.content:
• Own end-to-end delivery of AI/agent features within CRM Suite, from ideation and requirement definition through to launch — personally driving execution, not just setting direction.
  • Translate agent and LLM mechanics (reasoning, tool use, context/memory, orchestration, etc.) into concrete, shippable product designs and detailed specs.
  • Partner closely with engineering to define agent workflows, evaluate trade-offs, and iterate based on real usage and feedback.
  • Maintain a coherent, forward-looking view of how AI capabilities should be structured across the product lines you own, while staying hands-on with the details of any single feature.
  • Prepare and present product materials to internal and external stakeholders, translating technical AI capabilities into clear business value.
  • Continuously track emerging AI/agent patterns and technologies, and translate relevant ones into practical roadmap items.

• 7+ years of product management experience, including at least one AI/agent product taken from 0 to 1 (concept to launch) as the product lead.
  • Deep, hands-on understanding of agent architecture and underlying mechanics — e.g., LLM reasoning/planning, tool use/function calling, RAG, memory, multi-agent orchestration — not just conceptual familiarity.
  • Must possess a technical background (CS degree or equivalent hands-on engineering/technical experience), enabling detailed, credible collaboration with engineers on system design trade-offs.
  • A hands-on product builder — comfortable writing detailed specs and flows, working through edge cases, and personally driving features through to release.
  • Strong product design sense — able to translate complex AI capabilities into simple, intuitive user experiences.
  • Excellent cross-functional communication and collaboration skills, particularly with engineering teams building AI systems.
  • Fast learner, comfortable navigating ambiguity across multiple active product lines.

• Experience in life sciences/pharma or other complex, regulated industries.
  • Experience building AI agent products in an enterprise SaaS context.
  • Familiarity with evaluation frameworks for LLM-based products (offline eval, A/B testing for AI features).

The Role
The Senior Product Manager, Vault CRM Campaign Manager, is a critical position responsible for understanding global Marketing Automation commercial landscape. You will be responsible for defining and communicating the roadmap to internal and external customers, while working closely with the engineering team to bring your vision to life, as you jointly develop a world class solution. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a team of life sciences industry and technology A-players, who, together, are bringing the next generation of commercial solutions to the life sciences industry.

lists.content:
• Drive strategic direction of Veeva’s new Commercial solutions, building a new, better CRM on the Vault Platform that includes Campaign Manager
  • Define product priorities and roadmap by collecting and synthesizing input from customers, partners, executives, market owners, sales, services, and engineering
  • Be the voice of the customer and work collaboratively with product development teams to design and deliver product capabilities that meet customer/market requirements
  • Evangelize products and become the subject matter expert for internal audiences, external customers, and market facing communications
  • Collaborate with other departments (e.g. UX, engineering, QA, operations, etc.) to manage resources, timelines, and conflicts
  • Ultimately you are responsible for creating features that are built, delivered with quality, and delight customers

• 5+ years of product management experience in the Marketing Automation software industry
  • Experience in researching and understanding customer and market requirements to develop short and long term product roadmaps and plans
  • Experience developing configurable enterprise SaaS solutions in an agile environment
  • Experience writing detailed user stories and managing a feature backlog
  • Track record of effectively collaborating with engineering/QA to define, design, and deliver product
  • Ability to understand and communicate architectural requirements, preferences, and limitations
  • Experience interacting with customers, development, and consulting teams, both local and remote
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment, with little direct supervision
  • Strong communication skills: written, verbal, and formal presentation
  • A strong sense of professional ethics

• Experience with commercial aspects of the Life Sciences industry, including Inside Sales or Field Sales or Field Medical teams and their respective processes
  • Prior work in software development, or computer science degree

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $120,000 - $200,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

The Role
As a Senior Product Manager, Platform on the Compass Patient data product, you will own data quality and data features for our Compass Platform.
 
The Compass Platform is a centralized repository of deidentified healthcare claims data that has been ingested, normalized into a standard schema, matched/merged/deduped, enriched and made available for query.

lists.content:

  • Design product capabilities to measure, clean, enrich, and monitor data quality across billions of records
  • Own the roadmap for data quality - measure, monitoring, and improvements
  • Manage feature prioritization and backlog grooming with the Development team
  • Understand the needs of the internal customers and drive priorities with input from a variety of stakeholders, including strategy, analytics, data science, and the health data management teams
  • Support release and sprint planning to ensure product enhancements support customers at the right time and the right sequence

• 6+ years hands-on Product Management experience, technical services, engineering, analytics or other related positions
  • Must have experience working with Prescription and Medical Claims data
  • Experience working on big data systems, including schemas, reference tables, data clean-up, transformations, enrichment, and QC checks
  • Experience investigating data issues and in using data visualization tools
  • Proficient in SQL

• Experience working on enterprise products
  • Experience working on AWS platform
  • Proficient in Python
  • BA/BS degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Math, or related technical field
  • Experience working with EHR and Lab data

    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $120,000 - $170,000 CAD

data.descriptionPlain:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
 
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
 
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
 
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.


The Role
Interested in working in a fast-paced startup environment that has the stability of a successful and profitable public company? Interested in having your day-to-day work impact the lives of millions of people by helping to bring medical products to market that save lives and improve quality of life? If so, then the Veeva EDC team is likely a great option for you. 
 
Our Product is geared to help bring lifesaving drugs to market quicker by revolutionizing the way clinical trial processes are run. We’re looking for a high energy, passionate individual with experience in B2B enterprise product management. In this role, you will be responsible for creating a game changing health tech application which will, in turn, help continue Veeva’s success as the leader in providing cloud-based technology to the Life Sciences industry.

lists.content:
• Design and drive innovative product features based upon industry requirements across the entire Veeva EDC family of applications.
  • Directly responsible for designing features that will provide rich user experience while maintaining a streamlined user interaction model.
  • Generate wireframes, product requirements, and direct functional design.
  • Communicate specific, actionable requirements to members of the engineering team.
  • Drive customer initiatives through the development team.
  • Interact with Customers, Professional Services, Market Owners, and Sales to understand business needs and act as their primary development point of contact.
  • Manage the definition and evolution of product integrations among Veeva EDC products.
  • Analyze requirements, prepare technical specifications, create development and testing plans based on interaction with Senior Management.
  • Perform market and competitive analysis.
  • Demonstrate product features to internal and external audiences.

• 5+ years of product management experience, preferably with a focus on B2B enterprise SaaS applications.
  • Proven track record of managing all stages of the product lifecycle and successfully launching products or features that meet customer needs
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate a clear vision and influence cross-functional teams without formal authority.
  • Excellent spoken and written communication skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a demonstrated ability to make data-informed decisions.

• Direct experience and deep domain knowledge in clinical trials, gained from working at a pharmaceutical company, biotech, CRO, or a clinical technology provider.
  • Experience working in a regulated environment and knowledge of industry standards such as ICH GCP and FDA 21 CFR part 11.
  • Undergraduate or graduate degree in computer science or engineering
  • Experience with programming languages (Python, Java, SQL, …)
  • Familiarity with the Veeva Vault Platform or other Veeva applications

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $120,000 - $200,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

lists.content:
• Be hands-on. Design, prototype, define, configure Veeva MedInquiry and validate solutions rapidly to ensure we solve the right problems, in the right order
  • Be agile. Design, implement, iterate
  • Be a storyteller. Author & design high-quality specifications and communicate specific, actionable requirements to your engineering teammates
  • Be an owner. Create and manage the roadmap for your product area, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams. Keep up with the latest Medical Information software and Life Sciences industry trends, and distill them into product requirements
  • Be a team player. Work with Engineering, QA, and Product Management to build solutions that harmonize across Veeva applications
  • Take pride in your work with a passion for excellence

• 8+ years of progressive experience in product management
  • Experience with case management and customer service intake channels
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
  • Demonstrated expertise in design, product development, and strategic planning
  • Experience in researching and understanding customer and market requirements to develop short and long-term product roadmaps and plans
  • Experience writing detailed user stories and managing a story backlog
  • Ability to understand and communicate architectural requirements, preferences, and limitations
  • Track record of effectively collaborating with engineering/QA to define, design, and deliver the product
  • Experience with data modeling (ERDs) and Lucidchart
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment and comfortable with ambiguity
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, or a related discipline
  • Must be based in a region in the Eastern Standard Time zone
  • Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to work in the USA or Canada

• Experience in digital product design tools such as Figma
  • Experience in Medical Information

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $120,000 - $200,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

lists.content:
• Contribute to the Patient CRM Roadmap: Own the strategy and delivery of the features specific to patient recruitment, enrollment, and long-term engagement processes.
  • Collaborate Across Product Teams: Partner with the wider Vault CRM PM organization to incorporate patient-specific requirements into the core platform. You will ensure that core capabilities are optimized for the high-touch, high-security nature of patient services.
  • Industry Representation & Thought Leadership: Represent the product team at Patient Services and Hub-focused events. You will share our vision for the future of patient orchestration and gather market intelligence to inform our strategy.
  • Requirement Synthesis: Translate the complexities of patient journeys, including reimbursement, clinical trial support, and therapy adherence, into technical specifications.
  • AI & Intelligent Orchestration: Partner with the AI PM team to build agents that help patient case managers and support teams interact with patients more empathetically and efficiently.
  • Full Lifecycle Management: Work with UX, engineering, QA, and services teams to guide features from initial concept and design to global release and customer adoption.

• HealthTech Industry Expertise: Minimum of 5 years of experience in Patient Services, Hub Operations, Field Reimbursement, or Product Management for patient-specific software. You must have a deep understanding of HIPAA, GDPR, and patient privacy regulations.
  • Software Product Management: 3+ years of PM experience at a software company, with a proven track record of owning and launching enterprise-grade SaaS products.
  • Strategic Influence: Demonstrated ability to work across multiple product teams to influence roadmaps and drive shared goals in a complex, matrixed PM environment.
  • Analytical Rigor: Exceptional problem-solving skills with a "show me the data" mindset to uncover the "why" behind customer needs.
  • Technical Execution: Experience writing detailed requirement specifications, managing backlogs, and leading engineering teams in an agile environment.
  • Communication: Superior ability to translate Patient Services "shop talk" into technical requirements for developers and executive-level visions for customers.

• Experience with conversational AI, recommendation engines, or large language models (LLMs)
  • Deep knowledge of benefit verification, prior authorization and co-pay assistance
  • Experience with configurable enterprise SaaS solutions.
  • Prior exposure to the Veeva Vault Platform.
  • Background in software development or computer science.

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $120,000 - $200,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

The Role
As the newest member of our Product Management team, you will play a crucial role in advancing Veeva Safety, an enterprise-level pharmacovigilance (drug safety) solution that manages the intake, processing, and submission of adverse events for clinical and post-market products. Your contributions will enable the Life Sciences industry as a whole to better track and inform the public about the safety risk profile of the medicines we and our loved ones often rely upon for continued health.

lists.content:

  • Author high quality design specifications within an agile methodology
  • Prioritize feature development based on strategic initiatives, customer requirements, and internal technical needs
  • Interact with customers, professional services, strategy, and sales to understand business needs
  • Interact with engineering and QA teams to drive high quality product feature implementation
  • Be the product evangelist - become a subject matter expect for internal stakeholders and external customers

• 5+ years of experience as a product manager, business analysis, or consulting roles
  • 5+ years of SAP integration experience on major implementation projects, handling complex scenarios in the supply chain and process manufacturing space
  • Strong understanding of integration strategies including APIs, EDI, and RF
  • Experience interacting with customers, development, consulting, and sales teams
  • Strong technical skills to translate business requirements to design docs for developers to understand
  • Demonstrated skills in design, product development, and planning
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Degree in computer science, engineering, or business administration
  • Must be based in the Eastern Time zone or at least 1 hour offset

• Some prior experience implementing software in a professional services capacity
  • Experience working in the Life Sciences industry
  • Technical degree or hands-on development experience

lists.content:
• Drive the MedTech Roadmap: Own the strategy and delivery of functionality specific to MedTech sales processes 
  • Collaborate Across Product Teams: Partner with the wider Vault CRM PM organization to incorporate and drive specific functionality into the core platform. You will ensure that the core capabilities are optimized for the MedTech commercial model.
  • Industry Representation & Thought Leadership: Represent the product team at MedTech events. You will share our vision for the future of MedTech engagement and gather high-level market intelligence to inform our strategy.
  • Requirement Synthesis: Translate the nuances of the MedTech sales processes into technical specifications.
  • AI & Intelligent Orchestration: Partner with the AI PM team to build agents that help MedTech reps utilize CRM efficiently and effectively.
  • Full Lifecycle Management: Work with UX, engineering, QA, services teams to guide features from initial concept and design to global release and customer adoption.

• MedTech Industry Expertise: Minimum of 5 years of experience in MedTech Commercial Operations or Product Management for MedTech-specific software. You must have a deep understanding of the surgical sales cycle, hospital procurement (GPOs/IDNs), field service, clinical case management, consignment, order management, CPQ,  and inventory & logistics.
  • Software Product Management: 3+ years of PM experience at a software company, with a proven track record of owning and launching enterprise-grade SaaS products.
  • Strategic Influence: Demonstrated ability to work across multiple product teams to influence roadmaps and drive shared goals in a complex, matrixed PM environment.
  • Analytical Rigor: Exceptional problem-solving skills with a "show me the data" mindset to uncover the "why" behind customer needs.
  • Technical Execution: Experience writing detailed requirement specifications, managing backlogs, and leading engineering teams in an agile environment.
  • Communication: Superior ability to translate MedTech commercial "shop talk" into technical requirements for developers and executive-level visions for customers.

• Experience with conversational AI, recommendation engines, or large language models (LLMs)
  • Experience with configurable enterprise SaaS solutions.
  • Prior exposure to the Veeva Vault Platform.
  • Background in software development or computer science.

As a Senior Product Manager for MedTech, you will be the primary architect of the MedTech-specific vision within our broader product ecosystem. You will collaborate with the wider Vault CRM PM team to ensure the core platform (AI agents, mobile offline capabilities, data architecture, and more) is evolved to meet the unique, complex requirements of Medical Device and Diagnostic companies. You will act as the subject matter expert and advocate, driving a dedicated roadmap that bridges the gap between general life sciences functionality and specialized medical technology workflows.

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
 
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
 
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
 
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.


The Role
As a Senior Product Manager for Vault CRM Service Center, you will be the primary architect of the global service and contact center vision within our broader Vault CRM ecosystem. You will collaborate with the wider Vault CRM PM team to ensure the core platform (AI agents, Engagement Channels like telephony/CCaaS, Email, WhatsApp, SMS, and more) evolves to meet the unique, complex requirements of service and contact center users. You will act as the subject matter expert and advocate, driving a dedicated roadmap to develop a world class solution. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a team of life sciences industry and technology A-players, who, together, are bringing the next generation of commercial solutions to the life sciences industry.

The Role

As a Senior Product Manager for Vault CRM Service Center, you will be the primary architect of the global service and contact center vision within our broader Vault CRM ecosystem. You will collaborate with the wider Vault CRM PM team to ensure the core platform (AI agents, Engagement Channels like telephony/CCaaS, Email, WhatsApp, SMS, and more) evolves to meet the unique, complex requirements of service and contact center users. You will act as the subject matter expert and advocate, driving a dedicated roadmap to develop a world class solution. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a team of life sciences industry and technology A-players, who, together, are bringing the next generation of commercial solutions to the life sciences industry.

lists.content:
• Contribute to the Service Center Roadmap: Own the strategy and delivery of functionality specific to service and contact center processes 
  • Collaborate Across Product Teams: Partner with the wider Vault CRM PM organization to incorporate service and contact center requirements into the core platform. You will ensure that core capabilities are optimized for service and contact center users.
  • Industry Representation & Thought Leadership: Evangelize products and become the subject matter expert for internal audiences, external customers, and market facing communications
  • Requirement Synthesis: Translate the nuances of the service and contact center processes into detailed functional and technical specifications.
  • AI & Intelligent Orchestration: Partner with the AI PM team to build agents that help service and contact center reps utilize CRM efficiently and effectively.
  • Full Lifecycle Management: Work with UX, engineering, QA, and services teams to guide features from initial concept and design to global release and customer adoption.

• 5+ years of product management experience in the Service/Contact Center or CCaaS software industry
  • Experience in researching and understanding customer and market requirements to develop short and long term product roadmaps and plans 
  • Experience developing configurable enterprise SaaS solutions in an agile environment
  • Experience writing detailed user stories and managing a feature backlog
  • Track record of effectively collaborating with engineering/QA to define, design, and deliver product
  • Ability to understand and communicate architectural requirements, preferences, and limitations
  • Experience interacting with customers, development, and consulting teams, both local and remote.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment, with little direct supervision. 
  • Strong communication skills: written, verbal, and formal presentation
  • A strong sense of professional ethics

• Experience with conversational AI, recommendation engines, or large language models (LLMs)
  • Experience with configurable enterprise SaaS solutions.
  • Prior exposure to the Veeva Vault Platform.
  • Background in software development or computer science.

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $120,000 - $200,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

The Role
Vault CRM is an industry-leading product purpose-built for life sciences, with more than 80% market share, transforming how pharmaceutical, biotech, and medtech companies engage with healthcare professionals worldwide. This is an opportunity to build on a foundation of market leadership while driving the next wave of innovation in AI-powered customer engagement.
 
Vault CRM delivers:
A unified suite that integrates CRM with campaign management, contact centers, sales planning, events management, and more which enables customers to break down silos and enables smarter, more connected workflows.
Next-generation AI agents that deliver intelligent, context-driven engagement across commercial and medical teams.
Global compliance, with region-specific functionality and hundreds of built-in compliance features to support highly regulated markets.
Always-on productivity, with full offline support across Windows, Mac, and iOS, ensuring seamless use anywhere.
Deep functionality purpose-built for life sciences and strengthened by data lakehouse technology and modern cloud architecture - all built on the Veeva Vault Platform.
Integrations with other leading technology providers such as Microsoft 365, Concur, Workday, Zoom, and more.
Product Managers at Veeva:
Influence product direction and strategy in one of the world’s most widely used enterprise CRM applications.
Collaborate with life sciences and technology experts to shape the next generation of AI-powered, data-driven CRM solutions.
Drive Veeva’s AI and data initiative by designing functionality that combines intelligent orchestration and natural language interfaces.
See their work adopted at scale, with features rolled out across some of the world’s largest and most innovative life sciences companies.
Work for a product-focused company with a clear product vision set from the top, and where product knowledge and instinct are valued at all levels.
Contribute to a mission that matters by accelerating how new therapies reach patients and improving global healthcare outcomes.
This role offers the best of both worlds: the chance to work on a product with global scale and proven adoption, while still innovating at the cutting edge of AI, data, and platform extensibility. You’ll have visibility with senior leaders, influence roadmap decisions, and shape how an entire industry engages with its customers.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
 
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
 
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.


The Role
The Vault QMS product team is looking for an all-star Senior Product Manager to define, design, and deliver the next generation of game-changing capabilities for our Quality Events module. In this role, you will be responsible for launching new capabilities, enhancing existing functionality, and working with internal and external stakeholders to define the strategic roadmap of the module. You will work closely with customers, sales, consulting, and engineering teams and results will improve the lives of millions.
 
If you have a passion for creating world-class products and enjoy solving complex problems with simple elegant solutions, you will be a great fit for this position.

The Role

The Vault QMS product team is looking for an all-star Senior Product Manager to define, design, and deliver the next generation of game-changing capabilities for our Quality Events module. In this role, you will be responsible for launching new capabilities, enhancing existing functionality, and working with internal and external stakeholders to define the strategic roadmap of the module. You will work closely with customers, sales, consulting, and engineering teams and results will improve the lives of millions.
 
If you have a passion for creating world-class products and enjoy solving complex problems with simple elegant solutions, you will be a great fit for this position.

lists.content:
• Be hands on. Design, prototype, configure, and iterate on design to rapidly ensure capabilities are solving the right problems and achieving the intended business outcomes
  • Be the product evangelist. Become the subject matter expert for internal audiences and external customers
  • Author and design high-quality product specifications/UI flows to communicate actionable requirements to your engineering teammates. Engage and test alongside with QA to ensure capabilities function as designed. Identify areas of improvement with ruthless prioritization to ensure on-time delivery
  • Proactively generate content to educate on business value, configuration best practices, and how-to’s for delivered capabilities
  • Keep an eye on innovation, market trends, and engage in frequent conversations with internal audiences and external customers to identify areas of improvement
  • Cultivate learnings into an actionable product roadmap, collaborating and aligning with cross-functional teams

• 5+ years of Product Management experience in enterprise business application software
  • Ability to think creatively and critically in a dynamic work environment
  • Demonstrated skills in design, solving complex problems, phased product development, and planning
  • Ability to manage complex initiatives with limited supervision
  • Driven, focused, and quick to take ownership of work
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Experience with Life Sciences or Quality Management Software (QMS) products
  • Experience in digital design tools such as Figma or Sketch
  • Experience designing data models to support business processes
  • Experience developing configurable Enterprise SaaS solutions
  • Passion for clean user interface design

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $120,000 - $200,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
 
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
 
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

A Senior Product Manager for Veeva Clinical Operations will own the product strategy and roadmap for key applications that are transforming how the life sciences industry runs clinical trials. You will be responsible for defining and delivering innovative solutions that unify clinical systems, data, and processes to speed the delivery of new therapies to patients. This role is a unique opportunity to shape the future of an industry-leading product suite and have an impact on global health.

lists.content:
• Own the end-to-end product lifecycle, from ideation and strategy through development, launch, and iteration for applications within the Vault Clinical Operations suite.
  • Engage deeply with customers, industry experts, and internal stakeholders to identify market needs, gather requirements, and define a compelling product vision.
  • Author clear and concise feature specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria in collaboration with Engineering, QA and design teams.
  • Prioritize the product backlog, balancing customer enhancement requests, new features, and strategic initiatives to deliver maximum value.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert and product evangelist for your application, effectively communicating the vision, roadmap, and features to both internal and external audiences.
  • Educate Sales, Solution Consultants, Professional Services and Support Teams through written materials and demonstrations to drive customer adoption and support customer issues.
  • Define and analyze key metrics to measure product success, inform data-driven decisions, and demonstrate business impact.
  • Stay current with regulatory changes affecting the clinical operations domain.

• 5+ years of Product Management experience, preferably with a focus on B2B enterprise SaaS applications.
  • Proven track record of managing all stages of the product lifecycle and successfully launching products or features that meet customer needs.
  • Experience working in an agile development environment and collaborating effectively with engineering, QA and design teams.
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate a clear vision and influence cross-functional teams without formal authority.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a demonstrated ability to make data-informed decisions.
  • Unwavering commitment to professional integrity and ethical decision-making.
  • Ability to travel for on-site customer meetings, user research, and events (approximately 10-15% travel).

• Direct experience and deep domain knowledge in clinical trial operations, gained from working at a pharmaceutical company, biotech, CRO, or a clinical technology provider.
  • Experience working in a regulated environment and knowledge of industry standards such as ICH GCP and FDA 21 CFR Part 11.
  • Familiarity with the Veeva Vault Platform or other Veeva applications.

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $120,000 - $200,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

lists.content:
Project Oversight

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of solutions, from project initiation through successful go-live and continuous improvement phases
  • Facilitate delivery and execution of new customer implementations, managing multiple workstreams, dependencies, enforces timelines, budget and quality
  • Monitor project progress, proactively manage risks and issues, and ensure projects stay on schedule and within scope
  • Ensure gaps, risks and timelines are clearly communicated with clear follow-up to task owners until completion.
  • Consistent review of overall project timeline and identify and communicate risks to project completion timeline clearly and with detailed steps to ensure success.

    • Relationship Management

  • Build and nurture strong, lasting relationships with customers and internal teams.
  • Serve as the primary liaison between customer stakeholders and Veeva, addressing needs, resolving concerns, and ensuring satisfaction.
  • Guide customers in adopting industry and Veeva best practices, with a focus on long-term value realization and process optimization

    • Customer Support

  • Understand project objectives, timelines, deliverables, challenges, and opportunities to deliver tailored solutions.
  • Proactively provide updates to timeline, project status, risks and gaps.

    • Collaboration and Coordination

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless delivery of services and solutions.
  • Facilitate communication between internal departments to align on project goals and deliverables.

• B.S. or B.A. degree or equivalent experience
  • PMP Certification
  • 5-8 years of project management experience in software implementation, with a strong background in project management and customer-facing delivery
  • Demonstrated success leading technology implementations
  • Pharmaceutical Speaker Bureau experience is a plus
  • Pharmaceutical Event Planning experience is a plus
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Professional and clear oral and written communication
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate business needs into actionable project plans
  • Demonstrate ability to work in a fast-paced environment, and/or multitask often to meet fluctuating customer/company priorities 
  • Possesses strong leadership presence and are entirely comfortable holding people accountable to ensure project success and timely execution.
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), Google Suite of Applications, Smartsheet
  • Must be able to travel and work onsite for customer meetings

• Familiar with health sciences and regulated environments
  • Maintain current knowledge of appropriate regulations, e.g., OIG, PhRMA Code
  • Fundamental knowledge of Veeva Commercial Cloud Product Suite including by not limited to Veeva CRM, Veeva Vault, Events Management, and Engage
  • Ability to work and thrive in a team atmosphere
  • Positive attitude and maintain a “Whatever it Takes” attitude

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $75,000 - $115,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

The Role

We are looking for an experienced pharmacovigilance professional to serve as our Senior Safety Domain Expert for Veeva Falcon. This role bridges ground-level case execution with macro-level safety operations, using your deep knowledge of case processing, MedDRA coding, database reconciliation, and global compliance to inform our AI driven automation tools. You will spend your days collaborating with our internal technical teams and external early adopters, acting as the definitive "Voice of the Customer" to ensure our platform delivers flawless safety automation.

lists.content:
• End-to-End Workflow Guidance: Advise product and engineering teams on the detailed steps of safety case intake, triage, validation, and advanced data reconciliation workflows
  • Ground-Truth Verification: Actively review and verify platform outputs across initial data entry, automated MedDRA coding assignment, and generated follow-up queries to ensure absolute data precision
  • Early Adopter Engagement: Interact directly with PV leads and processing specialists at early adopter organizations, translating their feedback into actionable platform enhancements
  • Stress-Test Scenario Building: Map out highly complex, multi-variable safety case scenarios to rigorously evaluate and calibrate the platform's reasoning boundaries

• 5+ years of active experience in Pharmacovigilance / Drug Safety Operations
  • Extensive hands-on knowledge of the complete case lifecycle, including validation criteria, database reconciliation, and global expedited reporting timelines
  • High proficiency with MedDRA coding rules and deep familiarity with mainstream safety databases (e.g., Veeva Safety, Argus, ArisG)
  • Strong collaborative mindset with the ability to confidently present operational perspectives to non-clinical technical partners and customers

• Prior experience contributing to the design, implementation, or user-acceptance testing (UAT) of automated pharmacovigilance intake solutions
  • Prior experience with, or a strong baseline curiosity about, agentic AI, automated workflows, or next-generation cloud platforms in clinical trials

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $120,000 - $180,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

lists.content:
As a Backend Engineer, you will design and deliver scalable backend services that power Veeva Ostro’s SaaS platform. In this role, you’ll balance high-velocity delivery with long-term code health, building impactful features while championing clean architecture, rigorous testing, and low technical debt.

  • Architect and scale high-performance APIs for Veeva Ostro’s SaaS platform
  • Partner cross-functionally to design and ship new features
  • Provide technical feedback on product roadmaps and feature scoping
  • Champion quality through peer reviews, unit testing, and clean architecture
  • Optimize application and database performance to handle growth
  • Evaluate emerging backend technologies to improve engineering practices
  • Troubleshoot and resolve live system issues to maximize uptime

• 5+ years of software engineering experience shipping production code for B2B or B2C SaaS products
  • 5+ years of deep expertise in Python and frameworks like Django
  • Strong proficiency with relational databases, preferably PostgreSQL
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional teamwork skills

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $110,000 - $270,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

The Role

The Senior Tax Analyst will support the domestic tax operations of Veeva and will serve as the primary preparer of the income tax provision, coordinate income tax compliance workflows with external partners, and take full ownership of the internal and external information request processes.  Additionally, the candidate will drive non-income tax compliance and support tax account reconciliations.

lists.content:
• Prepare quarterly and annual global ASC 740 tax provision, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
  • Execute calculations for tax implications related to ASC 718 Stock-Based Compensation, 162(m), and other tax provision components.
  • Support tax accounting control compliance under Sarbanes-Oxley.
  • Own the internal and external information request process for tax provision, compliance, and audits.
  • Execute detailed reviews of income tax return workpapers and returns prepared by external service providers, including verifying book/tax differences, state apportionment, and required disclosures.
  • Coordinate the compliance timeline and execute a detailed review of all corporate income tax extensions and quarterly estimated tax workpapers prepared by external service providers.
  • Share operational responsibility for the accurate, timely calculation and processing of related tax payments to guarantee zero late or missed filings and payments.
  • Drive the non-income tax operational pipeline, ensuring accurate, timely filing of federal and state and local business licenses, gross receipts, and payments with zero missed deadlines.
  • Draft initial responses to federal and state notices, tax audits, and compile required documentation to support inquiries from authorities.
  • Prepare monthly general ledger tax account reconciliations and necessary journal entries.
  • Conduct research and provide insightful analysis on tax implications of specific transactions.

• 3+ years of hands-on experience in federal and state income tax compliance and reporting, including a minimum of 2 years in a CPA firm.
  • Foundational preparation expertise in ASC 740 tax provision models.
  • A sharp analytical mindset with a knack for problem-solving.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills to meet tight deadlines.
  • Proficient in Excel.

• A degree in Finance or Accounting (B.S./B.A.).
  • CPA License or a Master’s in Taxation.
  • Experience with Big 4 firms or in a multinational corporate setting.
  • Previous exposure to Netsuite.

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $90,000 - $150,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

Veeva Link’s vision is to build connected data applications that improve research and patient outcomes. 
 
As a Team Lead for one of our Data Operations teams, you will lead a remote team of 50+ freelancers who do rule-based web research. You will design business processes and drive process improvements as well as technology improvements. 
 
You plan and control these business processes and support their execution by removing barriers for your team members. Your primary focus is to improve process efficiency and reduce defects. As a first-line manager and servant leader, you deliver operational metrics associated with your process and results while keeping your team engaged.
 
To thrive in your role, you are highly motivated to lead and have a “can do” attitude. You are results-oriented, analytical, organized, and socially skilled. You communicate effectively with managers, analysts, and researchers.

Whether you choose to work at home or in one of our offices, you enjoy working with autonomy and in an international environment. We have a great remote working culture where people work hard, have fun, and grow.

The Role

Veeva Link’s vision is to build connected data applications that improve research and patient outcomes. 

As a Senior Team Lead for one of our Data Operations teams, you will lead a remote team of 50+ freelancers who execute on large-scale data generation pipelines. You will design business processes and drive process improvements as well as technology improvements.

You plan and control these business processes and support their execution by removing barriers for your team members. Your primary focus is to improve process efficiency and reduce defects. As a first-line manager and servant leader, you deliver operational metrics associated with your process and results while keeping your team engaged.

To thrive in your role, you are highly motivated to lead and have a “can do” attitude. You are results-oriented, analytical, organized, and socially skilled. You communicate effectively with leadership, analysts, engineers and researchers.

The ideal candidate for this role has a strong interest in people management, a process-oriented mindset, and an excellent work ethic. Whether you choose to work at home or in one of our offices, you enjoy working with autonomy and in an international environment. We have a great remote working culture where people work hard, have fun, and grow.

lists.content:
• Lead technical discovery workshops to define integration requirements and align on architectural best practices
  • Design and document end-to-end integration flows between Patient CRM and external entities, including Hubs, Specialty Pharmacies, and Data Aggregators
  • Articulate complex technical and integration concepts to both business and IT audiences
  • Develop and leverage expertise in the Vault platform to build scalable, high-performance solutions
  • Plan, manage, and perform technical build activities, including API configurations, middleware orchestration, and batch data processing
  • Identify and monitor technical interdependencies between various workstreams to mitigate project risk
  • Contribute to the development of technical implementation methodologies and reusable integration assets for the Patient CRM team
  • Support pre-sales activities by providing technical architecture reviews, scope definition, and responding to complex functional inquiries
  • Collaborate with Product and Strategy teams to provide feedback on technical capabilities and drive product excellence
  • Mentor junior technical consultants to facilitate a growing and collaborative team environment

• 7+ years of demonstrated technical consulting or technical architecture experience
  • Proven expertise in Life Sciences, with a specific focus on the technical challenges of patient support and patient engagement
  • Deep knowledge of modern integration approaches, including Middleware, direct REST/SOAP APIs, and secure batch file sharing
  • Experience architecting data exchanges between diverse entities such as CRM platforms, hubs, and specialty pharmacies
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior IT management through technical subject matter expertise
  • Adept at simplifying complex data mapping and vendor integration concepts for varying stakeholder groups
  • Strong solution design skills with a focus on data integrity and security
  • Ability to manage multiple technical workstreams concurrently in a fast-paced environment
  • Travel requirements are flexible; implementation roles may involve up to 25% travel

• Experience operating in a lean, agile, and evolving startup-like setting within a larger organization
  • Prior experience building or leading a technical service offering within a software vendor environment
  • Demonstrated experience in developing and refining technical delivery frameworks and best practices
  • Proven ability to coach junior team members towards successful technical project delivery

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $80,000 - $200,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.
