lists.content:
• Lead technical discovery workshops to define integration requirements and align on architectural best practices
  • Design and document end-to-end integration flows between Patient CRM and external entities, including Hubs, Specialty Pharmacies, and Data Aggregators
  • Articulate complex technical and integration concepts to both business and IT audiences
  • Develop and leverage expertise in the Vault platform to build scalable, high-performance solutions
  • Plan, manage, and perform technical build activities, including API configurations, middleware orchestration, and batch data processing
  • Identify and monitor technical interdependencies between various workstreams to mitigate project risk
  • Contribute to the development of technical implementation methodologies and reusable integration assets for the Patient CRM team
  • Support pre-sales activities by providing technical architecture reviews, scope definition, and responding to complex functional inquiries
  • Collaborate with Product and Strategy teams to provide feedback on technical capabilities and drive product excellence
  • Mentor junior technical consultants to facilitate a growing and collaborative team environment

• 7+ years of demonstrated technical consulting or technical architecture experience
  • Proven expertise in Life Sciences, with a specific focus on the technical challenges of patient support and patient engagement
  • Deep knowledge of modern integration approaches, including Middleware, direct REST/SOAP APIs, and secure batch file sharing
  • Experience architecting data exchanges between diverse entities such as CRM platforms, hubs, and specialty pharmacies
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior IT management through technical subject matter expertise
  • Adept at simplifying complex data mapping and vendor integration concepts for varying stakeholder groups
  • Strong solution design skills with a focus on data integrity and security
  • Ability to manage multiple technical workstreams concurrently in a fast-paced environment
  • Travel requirements are flexible; implementation roles may involve up to 25% travel

• Experience operating in a lean, agile, and evolving startup-like setting within a larger organization
  • Prior experience building or leading a technical service offering within a software vendor environment
  • Demonstrated experience in developing and refining technical delivery frameworks and best practices
  • Proven ability to coach junior team members towards successful technical project delivery

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $80,000 - $200,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

  • Influential experience in leading teams through hard decisions and negotiating compromises
  • Experience in working in a Consulting and/or customer-facing role, and managing customer expectations
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Proven ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment, comprehending and translating business requirements, and creating corresponding solution designs
  • University degree or equivalent relevant experience

  • Knowledge of Software Validation processes and requirements
  • Project management experience
  • Execution experience with Agile methodology and/or ACP Certification

  • Proficiency in additional European language(s)

    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Health & wellness programs

As a key member of our Professional Services team, the Senior Technical Consultant will lead customer implementations by providing expertise with solution architecture design, technical integration design, and Vault Platform best practices. lists.content:
• Provide subject matter expertise on the Veeva Systems implementation, Vault R&D product suite, Vault Platform, technical design, and Software as a Service (SaaS) implementation best practices
  • Design and implement cloud-based integrations
  • Design and provide subject matter expertise for the development of custom applications
  • Implement Java-based solutions using the Vault Java SDK
  • Manage integration and development projects and resources
  • Contribute to our professional services knowledge base
  • Develop internal and external tools to help our customers and our consultants
  • Partner with other parts of the organization to deliver technical presentations to current and prospective customers to evangelize the value of Veeva’s solution.

• 7+ years of experience with integration architecture, design, and development for enterprise/cloud software (Salesforce.com, PeopleSoft, Oracle, Siebel, SAP, Workday, etc.) or document/content management systems (Documentum, OpenText, SharePoint, etc.)
  • 7+ years of customer-facing technical consulting experience
  • 5+ years of development experience with one of the following languages – Java, .NET, Python, C#, or C++
  • Experience building solutions and interfaces in the cloud, SaaS applications using REST APIs
  • Proven track record meeting with senior management and executives as the subject matter expert
  • Experience leading and mentoring team members
  • Excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with SDLC process
  • Ability to articulate integration design patterns
  • Ability to travel up to 10%
  • Must be both located in and legally authorized to be employed in the United States or Canada

• Experience in the pharmaceutical and life sciences industry
  • Experience with Clinical, Regulatory, Quality, or Safety business processes
  • Project Management experience for enterprise software implementations
  • Experience with GxP regulations and software validation process
  • Document/Data migration experience
  • Product Manager experience
  • Experience with source code control systems
  • Amazon Web Services (AWS) tools such as Lambda and EC2

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $80,000 - $175,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

lists.content:
• Own documentation for multiple areas within CRM Product; deliver new content on a monthly release content and manage existing content, ensuring it’s easy for customers to find and use
  • Leverage AI tools and automation to improve documentation efficiency, quality, and speed-of-delivery
  • Support our multimedia content strategy, including video and eLearning resources, to meet customers where they are
  • Contribute to improvements in documentation workflows and websites/content structure
  • Build strong relationships with product, engineering, and other stakeholders to stay ahead of upcoming changes and ensure content reflects the product accurately
  • Collaborate with other writers and participate in review cycles
  • Apply and help evolve team standards and processes for writing, publishing, and distribution

• 8+ years of technical writing experience or equivalent in a related role (for example, information design, knowledge management, documentation engineering)
  • Experience managing content across complex multi-product or multi-service environments
  • Experience with AI-driven content workflows and tooling
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with a track record of building effective cross-team relationships
  • Strong prioritization and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities in a deadline-driven environment
  • Experience with technical authoring environments and docs-as-code approach
  • Portfolio or samples that demonstrate your ability to structure, manage, and deliver content for a technical audience
  • U.S. West location (Pacific Timezone)

• Experience working for an enterprise software company (strongly preferred)
  • Experience with Git, XML, HTML, Markdown, and/or Madcap Flare (strongly preferred)
  • Experience with video production, eLearning development, or creating interactive training materials to support a multimedia content strategy
  • Familiarity with web development and programming languages (HTML, XML, CSS; Python, React, Javascript)

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $85,000 - $140,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
 
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
 
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
 
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.


The Role
Veeva’s China Business Consulting Group is a key growth area for Veeva. It offers a differentiated consulting service in Life Sciences with a compelling value proposition - building on Veeva’s position as the digital partner of choice for 85% of the top 20 Pharmaceutical companies.
As part of the Veeva Business Consulting Team, you will be part of the team responsible for building and delivering insightful solutions (through face-to-face and virtual discussions, workshops, email, etc.) to deliver demonstrable, sustainable value at the forefront of digital and commercial innovation. As a (Senior) Consultant, you will manage workstreams on consulting projects for Veeva’s Commercial Life Sciences customers: planning, organizing, and tracking all aspects of delivery in that workstream and developing close working relationships with customers.

lists.content:
• Lead a workstream(s) in a project engagement: planning, organizing, and managing all aspects of delivery, including scope, quality, resources, risk, and timelines
  • Be responsible for the end-to-end design, build, and delivery of project deliverables that meet specific project goals and objectives
  • Identify and proactively solve problems faced by the Client
  • Be a primary Client contact for operational project questions, build trusted relationships with Client stakeholders through interactions in person and remotely 
  • Manage the work and priorities of Associate Consultants in your workstream
  • Support and mentor Associates in developing skills and professional capabilities
  • Demonstrating ability to assimilate new knowledge
  • Possess good business acumen
  • Remaining current on new developments in advisory services capabilities and industry knowledge
  • Input into business development opportunities and proposals
  • Help develop and disseminate thought leadership

• Bachelor's degree and excellent academic record
  • 3+ years of consulting experience and/or in-house business operation experience
  • Experience in Life Sciences, particularly in Commercial Operations/Commercial Excellence and/or consulting in this sector is preferred
  • Good understanding of Commercial, with deeper expertise in two or more of the following areas: Omni-Channel strategy and optimization, product launch, Go-to-Market strategy, commercial model design, key account planning and management, segmentation and targeting, insight and analytics, digital transformation, and brand strategy
  • Good understanding of commercial/marketing technology and how business consulting offerings can both leverage and support these
  • Good understanding of the business capabilities and drivers underpinning digital technology in Health and Life Sciences and the market forces and trends driving industry changes
  • Strong analytical skills to quantitatively and qualitatively assess problems and communicate responses across a range of issues
  • A problem-solving mindset: anticipating issues early, analyzing and proactively finding solutions
  • Highly effective project management skills
  • Skilled in facilitating collaboration amongst team members
  • Able to work effectively with people at all levels in an organization and quickly establish credibility
  • Have a strong personal impact and ability to influence and persuade a range of stakeholders
  • Data scientist experience is preferred
  • An effective communicator verbally and written in English
  • Ability to travel roughly 50%, but this can vary depending on engagement/environment 
  • Need the right to work in China

• Experience with digital technologies and analytics tools, such as Python / Power BI / LLM / AWS, etc.
  • Experience working with SaaS solutions
  • Understanding/experience of AI and its applications in sales and marketing

• Highly competitive remuneration
  • Opportunity for rapid progression in a high-growth business
  • Veeva Giving: Financial contributions for the societal causes you’re passionate about 
  • Health & wellness programs

The Role
Join Veeva as we advance our MedTech customers through the adoption of next-generation Commercial Solutions by building the services team for the industry. Veeva Systems drives innovation for our customers. In this role, you will lead the charge in ensuring customer success—both during implementation and beyond—for our commercial solutions serving Medtech clients. We are looking for a person that thrives in a fast-paced environment who can partner with our customers to innovate on new solutions and build sustainable processes.
 
Managing with a focus on operational excellence includes:
Ensuring customer and employee success and leading through ambiguity
Leading through hands-on and strategic initiatives for long-term success
Cultivating a positive and productive environment
Driving new practices to support implementation excellence
Creating innovative collateral to support delivery
Partnering with global and cross-function teams to provide the best outcomes
This is a remote, US-based position with required travel.

lists.content:
• Accountable to the delivery of MedTech customer success with Veeva’s Commercial Solutions through efficient and appreciated services
  • Partners with Services Engagement management team to ensure correct offerings and customer success
  • Onboard and enable resources to drive success on the MedTech projects
  • Team Management - drives the how we hire and develops the team to manage capacity, utilization, staffing on all projects
  • Manage supply and demand. Responsible for staffing the right people on the right projects and providing oversight to ensure delivery success
  • Support and coach. Find and create billable work to drive productivity
  • Manage escalations and support sales and other teams in the pre-sales process to build and maintain strong customer relationships with the customer
  • Cultivate trusted relationships with customers that drives high value services
  • Coordinate across projects and other Veeva functions to ensure lessons learned and best practices are shared to improve service delivery
  • Provide executive oversight of internal initiatives and project sponsorship
  • Build an internal network across Veeva - Sales, Strategy, Product, and Services - to champion customer and employee success

• 10+ years of experience in Enterprise Software Implementation
  • 2+ years of people management experience
  • Proven track record of managing large complex systems projects and teams
  • Expertise in enterprise software with deep understanding in system integration to drive product implementation
  • Operational excellence in leading Services including utilization and resource management

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $80,000 - $200,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

lists.content:
• Selling Value of Veeva Services: Educate customers on methodology and the value of Veeva’s Professional Services - why should they want to work with us? Set appropriate expectations of what we can/should/won’t do
  • Engagement Design: Define and prescribe the best Professional Services model for a given customer, based on an in-depth understanding of their needs and business objectives, through Proposals, Statements of Work, and RFx responses
  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with cross-functional stakeholders across sales, strategy, services, business consulting, solutions consulting, and others to ensure optimal engagement approach and positioning
  • Operational Excellence: Take strong ownership of a high-volume pipeline through consistent execution, a sense of urgency/speed, flawless data management, and appropriate stakeholder communication (from internal Associates to external C-Suite)
  • Leadership Through Influence: Provide thought partnership to the broader business and drive meaningful results without a direct reporting structure; embrace creative conflict with diplomacy and humility

• 3+ years of experience delivering software implementation and enhancement projects (Program Manager, Project Manager, Functional/Business Analyst, Practice Manager, etc.)
  • 1+ years of experience scoping/defining project plans, resource models, and negotiation of Statements of Work for software implementation projects a plus
  • Background in Life Sciences, Health Care, or Tech preferred; Experience working with Clinical Operations, Pharmacovigilance, or Regulatory Information Management (RIM) software applications a plus
  • A problem-solving and customer services-oriented mentality to drive the positioning and sales of professional services; Consulting, Tech Sales, and Program/Project Management experience
  • Remote role based in North America, with ability to work across time zones and travel when required (~10-15%)

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $85,000 - $170,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

lists.content:
• Selling Value of Veeva Services: Educate customers on methodology and the value of Veeva’s Professional Services - why should they want to work with us? Set appropriate expectations of what we can/should/won’t do
  • Engagement Design: Define and prescribe the best Professional Services model for a given customer, based on an in-depth understanding of their needs and business objectives, through Proposals, Statements of Work, and RFx responses
  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with cross-functional stakeholders across sales, strategy, services, business consulting, solutions consulting, and others to ensure optimal engagement approach and positioning
  • Operational Excellence: Take strong ownership of a high-volume pipeline through consistent execution, a sense of urgency/speed, flawless data management, and appropriate stakeholder communication (from internal Associates to external C-Suite)
  • Leadership Through Influence: Provide thought partnership to the broader business and drive meaningful results without a direct reporting structure; embrace creative conflict with diplomacy and humility

• 3+ years of experience delivering software implementation and enhancement projects (Program Manager, Project Manager, Functional/Business Analyst, Practice Manager, etc.)
  • 1+ years of experience scoping/defining project plans, resource models, and negotiation of Statements of Work for software implementation projects a plus
  • Background in Life Sciences, Health Care, or Tech preferred; Experience working with Clinical Operations, Pharmacovigilance, or Regulatory Information Management (RIM) software applications a plus
  • A problem-solving and customer services-oriented mentality to drive the positioning and sales of professional services; Consulting, Tech Sales, and Program/Project Management experience
  • Remote role based in North America, with ability to work across time zones and travel when required (~10-15%)

    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays

  • Develop and contribute to test automation for Infrastructure features including Zero downtime upgrades/HA/DR etc.
  • Apply your programming skills toward automating and optimizing the testing of cloud-based Infrastructure
  • Build, maintain, and improve the existing automation framework, test harness, and processes
  • Perform activities such as automation execution, bug verifications, triage automation results, etc., and verify outcomes within release milestones

  • Work in the Hyderabad Veeva office four days/week

• Experience working in a product-based company.

  • Knowledge using AWS SDK (Java) for validation or automation.
  • Basic knowledge of Groovy scripting for Jenkins pipeline.
  • Participation in code reviews, internal tools, hackathons, or automation initiatives.
  • Curiosity and willingness to learn DevOps and cloud-native testing practices.

lists.content:

• Life Science/Pharma industry experience
  • SaaS product implementation and customer delivery experience
  • Experience with low-code/no-code enterprise AI platforms
  • Cloud platform experience (AWS/Azure/Alibaba Cloud)

Veeva’s Commercial Cloud brings together software, AI, data, and consulting to the life sciences industry. As a Solution Consultant for Commercial Cloud, you will be delivering value-based product demonstrations as well as architecture presentations to prospects and existing customers. You will act as industry, technical and value advisor to our key customers. Not just software: you will also demonstrate Vault AI and Veeva Agentic competitive advantage and how these help improve productivity.
 
As a key member of the Korea Commercial organization, you will operate with high autonomy, similar to a ‘mini-startup’. Your work will make a direct and visible impact, right from demos to scoping to project definition. The Role
The Manager of Solution Consulting role at Veeva is focused on driving the adoption and growth of Veeva Data Cloud through pre-sales engagement. Veeva Data Cloud is the modern data foundation for Biopharma, overcoming the limitations of fragmented systems with a complete suite of commercial data products: reference data, deep data, performance data, and access data.
 
This is a hybrid role that combines deep technical data expertise with a consultative, client-facing approach. You will be responsible for supporting customer engagements in pre-sales, which includes working directly with customers to build brand awareness, highlighting product points of differentiation, and guiding customer data assessments. Additionally, you will demonstrate how these products can be used to drive value for customers by discovering new patients and healthcare providers, growing top-line revenue, and increasing bottom line efficiency.
 
Leveraging your technical skills and industry expertise, you will also educate prospective customers as to how Compass and HCP 360 products are used to support key use cases, including how:
  Compass Patient provides a more complete patient journey
  Compass Prescriber can be leveraged for segmentation, targeting, and incentive compensation
Compass National delivers more accurate forecasting, performance tracking, and competitive analysis
 HCP Access can be used to drive better segmentation and targeting, call planning, and field execution
This role is a key part of Data Cloud’s commercial strategy. The feedback you receive from customers in-market will be curated and shared with members of the Compass and HCP Access teams to inform product roadmap and feature releases.
 
If you are intellectually curious and get excited about bringing new products to market, this is a great opportunity for you.

lists.content:
• Subject-Matter Expertise: You will serve as the go-to expert on Veeva Compass and HCP Access, with heightened focus on its APLD data products: Compass Patient, Pathway and Data Connector. Your role is to articulate the value proposition and expertly address customer questions and potential objections
  • Consultative Selling: You will adopt a consultative approach, working directly with customers to understand their business needs and therapeutic area dynamics. You will then design and deliver custom data assessments and product demonstrations that precisely demonstrate how Compass solves their most critical commercial use cases
  • Pre-Sales Framework Design: Contribute to the pre-sales framework, including standardized processes, methodologies and analysis templates, to create a consistent, repeatable, and scalable approach for all customer engagements
  • Project Management: You will manage multiple analytics projects, ensuring on-time delivery
  • Thought Leadership: You will serve as a key thought leader for Veeva Compass, helping to shape the market narrative and establish our brand as an authority in the industry. You will educate the industry on new and innovative product methodologies through customer-facing discussions, presentations, and the creation of forward-looking content
  • Strategic Contribution: You'll collect market feedback and share it with the strategy and product teams to influence the product roadmap and future feature releases. You will also contribute to new business development and assist Account Partners in responding to RFPs (Request for Proposals)
  • Client Relationship Management: You will serve as a trusted advisor to clients, working alongside account partners and strategists to build and maintain strong relationships at key accounts

General Experience
  • 8+ years of healthcare data and/or analytics experience, with deep knowledge in areas like Oncology and Rare Disease
  • Experience working with commercial teams in life sciences and managing client engagements
  • A demonstrated ability to successfully engage all levels of client organizations
    • Technical Expertise
  • Deep knowledge of and direct experience working with pharmaceutical commercial data sets, including specific data products from vendors like IQVIA (i.e., LAAD, Xponent, DDD, NPA, NSP), ICON (i.e., PatientSourceComplete, PatientSourceDuo, PrescriberSource, PayerSource, NonRetailSource), and Komodo MapLab
  • Ability to analyze large datasets using SQL
  • Proficiency in project management tools like Jira and Confluence
    • Other Skills
  • Excellent critical thinking, analysis, and presentation skills
  • A passion for bringing new products to market and entrepreneurial energy
  • The ability to function as a trusted advisor to customers
  • Ability to travel for customer meetings and internal events, as needed

• Data visualization expertise (Tableau, Power BI, Sigma)
  • Experience working with product and/or agile teams
  • Experience in labs and genomics data
  • Experience in remittance data

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $80,000 - $160,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

lists.content:
• Subject-Matter Expertise: You will serve as the go-to expert on Veeva Compass and HCP Access, with heightened focus on its APLD data products: Compass Patient, Pathway and Data Connector. Your role is to articulate the value proposition and expertly address customer questions and potential objections
  • Consultative Selling: You will adopt a consultative approach, working directly with customers to understand their business needs and therapeutic area dynamics. You will then design and deliver custom data assessments and product demonstrations that precisely demonstrate how Compass solves their most critical commercial use cases
  • Pre-Sales Framework Design: Contribute to the pre-sales framework, including standardized processes, methodologies and analysis templates, to create a consistent, repeatable, and scalable approach for all customer engagements
  • Project Management: You will manage multiple analytics projects, ensuring on-time delivery
  • Thought Leadership: You will serve as a key thought leader for Veeva Compass, helping to shape the market narrative and establish our brand as an authority in the industry. You will educate the industry on new and innovative product methodologies through customer-facing discussions, presentations, and the creation of forward-looking content
  • Strategic Contribution: You'll collect market feedback and share it with the strategy and product teams to influence the product roadmap and future feature releases. You will also contribute to new business development and assist Account Partners in responding to RFPs (Request for Proposals)
  • Client Relationship Management: You will serve as a trusted advisor to clients, working alongside account partners and strategists to build and maintain strong relationships at key accounts

General Experience:
  • 8+ years of healthcare data and/or analytics experience, with deep knowledge in areas like Oncology and Rare Disease
  • Experience working with commercial teams in life sciences and managing client engagements
  • A demonstrated ability to successfully engage all levels of client organizations
    • Technical Expertise:
  • Deep knowledge of and direct experience working with pharmaceutical commercial data sets, including specific data products from vendors like IQVIA (i.e., LAAD, Xponent, DDD, NPA, NSP), ICON (i.e., PatientSourceComplete, PatientSourceDuo, PrescriberSource, PayerSource, NonRetailSource), and Komodo MapLab
  • Ability to analyze large datasets using SQL
  • Proficiency in project management tools like Jira and Confluence
    • Other Skills:
  • Excellent critical thinking, analysis, and presentation skills
  • A passion for bringing new products to market and entrepreneurial energy
  • The ability to function as a trusted advisor to customers
  • Ability to travel for customer meetings and internal events, as needed

• Data visualization expertise (Tableau, Power BI, Sigma)
  • Experience working with product and/or agile teams
  • Experience in labs and genomics data
  • Experience in remittance data

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $80,000 - $160,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

The Role

As a Solution Consultant, you are the primary bridge between complex pharmacovigilance challenges and Veeva’s industry-leading cloud solutions. Acting as a trusted advisor to the world’s most innovative Life Sciences companies, you will help Safety/Pharmacovigilance teams move away from fragmented legacy systems and toward a unified Vault Safety platform.
 
The ideal candidate has a solid foundation in Life Sciences, technical curiosity, exceptional presentation and communication skills, and a team first attitude.

lists.content:
• Solve Unique Challenges: Uncover specific business challenges and craft solutions that show how Vault Safety streamlines end-to-end pharmacovigilance processes
  • Showcase Value: Deliver compelling, tailored presentations and demonstrations that highlight the tangible benefits and the value of the Vault Safety platform
  • Drive Innovation: Using your industry and technical knowledge you’ll identify how Veeva solutions can replace manual processes and drive innovation for our customers
  • Build Relationships: Establish yourself as a trusted advisor by building deep, credible relationships with pharmacovigilance stakeholders
  • Collaborate: Work closely with Account Partners, Strategists, and other cross-functional teams to ensure customer success

• Bachelor’s Degree
  • 3+ years of experience within the Life Sciences industry
  • Familiarity with end-to-end pharmacovigilance processes and lifecycles, including case processing, PSMF, PVAs, RMPs, and safety signal detection, validation, and management
  • Technical curiosity and an understanding of cloud/SaaS technology
  • Exceptional presentation skills
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, team first environment
  • Driven self-starter; able to work independently
  • Willingness to travel up to 20% of the time, primarily in North America

• Experience in pre-sales, Solution Consulting, or other related customer-facing roles
  • Experience in pharmacovigilance groups within pharmaceutical and biotech organizations
  • End-user and/or Administrator experience with Veeva products, Vault Safety, or other related Safety software
  • Experience with Artificial Intelligence (AI) or other advanced technical tools and concepts

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $80,000 - $160,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

Acting as a trusted advisor to the world’s most innovative Life Sciences companies, you will help Safety/Pharmacovigilance teams move away from fragmented legacy systems and toward a unified Vault Safety platform.

The ideal candidate has a solid foundation in Life Sciences, technical curiosity, exceptional presentation and communication skills, and a team first attitude.

lists.content:
• Solve Unique Challenges: Uncover specific business challenges and craft solutions that show how Vault Safety streamlines end-to-end pharmacovigilance processes
  • Showcase Value: Deliver compelling, tailored presentations and demonstrations that highlight the tangible benefits and the value of the Vault Safety platform
  • Drive Innovation: Using your industry and technical knowledge you’ll identify how Veeva solutions can replace manual processes and drive innovation for our customers
  • Build Relationships: Establish yourself as a trusted advisor by building deep, credible relationships with pharmacovigilance stakeholders
  • Collaborate: Work closely with Account Partners, Strategists, and other cross-functional teams to ensure customer success

• Bachelor’s Degree
  • 3+ years of experience within the Life Sciences industry
  • Familiarity with end-to-end pharmacovigilance processes and lifecycles, including case processing, PSMF, PVAs, RMPs, and safety signal detection, validation, and management
  • Technical curiosity and an understanding of cloud/SaaS technology
  • Exceptional presentation skills
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, team first environment
  • Driven self-starter; able to work independently
  • Willingness to travel up to 20% of the time, primarily in North America

• Experience in pre-sales, Solution Consulting, or other related customer-facing roles
  • Experience in pharmacovigilance groups within pharmaceutical and biotech organizations
  • End-user and/or Administrator experience with Veeva products, Vault Safety, or other related Safety software
  • Experience with Artificial Intelligence (AI) or other advanced technical tools and concepts

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $80,000 - $160,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

The Role

Veeva QualityOne is expanding in Korea, and we are looking for a Solution Consultant to become the local technical and solution authority for enterprise customers in regulated manufacturing sectors such as cosmetics, food & beverage, and chemicals.

You will partner closely with the Director, QualityOne Korea throughout the sales cycle to understand customer challenges, design value-based solution approaches, and help secure the technical win. This role is ideal for a hands-on pre-sales professional who can connect enterprise architecture, manufacturing workflows, and executive business outcomes.

lists.content:
• Partner with sales throughout the enterprise sales cycle, owning technical discovery, solution strategy, demo design, and technical validation with prospective customers.
  • Translate customer challenges in quality, document control, supplier governance, audits, compliance, and operations into clear solution designs using Veeva QualityOne.
  • Deliver tailored, industry-specific demonstrations for Korean manufacturers, including cosmetics brand owners, OEM/ODMs, F&B manufacturers, and chemical companies.
  • Lead or support RFI/RFP responses, architecture discussions, integration narratives, security/compliance questions, and technical follow-up with IT and business stakeholders.
  • Explain how QualityOne fits into enterprise landscapes that may include ERP, MES, PLM, LIMS, identity management, data platforms, and legacy custom systems.
  • Act as the local bridge to global product and services teams by sharing Korea market requirements, localization needs, customer feedback, and competitive insights.
  • Support local marketing and thought-leadership activities as a subject matter expert at executive roundtables, webinars, workshops, and customer meetings.

• 5+ years of experience in solution consulting, pre-sales engineering, solution architecture, or implementation consulting in Korea.
  • Experience with enterprise SaaS or business software, ideally in QMS, document management, PLM, ERP, MES, LIMS, supply chain, manufacturing operations, or compliance-related platforms.
  • Strong ability to conduct business discovery, understand process requirements, design solution narratives, and present to both technical and executive audiences.
  • Clear understanding of enterprise system landscapes and integration concepts, including how cloud applications coexist with ERP, MES, PLM, LIMS, and legacy systems.
  • Excellent presentation, demo, and storytelling skills with the ability to translate technical capabilities into business value and operational impact.
  • Comfortable working in a greenfield market with ambiguity, evolving messaging, and a need for category education.
  • Native-level Korean and professional English fluency for collaboration with global product, services, and engineering teams.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• Direct experience with QMS, document control, audit management, supplier quality, PLM, or manufacturing compliance solutions.
  • Experience supporting customers in cosmetics, food & beverage, chemicals, consumer products, or other regulated manufacturing sectors.
  • Familiarity with Korea MFDS, US MoCRA, GMP, HACCP, ISO, or other manufacturing quality and regulatory frameworks.
  • Prior experience as an early or founding solution consultant for a global SaaS company in Korea.

The Role

The Statutory Reporting Accountant manages the end-to-end statutory reporting cycle and local GAAP compliance for multiple European entities, bridging the gap between US GAAP, IFRS, and local requirements. This role requires a 'deep-dive' analytical mindset to resolve technical accounting queries and leads the coordination of complex year-end audits to ensure seamless regulatory integrity across borders.

lists.content:
• Drive end-to-end statutory reporting process for several European countries
  • Interpret and align disparate financial reporting frameworks (US GAAP, IRFS, and Local GAAP) quantifying technical variances and executing adjustments
  • Collaborate as the technical liaison and local expert, ensuring the successful transition to our new regional accounting and tax partner
  • Enable the Pillar 2 reconciliation process, ensuring alignment with international requirements
  • Advance statutory workstreams for critical finance system projects such as ERP tax bundles and localization module implementations
  • Embed statutory compliance workflows to enable audit readiness and mitigate risk
  • Spearhead the audit process, aligning with external auditors and tax authorities while acting as the point of contact for initial response to technical inquiries
  • Engage with internal teams (GL, Tax, Legal) and external partners to ensure accounting and data excellence
  • Maintain regulatory compliance by proactively tracking evolving European accounting standards and VAT legislation

• 4+ years of proven experience in a fast-paced, multinational environment, specifically owning the end-to-end statutory reporting cycle for multiple European entities.
  • A strong background in financial reporting with a focus on complex statutory filings and financial statement preparation.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting the statutory audit process
  • ACCA, CIMA, CPA, or a recognized national equivalent (e.g., Chartered Accountant)
  • Met rigorous statutory deadlines while managing high-volume workloads independently
  • Clearly communicated technical accounting and GAAP-to-Stat reconciliations to auditors
  • Excel proficiency for complex data reconciliation and reporting

• Growing knowledge of ESRS and CSRD frameworks
  • Practical experience with E-reporting and (i)XBRL tagging, ensuring digital filings meet regulatory technical standards.
  • Active involvement in M&A integrations and legal entity liquidations, providing accounting support for balance sheet migrations and closing entries.
  • Skilled in utilizing automation and data visualization tools (e.g., Alteryx, Power BI) to improve the speed and transparency of statutory reconciliations.

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Flexibility and autonomy to Work Anywhere
  • Glasses & Commuting Cost Reimbursement
  • Life & Private Medical Insurance
  • Cafeteria Policy
  • Allocation for charitable giving
  • Selection of fitness classes offered weekly
  • Healthy free snacks provided every day and lunch on Tuesdays and Wednesdays
  • Veeva break: additional company paid holidays over Christmas period (generally from December 24 to January 1)

• Total compensation: 8,000,000 - 12,000,000 HUF
  • The total compensation range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential total compensation range for this role. Please note that actual total compensation may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position's total compensation may be composed of other types of compensation, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

lists.content:
• Own adoption of the Crossix Suite within a set of key Emerging Biotech accounts
  • Work closely with Account Partners to identify key messaging, map stakeholders for engagement and lead customer meetings, and execute strategic account plans
  • Lead go to market messaging for new products and features
  • Forecast product adoption across our customers and prospects
  • Own early adopter success for new products. Includes defining criteria for who should be a target early adopter, messaging the value, and getting feedback from customers
  • Support delivery teams in best practice utilization of Crossix products and identify barriers to adoption

• 6+ years of successful client facing consulting and/or strategy experience
  • 4+ years in a media related role, including media planning and/or buying experience
  • 4+ years in an analytical role
  • Life Sciences experience required
  • Effective communicator, able to write and speak clearly and with confidence
  • Demonstrated experience managing projects and working effectively across functions and with peers
  • Bachelor’s degree with strong academic performance

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.
  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • If moving to the interview stage, our process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A personality assessment
    3. A practical case exercise
    4. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $125,000 - $300,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

Crossix is positioned at the center of big data, innovative technology, media, and life sciences. Our mission is to empower life sciences companies with the data and insights they need to drive DTC and HCP marketing effectiveness and, ultimately, better patient outcomes. As part of Veeva, the Crossix team offers the agility of a high-growth team with the stability of a global leader. 
 
The Strategy Director will be responsible for the adoption and commercial success of Crossix Analytics M&O partner products. This includes building and expanding relationships with DSPs and other biddable media partners, leading go to market strategy, identifying and removing blockers to sales, and ensuring success of early adopters. In this role, you will work closely with the Crossix Partnerships team and Crossix Account Partners acting as a market owner and subject matter expert on Crossix data, methodologies, products, and differentiators. You will participate in mapping out key targets both among partner companies for product development and among Life Sciences advertisers for product adoption. You will be expected to effectively communicate the value of Crossix partner products to customers in clear and compelling ways. You’ll drive cross-functional workstreams with product, marketing, and partnerships establishing a feedback loop to ensure products are positioned effectively and meeting customer expectations.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

lists.content:
• Partner with sales team in developing strategic partnerships with customers, leading to customer success
  • Deliver stable and repeatable revenue growth
  • Hold sales team accountable
  • Aid in effective new product/feature adoption and improvement

• At least 5 years of successful client facing consulting and/or strategy experience
  • At least 2 years in a media related role, including media planning and/or buying experience
  • Skilled data analyst with passion for using data to tell a story
  • Life Sciences experience required
  • Effective communicator, able to write and speak clearly and with confidence
  • Demonstrated experience managing projects and working effectively across functions and with peers

    3. A practical case exercise
    4. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

The Role
Veeva Link’s vision is to build connected data applications that improve research and patient outcomes. 
 
As a Team Lead for one of our Data Operations teams, you will lead a remote team of 50+ freelancers who execute on large-scale data generation pipelines. You will design business processes and drive process improvements as well as technology improvements.
 
You plan and control these business processes and support their execution by removing barriers for your team members. Your primary focus is to improve process efficiency and reduce defects. As a first-line manager and servant leader, you deliver operational metrics associated with your process and results while keeping your team engaged.
 
To thrive in your role, you are highly motivated to lead and have a “can do” attitude. You are results-oriented, analytical, organized, and socially skilled. You communicate effectively with leadership, analysts, engineers and researchers.
 
The ideal candidate for this role has a strong interest in people management, a process-oriented mindset, and an excellent work ethic. Whether you choose to work at home or in one of our offices, you enjoy working with autonomy and in an international environment. We have a great remote working culture where people work hard, have fun, and grow.

lists.content:
• Scale Leadership: Lead and mentor a dynamic remote team of approx. 50, fostering a proactive, high-performing environment at scale
  • Pioneer AI-Driven Solutions: Identify opportunities to integrate AI into operational workflows to accelerate web research, enhance data quality, and drive next-level automation
  • Operational Excellence: Take full ownership of team KPIs, ensuring daily targets for data quality and volume are met across your entire headcount
  • Collaborate on AI & Tools: Partner closely with engineering teams to build, test, and scale innovative AI-driven tooling and process automation
  • Process Architecture: Drive the implementation of quality and efficiency projects that allow a team of approx. 50 to operate as a cohesive unit

• Leadership: You have experience leading or coordinating others in a professional or fast-paced environment
  • Tech-Forward Mindset: A strong understanding of process workflows

The Role
Join Veeva as a Team Manager, Cloud Managed Services (Vault) and lead a high-performing team that ensures our Life Sciences customers achieve consistent, high-quality outcomes with their Veeva Vault applications. This role offers the opportunity to contribute directly to the operational excellence of global pharmaceutical and biotech organizations using best-in-class cloud technology.
 
You will oversee a growing team of consultants responsible for supporting customers’ Production Vaults, driving continuous enhancement, and maintaining system reliability. lists.content:
• Manage and grow a team of Consultants focusing on Managed Services work on the Veeva platform (Vault); for both small and large global accounts (Pharmaceutical and Biotech)
  • Lead your team including resource planning, follow up with their utilization, and ensure their professional growth leading to Employee Success
  • Own the hiring process for consultants in Poland and Hungary, ensuring a pipeline of high-caliber talent
  • Coordinate communication between implementation teams and Managed Services to ensure smooth transitions and consistent operational delivery
  • Serve as a point of leadership contact for selected Pharmaceutical and Biotech customers of all sizes, acting as an escalation point
  • Work with new and existing customers to expand contract offerings and strengthen long-term service value

• 2+ years of experience in a Leadership role
  • 5+ years of experience working in IT, Project Management, Consultancy, Technical Product management or an adjacent business role
  • Proven hiring professional with demonstrated success attracting and selecting strong technical talent
  • Skilled escalation manager able to navigate complex customer situations and drive outcomes aligned with customer success
  • Adaptable contributor who performs effectively both independently and within cross-functional, fast-paced environments
  • Analytical problem-solver with strong critical thinking and decision-making abilities
  • Clear and confident communicator with excellent written and verbal English skills
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience
  • Legal authorization to work in Poland or Hungary
  • Ability to work from the Budapest office once per month and to travel periodically for customer or team meetings

• Experience in Life Sciences environments, particularly with cloud or SaaS solutions
  • Knowledge of Managed Services, cloud operations, or post-implementation support models
  • Familiarity with Veeva Vault or other enterprise cloud platforms (eg. CRM or ERP)

• We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.
  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • If moving to the interview stage, our process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A personality assessment
    3. A practical case exercise
    4. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Veeva Charitable Giving Program
  • Mobile and/or internet contribution
  • Medical Insurance
  • Glasses and Fitness reimbursements
  • Healthy Meals
  • Additional annual leave over the end of year (Veeva Break)

• Total compensation: 240,000 - 380,000 PLN

lists.content:
• Lead a post implementation team that services customers of Veeva Quality Cloud
  • Responsible for hiring, performance management, and mentorship
  • Execute as a Services Delivery Lead for multiple customer engagements as a non-billable resource. Dedicate up to 25% of time engaging with customers
  • Managing supply and demand of your team. Responsible for staffing the right people on the right post-implementation projects and providing oversight to ensure delivery success
  • Support and coach your team. Find and create billable work to drive productivity and hold your team accountable
  • Manage escalations and support sales and other teams in the pre-sales process
  • Cultivate trusted relationships with customers
  • Provide executive oversight of internal initiatives and project sponsorship
  • Build an internal network across Veeva – Sales, Strategy, Product, and Services - to champion customer and employee success

• 5+ years of software services experience at a software vendor or consulting firm
  • 2+ years in people management
  • Has grown and led a team of customer-facing software consultants
  • Operational excellence in leading Services including utilization and resource management
  • Ability to travel up to 25% of the time

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.
  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • If moving to the interview stage, our process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A personality assessment
    3. A practical case exercise
    4. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $90,000 - $150,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

The Role
X-pages is a Vault CRM capability offering a customized user experience with AI-driven, actionable insights for streamlined workflows and better decision-making.
 
Our X-pages Technical Services team supports global and regional pharmaceutical and biotech organizations, using best-in-class cloud technology to drive more impactful engagements. We need a leader to manage the intersection of elite frontend engineering and seamless technical service delivery.
 
You will oversee a growing team of technical consultants responsible for delivering game-changing X-pages through a professional, collaborative effort with other consultants and customers. lists.content:
Your Impact as a Leader
  • Own the hiring and mentorship of a high-performance frontend squad
  • Don't just follow trends, set them. You will evolve our service offerings to include the latest in AI-driven UX and modular frontend architecture
  • Act as the technical North Star for our largest accounts, turning complex technical escalations into long-term strategic partnerships. You will partner closely with customers as well as our Product and Business Consulting divisions
  • Balance resource utilization with employee success. Instead of burnout, we believe in sustainable high performance
    • Your Tech Stack
  • Veeva X-pages allows for both No-Code (X-pages Studio) and Pro-Code (Custom Dev) development. Your team will be responsible for delivering modular and sustainable code in JavaScript frameworks (e.g., Vue) for all custom solutions
  • Data typically originates from the CRM, but X-pages can also integrate with other sources
  • X-pages embed AI-generated insights and provide a UI to interact with agents. Your team will work with LLM APIs and participate in prompt and context engineering

• Leadership: 2+ years of experience in a leadership role
  • Industry Experience: 5+ years of experience working in IT, Technical Consulting, Technical Product Management, or an adjacent business role
  • Talent Acquisition: Proven hiring professional with demonstrated success attracting and selecting strong technical talent
  • Escalation Management: Skilled escalation manager able to navigate complex customer situations and drive outcomes aligned with customer success
  • Adaptability: An adaptable contributor who performs effectively both independently and within cross-functional, fast-paced environments
  • Technical Oversight: Experience managing technical debt versus delivery speed in a high-growth SaaS environment
  • Frontend Architecture: Deep understanding of the frontend build pipeline and how it impacts service delivery
  • Communication: Clear and confident communicator with excellent written and verbal English skills
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience
  • Eligibility: Legal authorization to work in Hungary
• AI Integration: Experience integrating AI/LLM components into frontend interfaces (e.g., streaming responses, AI-driven UI components)

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.
  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • If moving to the interview stage, our process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A personality assessment
    3. A practical case exercise
    4. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Veeva Charitable Giving Program
  • Mobile and/or internet contribution
  • Medical Insurance
  • Glasses and fitness reimbursements
  • Healthy meals
  • Additional annual leave over the end of the year (Veeva Break)

• Total compensation: 21,000,000 - 36,000,000 HUF
  • The total compensation range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential total compensation range for this role. Please note that actual total compensation may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position's total compensation may be composed of other types of compensation, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

The Role
As a Technical Consultant specializing in environment and release management, you will be a key member of the Veeva Technical Services team. You will be working on our industry-leading Vault Platform, which powers all Veeva applications across the Commercial and Dev Cloud spaces.
 
You will join the Environment & Deployment Excellence Team within Technical Services. Our team oversees large-scale development workstreams and robust environment landscapes, ensuring reliable, automated configuration deployments with version control. Development teams depend on our expertise in maintaining safe code isolation and effectively managing conflicts across multiple workstreams.
 
The role requires a technical mindset: you will take care not only of the release standards, but the release package creation, the version control system built around it, the data migration itself, and the troubleshooting. We use a dedicated “toolset base” that includes free source ones as well as massive in-house built and continuously upgraded applications.

lists.content:
• Design and implement release strategies and configuration distribution models
  • Define and enforce standards for development, configuration deployment, and environment management
  • Build, test, and deploy configuration packages through automated CI/CD pipelines and version control systems
  • Responsible for managing and synchronizing multiple project workstreams, proactively identifying and mitigating risks arising from cross-project dependencies
  • Create and maintain Vault sandbox environments for production, QA, and development purposes
  • Serve as a subject matter expert to help establish environment management strategies for new customers
  • Analyze and propose optimal deployment solutions for new product features
  • Collaborate with the developer teams, and support their work
  • Contribute to internal projects by developing innovative tools to improve deployment quality, efficiency, and speed
  • Deliver knowledge transfers and provide ad-hoc training to customer teams

Experience & Education:
  • 2+ years of professional experience in software development, DevOps, or a similar technical role
  • A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, MIS, or equivalent practical experience
  • Proven experience in full lifecycle software implementation projects
  • Candidates must be eligible for employment in Europe
    • Technical Skills:
  • Proficiency with version control systems (e.g., Git)
  • Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities
  • Solid understanding of the following:
  • Relational databases
  • API principles and web services
  • Continuous Integration (CI/CD) pipelines
  • XML
  • Package automation and deployment
    • Qualities & Communication:
  • A passion for technology and a drive to solve complex challenges
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to support technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Direct experience designing or working within a cloud-native architecture (AWS, Azure)
  • Familiarity with the end-to-end software development lifecycle (SDLC) and its associated tools, such as Jenkins, Selenium, and GitHub
  • Practical programming and code-reviewing skills, particularly with languages like Python, Java, or Shell scripting
  • Proven experience building or integrating with RESTful APIs

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Stock bonus %
  • Health & wellness programs
  • Life Assurance
  • Veeva charitable giving program
  • Free lunch on Tuesday and Wednesday in the Veeva office
  • Additional annual leave over Christmas break

• Total compensation: 12,000,000 - 23,000,000 HUF

lists.content:
• Design, develop, and evangelize custom user experiences, with an emphasis on data-driven workflow

lists.content:
• Extend application capabilities through Java-based solutions using the Vault Java SDK 
  • Design and implement cloud-based integrations using REST APIs 
  • Manage integration and development projects and resources
  • Develop internal and external tools to help our customers and our consultants
  • Provide subject matter expertise on the Veeva Vault product functionality and APIs
  • Work closely with customers to establish solutions at the business and technical level

• 3+ years of programming in Java or other object-oriented programming languages
  • Proven ability to manage concurrent projects with concurrent deadlines
  • 4-year degree majoring in a technical field (Computer Science, Management Information Systems or equivalent)
  • Proven analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Desire to go into a technical consulting career path
  • Ability to travel up to 10%
  • Experience with working within Cloud Based Architecture
  • Integration/Programming experience with REST-based APIs
  • Ability to take technical concepts/solutions and educate non-technical audiences

• Experience with Spring and Maven
  • Hands-on experience with SSO and SAML
  • Experience with AWS services and methodologies, particularly on using Serverless components, including AWS Lambda, Step Functions, API Gateway, Fargate, and CloudFormation

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.

  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.

    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Work Anywhere - you can work from home or the office on any given day
  • Fitness and Wellness Reimbursements
  • Allocations for donations to the non-profits and charities of your choosing

lists.content:

  • Manage integration and development projects and resources
  • Develop internal and external tools to help our customers and our consultants
  • Provide subject matter expertise on the Veeva Vault product functionality and APIs
  • Work closely with customers to establish solutions at the business and technical level

• 3+ years of programming in Java or other object-oriented programming languages
  • Proven ability to manage concurrent projects with concurrent deadlines
  • 4-year degree majoring in a technical field (Computer Science, Management Information Systems or equivalent)
  • Proven analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Desire to go into a technical consulting career path
  • Ability to travel up to 10%
  • Experience with working within Cloud Based Architecture
  • Integration/Programming experience with REST-based APIs
  • Ability to take technical concepts/solutions and educate non-technical audiences

• Experience with Spring and Maven
  • Hands-on experience with SSO and SAML
