The Role
Managed Services are provided to our customers after they go live with Veeva Quality applications. We aim to be our customers' trusted partners and ensure they leverage the additional value Veeva applications offer.
 
Our Quality Services Team comprises 60+ consultants in Europe, of which 15+ are in the Managed Services Team. Due to the rapid growth of our client portfolio, we are opening many career opportunities for our new and existing employees. We hire people from industry, tech, and consulting, which adds diversity to our team.
Are you passionate about technology and life sciences? Would you like to be an advisor to our customers?
 
As a Quality Consultant, you will support a group of customers assigned to you. Your task will be understanding their business processes, providing guidance, discussing Vault changes, and applying all the required configurations. You will also actively collaborate with other teams at Veeva, shape ideas, enhance our delivery model, and work closely with our product management team to communicate the customer's requirements and meet the evolving needs of the industry.
 
To thrive in this role, you are likely to have the ability to adapt and learn new technology. You have been configuring, supporting, or implementing software solutions. You enjoy working with customers, speak fluent English, and have strong communication and presentation skills. We have lots of training to help you get up to speed on the knowledge part!
 
However, if you have yet to gain direct experience in IT, the exposure to Quality Management and knowledge of the regulations applying to the Life Sciences industry (pharma, biotech) is highly valued. In this case, you must be prepared for comprehensive training and much self-learning. Our team will support you and provide the necessary materials and mentoring, so your first few weeks will be intensive in learning the Veeva Quality solution and configuration. (You will not be the first person in the team who, with no experience in implementing systems, is now flourishing and enjoys working at Veeva every day). We give you an excellent opportunity to upskill and enhance your CV!
 
If you are unsure whether your experience matches the requirements, please feel free to submit your application.

data.descriptionBody:
The Role

Managed Services are provided to our customers after they go live with Veeva Quality applications. We aim to be our customers' trusted partners and ensure they leverage the additional value Veeva applications offer.
 
Our Quality Services Team comprises 60+ consultants in Europe, of which 15+ are in the Managed Services Team. Due to the rapid growth of our client portfolio, we are opening many career opportunities for our new and existing employees. We hire people from industry, tech, and consulting, which adds diversity to our team.
Are you passionate about technology and life sciences? Would you like to be an advisor to our customers?
 
As a Quality Consultant, you will support a group of customers assigned to you. Your task will be understanding their business processes, providing guidance, discussing Vault changes, and applying all the required configurations. You will also actively collaborate with other teams at Veeva, shape ideas, enhance our delivery model, and work closely with our product management team to communicate the customer's requirements and meet the evolving needs of the industry.
 
To thrive in this role, you are likely to have the ability to adapt and learn new technology. You have been configuring, supporting, or implementing software solutions. You enjoy working with customers, speak fluent English, and have strong communication and presentation skills. We have lots of training to help you get up to speed on the knowledge part!
 
However, if you have yet to gain direct experience in IT, the exposure to Quality Management and knowledge of the regulations applying to the Life Sciences industry (pharma, biotech) is highly valued. In this case, you must be prepared for comprehensive training and much self-learning. Our team will support you and provide the necessary materials and mentoring, so your first few weeks will be intensive in learning the Veeva Quality solution and configuration. (You will not be the first person in the team who, with no experience in implementing systems, is now flourishing and enjoys working at Veeva every day). We give you an excellent opportunity to upskill and enhance your CV!
 
If you are unsure whether your experience matches the requirements, please feel free to submit your application.

lists.content:
• Extend application capabilities through Java-based solutions using the Vault Java SDK
  • Design and implement cloud-based integrations using REST APIs
  • Manage integration and development projects and resources
  • Develop internal and external tools to help our customers and our consultants
  • Provide subject matter expertise on the Veeva Vault product functionality and APIs
  • Work closely with customers to establish solutions at the business and technical level
    •

• 3+ years of programming in Java or other object-oriented programming languages
  • Experience with AWS services and methodologies, particularly on using Serverless components, including AWS Lambda, Step Functions, API Gateway, Fargate, and CloudFormation
  • Technical consulting experience in the life sciences industry
  • Proven ability to manage concurrent projects with concurrent deadlines
  • 4-year degree majoring in a technical field (Computer Science, Management Information Systems or equivalent)
  • Proven analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Desire to go into a technical consulting career path
  • Ability to travel up to 10%
  • Must be both located in and legally authorized to be employed in the United States or Canada

• Experience with working within Cloud Based Architecture
  • Hands-on experience with SSO and SAML
  • Integration/Programming experience with REST-based APIs
  • Experience with scripting languages (Go, Python, Node.js)
  • Experience with Spring and Maven
  • Community involvement or organizational leadership experience
  • Ability to take technical concepts/solutions and educate non-technical audiences

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.

    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $75,000 - $150,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

Veeva Systems, a leader in cloud-based solutions for the global life sciences industry, is looking for a Technical Consultant to join our RTSM (Randomization and Trial Supply Management) team. The Technical Consultant will write custom code for RTSM projects, helping customers expedite trials and bring treatments to patients faster.
 
This position requires great attention to detail and is a remote, full-time, exempt, position. Days and hours of work are generally Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, however, hours are dependent on customer needs and deliverables.

The Role

Veeva Systems, a leader in cloud-based solutions for the global life sciences industry, is looking for a Technical Consultant to join our RTSM (Randomization and Trial Supply Management) team. The Technical Consultant will write custom code for RTSM projects, helping customers expedite trials and bring treatments to patients faster.
 
This position requires great attention to detail and is a remote, full-time, exempt, position. Days and hours of work are generally Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, however, hours are dependent on customer needs and deliverables.

lists.content:
• Work closely with cross-functional team members and customers to understand RTSM requirements
  • Code, test, debug, document, and install modified and new RTSM projects based on customer requirements
  • Use coding methods for specific programming languages used at Veeva to enhance or initiate efficient program execution and performance
  • Provide RTSM expertise and guidance in the RTSM design
  • Work within the specifications provided to meet programming assignment goals and objectives in a timely and accurate manner
  • Maintain the integrity of program logic and coding and establish required checks and balances for operational controls
  • Maintain a working knowledge of all RTSM projects and timelines and oversee the completion of application development milestones
  • Facilitate and troubleshoot the myriad issues associated with designing complex systems and projects

• Experience and expertise in coding in C#, ASP.NET framework, XML, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
  • Proficient in MSSQL
  • Excellent attention to detail and problem-solving/analysis skills
  • Located in eastern or central time zones
  • 4-year degree or equivalent experience

• 2+ years of RTSM/IRT experience
  • 2+ years in the Life Sciences industry

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $75,000 - $150,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

data.descriptionPlain:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
 
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
 
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
 
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.


The Role
Make the work of our customers delivering life-changing medicines and treatments to patients more efficient and productive.  We are looking for an experienced technical product manager to design and deliver high-value AI Agent solutions for Veeva Development Cloud.  In this role, you will be an expert in the use of AI to design and build AI agents that will speed up clinical trials, automate regulatory submissions, or make pharmacovigilance more efficient.

The Role

Make the work of our customers delivering life-changing medicines and treatments to patients more efficient and productive.  We are looking for an experienced technical product manager to design and deliver high-value AI Agent solutions for Veeva Development Cloud.  In this role, you will be an expert in the use of AI to design and build AI agents that will speed up clinical trials, automate regulatory submissions, or make pharmacovigilance more efficient.

lists.content:
• Hands-on design and development of prototypes of AI solutions for a specific application domain such as Submissions, Clinical, or Drug Safety working with application PMs and customers.
  • Design and deliver production AI Agent applications including data flow, orchestration, and prompts.
  • Work with engineering and UX to automate key business processes using AI.
  • Present solution capabilities and value to internal and external stakeholders.

• 5+ years of enterprise software product management, engineering, or consulting experience, with at least 2 years focused on AI/ML applications.
  • Experience with data flow design, algorithm selection, and model integration.
  • Coding skills in Python and hands-on experience with AI Frameworks and APIs.
  • Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts, LLMs, and prompt engineering.
  • Strong collaboration skills for working with engineering, UX design, and application product management teams.
  • Excellent communication skills to work with non-technical stakeholders.

• Experience in Life Sciences
  • Experience in a data scientist, machine learning, or data engineering role.

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $75,000 - $165,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

data.descriptionBody:
The Role

We are seeking an experienced technical product manager to design and deliver high-value AI Agent solutions for Veeva Labeling, a new product being developed by a team moving with the speed of a startup and the resources of a market-leading public company. In this role, you will be an expert in the use of AI to design and build AI agents that will author and validate drug labeling content and automate related processes.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.


The Role
We are seeking an experienced technical product manager to design and deliver high-value AI Agent solutions across the Veeva Quality Cloud suite of products. Veeva Quality Cloud accelerates the manufacturing of high-quality products to a greater number of patients. The cloud platform unifies applications, processes and partners across content management, training, Quality Management System (QMS) and QC lab solutions (LIMS). In this role, you will be an expert in the use of AI to design and build AI agents that analyze document content and intelligently extract the information to map & store them as structured data within the Veeva Quality Cloud data model (i.e. ‘Docs to Data’).

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced technical product manager to design and deliver high-value AI Agent solutions across the Veeva Quality Cloud suite of products. Veeva Quality Cloud accelerates the manufacturing of high-quality products to a greater number of patients. The cloud platform unifies applications, processes and partners across content management, training, Quality Management System (QMS) and QC lab solutions (LIMS). In this role, you will be an expert in the use of AI to design and build AI agents that analyze document content and intelligently extract the information to map & store them as structured data within the Veeva Quality Cloud data model (i.e. ‘Docs to Data’).

lists.content:
• Hands-on design and development of AI agents focused on ‘Docs to Data’ across the Veeva Quality Cloud
  • Design and deliver production AI Agent applications including data flow, orchestration, and prompts
  • Work with engineering and UX to automate key business processes using AI
  • Assist with AI Agent evaluations
  • Present feature capabilities and value to internal and external stakeholders

• 5+ years of enterprise SaaS product management, engineering, or technical consulting experience, with at least 2+ years focused on AI/ML applications
  • Experience with data flow design, algorithm selection, and model integration
  • Coding skills in Python and hands-on experience with AI Frameworks and APIs
  • Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts, LLMs, and prompt engineering
  • Strong collaboration skills for working with engineering, UX design, and application product management teams
  • Excellent communication skills to work with non-technical stakeholders
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment with little direct supervision
  • Must be based in or within one hour of the Eastern Time zone
  • Must be able to travel 20%

• Experience in a data scientist, machine learning, or data engineering role
  • Experience in Life Sciences
  • Experience building products on application development platforms
  • Experience building software for regulated industries
  • Experience interacting with customers and internal teams remotely and across geographies

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $75,000 - $165,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

• Experience working for an enterprise software company ( preferred)

  • Experience with AI-driven content workflows and tooling

The Role

The Technical Writer will own content areas within a complex, fast-moving product ecosystem. As Technical Writer, you will work closely with other writers and with Product to deliver high-quality content on a monthly release cadence, using AI tooling and automation to produce documentation, and contribute to our multimedia strategy with video and eLearning content.

lists.content:
• Own documentation for multiple areas within CRM Product; deliver new content on a monthly release content and manage existing content, ensuring it’s easy for customers to find and use
  • Leverage AI tools and automation to improve documentation efficiency, quality, and speed-of-delivery
  • Support our multimedia content strategy, including video and eLearning resources, to meet customers where they are
  • Build strong relationships with product, engineering, and other stakeholders to stay ahead of upcoming changes and ensure content reflects the product accurately
  • Collaborate with other writers and participate in review cycles
  • Apply and help evolve team standards and processes for writing, publishing, and distribution

• 3+ years of technical writing experience or equivalent in a related role (for example, information design, knowledge management, documentation engineering)
  • A proven ability to dive deep into complex technical systems independently, learning new features quickly to translate them into customer-centric content
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams
  • Strong prioritization and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities in a deadline-driven environment
  • Experience with technical authoring environments and docs-as-code approach
  • Portfolio or samples that demonstrate ability to deliver content for a technical audience
  • U.S. West location (Pacific Timezone) required

• Experience working for an enterprise software company ( preferred)
  • Experience with Git, XML, HTML, Markdown, and/or Madcap Flare (preferred)
  • Experience with AI-driven content workflows and tooling
  • Experience with video production, eLearning development, or creating interactive training materials to support a multimedia content strategy
  • Familiarity with web development and programming languages (HTML, XML, CSS; Python, React, Javascript)

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $75,000 - $115,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

Veeva Systems is building the industry cloud for Life Sciences to help companies work in a more efficient and connected way. Learn more about our products, vision and values, and status as a public benefit corporation on our website.
Veeva Services ensures customers are successful with our products. Our services team works directly with customers to help them implement, use, and innovate with our technology. Because we’re a services firm in a product company, we’re uniquely positioned with deep product and industry expertise to help customers achieve their goals. We have one primary objective: customer success.
Great people deliver great services; our people are our most valuable asset. We’re continually seeking great people with a passion for technology and complex problem-solving to join our team.
Explore More Generation Veeva Roles
We welcome you to apply to all roles that align with your skills and interests. See all open opportunities here: Generation Veeva Careers
The Role
The Technology Consulting Intern role is part of our Consultant Development Program, which is designed to grow recent university graduates into the next generation of services consultants. The Intern role is specifically designed for Bachelor's and Master's students in their final year of studies who can commit to work 6-12 months for at least 20 hours per week, with the potential to pursue a full-time Associate Consultant position after graduating from University. 
This is a high-impact, customer-facing role where you help solve complex business challenges and get to be hands-on with technology everyday.
We believe in pushing high potential people to achieve excellence. Our program is specifically designed to provide a challenging environment where you’re expected to learn fast, contribute quickly, and are empowered with significant responsibility early.
This role doesn’t require a background in life sciences or technology. You bring your drive and ability to learn; we’ll provide education on the industry, technical training, and robust opportunities to develop your consulting skills and grow your career.

lists.content:
• Work directly with customers, providing expertise on Veeva’s applications and platform
  • Configure Veeva software under the guidance of experienced architects and project leads
  • Collaborate in teams to help implement and optimize Veeva software by contributing in key roles (e.g., project management, solution design and configuration workshops, validation, integration, migration, training)

lists.text: REQUIREMENTS | We are looking for graduates who meet the following requirements:
lists.content:
• Thrives in a challenging, intense environment that rewards initiative and rapid learning
  • Desire to be hands-on with technology
  • Active student status at a Hungarian university pursuing a Degree (Bachelor's or Master's) in any field and in the final year of your studies 
  • History of strong and consistent academic performance
  • Ability to commit to at least 20h/week during core business hours
  • Fluent in English
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong critical thinking skills with an analytical mindset
  • High work ethic. Veeva is a hard-working company
  • High integrity and honesty. Veeva is a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) and a “do the right thing” company and we expect that from all employees
  • Willingness to travel as needed up to 20-30% of the time

lists.text: THE PROCESS | Our process is different from most. It is designed to be fast, efficient and respectful. Here are the steps:
lists.content:
• You submit your resume, short cover letter of questions, and take a personality test
  • Within one week we will notify you via email if we would like to go to the next step or not
  • The next step is a 60-minute interview followed by a case exercise. You will have three days to prepare for the case exercise
  • Within one week after this step, we will give you an offer or let you know that we do not wish to move forward
  • You will have two weeks to accept our offer or not. If you accept, we will hold a spot for you and expect you to show up on your start date. Accepting an offer and continuing to interview would be an ethical violation in our view

• Starting Salary: Hourly rate 2,250 - 3,500 HUF
  • After one year, if you perform well, you will receive a compensation increase and participate in our bonus program.

lists.content:

  • Itinerary Management- creating detailed, accurate travel itineraries and communicating them to the HCPs
  • Compliance - ensuring all travel arrangements adhere to the company's travel policies, budget constraints, and industry regulations (e.g., visa/passport requirements, health advisories)
  • Database management - manage promotional educational programs within the proprietary system
  • Budget management - assisting customer representatives with their program planning budget to ensure they meet customer business rules and guidelines
  • Frequent daily communication with sales representatives and faculty as needed
  • Ensuring all event materials are complete and accurate
  • Work closely with other team members to ensure successful execution of events and travel
  • Adherence to various policies (i.e., confidentiality, sensitive communication, intellectual property)
  • Effectively manage a high volume of events while also responding to emails and phone calls
  • Manage and monitor a high volume of emails daily.
  • Cover after-hours phone line 5pm-midnight on a rotated basis (weeks selected by coordinator)
  • Must be able to work in-office Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday

• High School diploma or equivalent; College Degree Preferred
  • 1-2 years experience in field or related area (Travel Agency, Sales, Hospitality, Pharmaceutical, Medical Industry, and Customer Service)
  • Pharmaceutical Speaker Bureau experience is a plus
  • Pharmaceutical Event Planning experience is a plus
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Professional and clear oral and written communication and etiquette skills to successfully manage high phone and email volume 
  • Demonstrate ability to work in a fast-paced environment, changing planning activities and/or multitasking often to meet fluctuating customer /company priorities 
  • Proficiency in MS Office, Word, Excel (e.g., financial calculations, pivot tables, VLOOKUP’s), and Gmail preferred

• Exceptional attention to detail
  • Ability to work and thrive in a team atmosphere
  • Positive attitude and maintain a “Whatever it Takes” attitude
  • Ability to take on additional ad hoc tasks as needed to support the team
  • Ability to maintain productivity while performing repetitive planning tasks every day

  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $22 - $28/hour

The Role

The travel Coordinator will be responsible for travel booking, itinerary management and compliance for pharmaceutical educational events and ensuring that commitments are met on schedule and within budget. This person must maintain consistent communication with various internal and external stakeholders in a high-volume, deadline-driven environment.

lists.content:
• Booking travel - arrange and book travel for HCPs, including flights, hotels, ground transportation, etc.
  • Itinerary Management- creating detailed, accurate travel itineraries and communicating them to the HCPs
  • Compliance - ensuring all travel arrangements adhere to the company's travel policies, budget constraints, and industry regulations (e.g., visa/passport requirements, health advisories)
  • Database management - manage promotional educational programs within the proprietary system
  • Budget management - assisting customer representatives with their program planning budget to ensure they meet customer business rules and guidelines
  • Frequent daily communication with sales representatives and faculty as needed
  • Ensuring all event materials are complete and accurate
  • Work closely with other team members to ensure successful execution of events and travel
  • Adherence to various policies (i.e., confidentiality, sensitive communication, intellectual property)
  • Effectively manage a high volume of events while also responding to emails and phone calls
  • Manage and monitor a high volume of emails daily.
  • Cover after-hours phone line 5pm-midnight on a rotated basis (weeks selected by coordinator)

• High School diploma or equivalent; College Degree Preferred
  • 1+ years experience in field or related area (Travel Agency, Sales, Hospitality, Pharmaceutical, Medical Industry, and Customer Service)
  • Pharmaceutical Speaker Bureau experience is a plus
  • Pharmaceutical Event Planning experience is a plus
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Professional and clear oral and written communication and etiquette skills to successfully manage high phone and email volume 
  • Demonstrate ability to work in a fast-paced environment, changing planning activities and/or multitasking often to meet fluctuating customer /company priorities 
  • Proficiency in MS Office, Word, Excel (e.g., financial calculations, pivot tables, VLOOKUP’s), and Gmail preferred

• Exceptional attention to detail
  • Ability to work and thrive in a team atmosphere
  • Positive attitude and maintain a “Whatever it Takes” attitude
  • Ability to take on additional ad hoc tasks as needed to support the team
  • Ability to maintain productivity while performing repetitive planning tasks every day

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $22 - $28/hour
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

lists.content:
• Technical Thought Leadership: Act as a technical thought partner and trusted advisor for all stakeholders, shaping secure, scalable solutions that address enterprise challenges in AI, integration, governance, compliance, and developer productivity
  • Cultivate Strategic Partnerships: Establish and maintain extensive partnerships with technology leaders at major global and enterprise-level organizations to successfully drive Veeva Vault platform success
  • Architectural Guidance: Guide customers through technical evaluations and architectural decisions, aligning Veeva Vault Platform capabilities with their business and technology objectives
  • Compelling Communication: Deliver impactful technical presentations, demos, and proofs of concept to showcase the transformative potential of the Veeva Vault Platform
  • Innovation: Stay at the forefront of Vault Platform innovations, including Veeva AI, bringing technical insight and thought leadership to customer engagements
  • Customer Engagement Support: Support the team in preparing and delivering winning presentations and demonstrations.  Analyze and understand customer business and technical requirements
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with cross-functional teams to ensure customer success and provide feedback from the customer engagements that shapes our product direction

• 5+ years of experience in pre-sales solution engineering or consulting
  • Deep technical knowledge of enterprise applications, preferably knowledge of the Veeva Vault platform
  • Proven aptitude across the domains of software, Artificial Intelligence (AI), infrastructure, and Software as a Service (SaaS)
  • Knowledge of Integration Patterns: (e.g., REST/SOAP APIs, Middleware)
  • Understanding of DevOps/ALM and CI/CD processes
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Experience creating architectural diagrams, technical specification documents, and data flow maps
  • A strategic thinker with a customer and team-first mindset and a passion for innovation
  • Excellent presentation and communication skills
  • Driven self-starter; able to work independently
  • Willingness to travel 20-30%

• Bachelor’s Degree
  • Pharmaceutical or Biotech Industry Knowledge: Prior experience or strong familiarity with the drug development lifecycle (e.g., Clinical, Regulatory, Quality) and the use of technology within these processes. (While not mandatory, it's highly advantageous given Veeva's core market)
  • Working knowledge of GxP compliance and Validated Systems
  • Veeva or Adjacent Ecosystem Experience: Familiarity with the Veeva Vault Platform or experience with other enterprise SaaS platforms/ecosystems prevalent in the Life Sciences domain

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $100,000 - $165,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

This critical role requires deep expertise in software, AI, and infrastructure, paired with a year track record of establishing strategic partnerships with technologists in global organizations. As a member of our team, you will be responsible for supporting customer sales cycles by working with Account Partners, Strategy Leads, and Solution Consultants to understand our customers’ technical environment and to clearly articulate the differentiated value of the Veeva Vault Platform.
 
In this capacity, you will act as a technical thought partner and trusted advisor for all stakeholders. You will excel at shaping secure, scalable solutions that address enterprise challenges in governance, compliance, and developer/administrator productivity. You will guide customers to a best-in-class solution by aligning Veeva Vault Platform capabilities with their business and technology objectives.
data.description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
 
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
 
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
 
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

We are looking for a highly-technical Vault Platform Pre-Sales Solution Architect to join our Solution Consulting Team. This critical role requires deep expertise in software, AI, and infrastructure, paired with a year track record of establishing strategic partnerships with technologists in global organizations. As a member of our team, you will be responsible for supporting customer sales cycles by working with Account Partners, Strategy Leads, and Solution Consultants to understand our customers’ technical environment and to clearly articulate the differentiated value of the Veeva Vault Platform.
 
In this capacity, you will act as a technical thought partner and trusted advisor for all stakeholders. You will excel at shaping secure, scalable solutions that address enterprise challenges in governance, compliance, and developer/administrator productivity. You will guide customers to a best-in-class solution by aligning Veeva Vault Platform capabilities with their business and technology objectives.

lists.content:
• Technical Thought Leadership: Act as a technical thought partner and trusted advisor for all stakeholders, shaping secure, scalable solutions that address enterprise challenges in AI, integration, governance, compliance, and developer productivity
  • Cultivate Strategic Partnerships: Establish and maintain extensive partnerships with technology leaders at major global and enterprise-level organizations to successfully drive Veeva Vault platform success
  • Architectural Guidance: Guide customers through technical evaluations and architectural decisions, aligning Veeva Vault Platform capabilities with their business and technology objectives
  • Compelling Communication: Deliver impactful technical presentations, demos, and proofs of concept to showcase the transformative potential of the Veeva Vault Platform
  • Innovation: Stay at the forefront of Vault Platform innovations, including Veeva AI, bringing technical insight and thought leadership to customer engagements
  • Customer Engagement Support: Support the team in preparing and delivering winning presentations and demonstrations.  Analyze and understand customer business and technical requirements
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with cross-functional teams to ensure customer success and provide feedback from the customer engagements that shapes our product direction

• 5+ years of experience in pre-sales solution engineering or consulting
  • Deep technical knowledge of enterprise applications, preferably knowledge of the Veeva Vault platform
  • Proven aptitude across the domains of software, Artificial Intelligence (AI), infrastructure, and Software as a Service (SaaS)
  • Knowledge of Integration Patterns: (e.g., REST/SOAP APIs, Middleware)
  • Understanding of DevOps/ALM and CI/CD processes
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Experience creating architectural diagrams, technical specification documents, and data flow maps
  • A strategic thinker with a customer and team-first mindset and a passion for innovation
  • Excellent presentation and communication skills
  • Driven self-starter; able to work independently
  • Willingness to travel 20-30%

• Bachelor’s Degree
  • Pharmaceutical or Biotech Industry Knowledge: Prior experience or strong familiarity with the drug development lifecycle (e.g., Clinical, Regulatory, Quality) and the use of technology within these processes. (While not mandatory, it's highly advantageous given Veeva's core market)
  • Working knowledge of GxP compliance and Validated Systems
  • Veeva or Adjacent Ecosystem Experience: Familiarity with the Veeva Vault Platform or experience with other enterprise SaaS platforms/ecosystems prevalent in the Life Sciences domain

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

• Base pay: $100,000 - $165,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

The Role
Business Consulting at Veeva is a unique group fusing strategy and technology inside a company at the forefront of digital innovation in Life Sciences; establishing a leading Business Consulting practice is a strategic priority for Veeva, with high visibility within the company and to leaders of the wider Life Sciences industry.
 
As the Consulting Practice Lead for China, you will help lead and grow this practice, with a focus on building our brand in the market, developing our customer network, and identifying and selling new projects to support our customers to deliver on their more complex and strategic business issues.
 
The ideal candidate would be Shanghai based.

Business Consulting at Veeva is a unique group fusing strategy and technology inside a company at the forefront of digital innovation in Life Sciences; establishing a leading Business Consulting practice is a strategic priority for Veeva, with high visibility within the company and to leaders of the wider Life Sciences industry.
 
As the Consulting Practice Lead for China, you will help lead and grow this practice, with a focus on building our brand in the market, developing our customer network, and identifying and selling new projects to support our customers to deliver on their more complex and strategic business issues.
 
The ideal candidate would be Shanghai based.

lists.content:
• P&L ownership of the business consulting practice in China responsible for overall strategy, growth and performance
  • Lead business development opportunities – identify and generate new project opportunities, clarify the customer’s issues and needs, be able to develop a compelling, differentiated proposal to solve these issues, and win new work
  • Leverage your network to identify and originate new opportunities, win work and build new relationships
  • Oversee the delivery of projects in your region to ensure the team delivers with excellence
  • Build strong, trusted relationships with customers, serving as a primary contact for strategic questions
  • Support in the creation of new campaigns, offerings, and thought leadership that differentiate Business Consulting in the market
  • Recruit, develop and maintain a high performing team
  • Be a key member of the China leadership team, partnering with the GM, Strategy and Account Leads to support the broader Veeva strategy and priorities

• Significant (10+ years) management and strategy consulting experience from a top tier firm.
  • Experience in the Health and Life Sciences, particularly in the Commercial and Medical area
  • An extensive network of stakeholders within leadership positions in Top 20 Life Science companies
  • Credibility and experience to operate and engage at Senior levels with our Life Sciences customers
  • Strong track record of selling consulting work
  • Previous experience of leading teams of 5-10+ people
  • Demonstrated experience in designing and implementing digital transformation and commercial improvement programs
  • Deep understanding across the entire Commercial value chain with recognized mastery in two or more of the following areas: product launch, go-to-market strategy, commercial model design, key account planning and management, segmentation and targeting, omni-channel strategy and optimization, insight, tech-led business transformation, AI and analytics, organisational change management

• Experience with digital technologies – channels, analytics tools, emerging tech
  • Good understanding of Veeva's broader platforms and solutions and how these can be leveraged and enhanced by commercial consulting services
  • Understanding of industry specific data sets
  • Experience working with SaaS solutions

• Highly competitive remuneration
  • Health & wellness programs
